daas-irab:1-5.t:
﴿الم﴾: disjointed letters (ḥurūf muqaṭṭaʿa) with no grammatical position, or a khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هذه ألم" (this is Alif Lām Mīm). ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: ذا is a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿الْكِتابُ﴾: a badal (substitute) from the demonstrative, nominative; it may also be parsed as the khabar of the demonstrative. ﴿لا رَيْبَ﴾: لا is the lā of generic negation, working like إنّ. ريب is its noun, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of accusative. ﴿فِيهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar, its implied form being "حاصل" (existing); the clause لا ريب فيه is a khabar of the demonstrative. ﴿هُدىً﴾: a second khabar of the demonstrative, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma.
﴿لِلْمُتَّقِينَ﴾: المتقين is a noun, genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; both are attached to هدى. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of المتقين. ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw is an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent). ﴿بِالْغَيْبِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb يؤمنون. The clause ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَيُقِيمُونَ﴾: its i'rab is like يؤمنون ... and the clause is conjoined to the clause before it. ﴿الصَّلاةَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَمِمَّا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and من is a preposition; ما is a relative noun, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of genitive by the preposition. ﴿رَزَقْناهُمْ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn; نا is the fāʿil, the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi, and the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural. The returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, and it is the second object; the implied form is "مما رزقناهم إياه" (of what We provided them with it), and the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿يُنْفِقُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the relative noun before it. ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿بِما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition; ما is a relative noun in the position of genitive by the preposition. ﴿أُنْزِلَ﴾: a passive past verb; the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (it), referring back to ما.
﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb أنزل; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿وَما أُنْزِلَ﴾: its i'rab is like the i'rab of the preceding one, and the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكَ﴾: both attached to the verb أنزل; the kāf is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
﴿وَبِالْآخِرَةِ﴾: both attached to the verb يوقنون. ﴿هُمْ﴾: a detached nominative pronoun, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is conjoined to the clause يؤمنون. ﴿يُوقِنُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ هم.
﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable on kasra, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, and the kāf is for address. ﴿عَلى هُدىً﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted khabar; the implied form is "أولئك سائرون على هدى" (those are proceeding upon guidance). ﴿مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ﴾: both attached to an omitted naʿt of هدى, the implied form being "هدى نازل" (guidance sent down); the clause أولئك is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَأُولئِكَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أولئك is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿هُمُ﴾: a second mubtadaʾ, a detached pronoun. ﴿الْمُفْلِحُونَ﴾: khabar of هم, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause هم المفلحون is the khabar of أولئك.

daas-irab:165-165.t:
﴿وَمِنَ﴾ The wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿مِنَ النَّاسِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the nominative (in the position of rafʿ) as a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). [Translator's note: the source prints the word as ﴿مِنَ﴾; the relative noun meant here is ﴿مَنْ﴾.] ﴿يَتَّخِذُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) being implied as "huwa" (he), referring back to مَن; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to يتخذ. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَنْداداً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يُحِبُّونَهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb; the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a ṣifa (adjective) of أندادا. ﴿كَحُبِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ṣifa of a maṣdar (verbal noun) functioning as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "a great love". ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); الذين is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿أَشَدُّ﴾ khabar of the relative noun. ﴿حُبًّا﴾ tamyīz (specification). ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive (majrūr), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the maṣdar حبا; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; لو is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿يَرَى﴾ an imperfect verb.
﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, fāʿil (agent). ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the clause يرى الذين is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) for past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يرى; it has also been said that it is in the sense of إذا, and so would be an adverb for future time. ﴿يَرَوْنَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿الْعَذابَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿أَنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿الْقُوَّةَ﴾ its noun (ism). ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty; they are a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial); أنّ with its noun and khabar are interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) standing in place of the two objects of يرى, and the apodosis (jawāb) of لو is omitted, its implied form being "they would have found an astonishing matter". ﴿وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ شَدِيدُ﴾ أنّ, the Name of Majesty is its noun and شديد is its khabar; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿الْعَذابَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). [Translator's note: the muḍāf ilayhi here is written ﴿الْعَذابَ﴾ with fatḥa in the source; in the Quranic text it is ﴿الْعَذابِ﴾.]

daas-irab:166-167.t:
﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb for past time; it is a badal (substitute) from إذ in the preceding verse. ﴿تَبَرَّأَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿اتُّبِعُوا﴾ a passive past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿مِنَ الَّذِينَ﴾ both attached to تبرأ. ﴿اتُّبِعُوا﴾ a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. [Translator's note: the source prints this second word as ﴿اتُّبِعُوا﴾, but its analysis (active verb with fāʿil) corresponds to the Quranic ﴿اتَّبَعُوا﴾.] ﴿وَرَأَوُا﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); رأوا is a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl, with قد implied before it. ﴿الْعَذابَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَتَقَطَّعَتْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; تقطع is a past verb and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿بِهِمُ﴾ both attached to تقطعت. ﴿الْأَسْبابُ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَقالَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿اتَّبَعُوا﴾ a past verb and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿لَوْ﴾ a conditional particle containing the sense of wishing (tamannī). ﴿أَنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿لَنا﴾ both attached to an omitted khabar of أنّ. ﴿كَرَّةً﴾ its noun; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿فَنَتَبَرَّأَ﴾ the fāʾ is causal (al-sababiyya); نتبرأ is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an أن concealed after the fāʾ, and its fāʿil is implied as "نحن" (we). ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ both attached to نتبرأ; أن and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar conjoined to a maṣdar implied from the preceding verb, the implied form being: "we want a return and a disavowal of these". ﴿كَما﴾ the kāf is a preposition; ما is maṣdariyya (infinitival).
﴿تَبَرَّؤُا﴾ a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the maṣdariyya ما with the verb is interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of the genitive by the kāf, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of an omitted accusative maṣdar functioning as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), its implied form being: "we disavow like their disavowal".
﴿مِنَّا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb before them. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ṣifa of an omitted maṣdar, a mafʿūl muṭlaq, its implied form being: "Allah shows them a showing like that showing". ﴿يُرِيهِمُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ because of heaviness, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿أَعْمالَهُمْ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿حَسَراتٍ﴾ ḥāl.
﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to حسرات; the clause كذلك is resumptive. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; ما is the Ḥijāzī mā, which operates like ليس. ﴿هُمْ﴾ a detached pronoun, the noun of ما. ﴿بِخارِجِينَ﴾ the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida); خارجين is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position as the khabar of ما. ﴿مِنَ النَّارِ﴾ both attached to خارجين.

daas-irab:234-234.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; الذين is a relative noun, in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يُتَوَفَّوْنَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَيَذَرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَزْواجاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يَتَرَبَّصْنَ﴾: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, and the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being: "the wives of those who die among you wait"; and this nominal clause is the khabar of الذين. ﴿بِأَنْفُسِهِنَّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before them. ﴿أَرْبَعَةَ﴾: an adverb of time, attached to the verb before it. ﴿أَشْهُرٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (the genitive term of the construct). ﴿وَعَشْراً﴾: conjoined to أربعة, i.e. ten nights.

daas-irab:235-235.t:
﴿فَإِذا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إذا is an adverb of time. ﴿بَلَغْنَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَجَلَهُنَّ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَلا جُناحَ عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: its i'rab has been given before; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿فِيما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَعَلْنَ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, and the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil. ﴿فِي أَنْفُسِهِنَّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to فعلن.
﴿بِالْمَعْرُوفِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "acting according to what is recognized (bi-l-maʿrūf)". ﴿وَاللَّهُ بِما تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ﴾: the i'rab of its like has preceded in the previous verse.
﴿وَلا جُناحَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِيما عَرَّضْتُمْ بِهِ﴾: for its i'rab see verse 228. ﴿مِنْ خِطْبَةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿النِّساءِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (the genitive term of the construct). ﴿أَوْ أَكْنَنْتُمْ﴾: أو is a conjunction; أكننتم is a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿فِي أَنْفُسِكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أكننتم; the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَلِمَ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿أَنَّكُمْ﴾: anna and its noun. ﴿سَتَذْكُرُونَهُنَّ﴾: the sīn is for the future; تذكروهن is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar (predicate) of anna; and anna with what follows it stands in place of the two objects of عَلِمَ. The clause ﴿عَلِمَ اللَّهُ ... ﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk). ﴿لا﴾: prohibitive, making the verb jussive. ﴿تُواعِدُوهُنَّ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿سِرًّا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi; it is also said to be a ḥāl, or accusative by removal of the preposition. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: particle of exception. ﴿أَنْ تَقُولُوا﴾: the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from the maṣdar-particle an and the imperfect verb after it is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the excepted. ﴿قَوْلًا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿مَعْرُوفاً﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive, making the verb jussive. ﴿تَعْزِمُوا﴾: a jussive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿عُقْدَةَ﴾: accusative by removal of the preposition, its implied form being: "upon (على) the knot".
﴿النِّكاحِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ﴾: the interpreted maṣdar formed from the an latent after حتى and the verb يبلغ is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the preposition, and the two are attached to تعزموا. ﴿الْكِتابُ﴾: fāʿil. ﴿أَجَلَهُ﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وَاعْلَمُوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اعلموا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: anna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; and the clause ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾ is its khabar; and anna with what follows it stands in place of the two objects of اعلموا. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فِي أَنْفُسِكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فَاحْذَرُوهُ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa. ﴿احذروه﴾: an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَاعْلَمُوا﴾: an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ﴾: anna, the Name of Majesty is its noun, and غفور is its khabar. ﴿حَلِيمٌ﴾: a second khabar. And anna with what follows it stands in place of the two objects of اعلموا. The clause اعلموا is conjoined.

daas-irab:236-236.t:
﴿لا جُناحَ عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: lā, its noun and its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنْ﴾: a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive. ﴿طَلَّقْتُمُ﴾: a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); it is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿النِّساءَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما لَمْ تَمَسُّوهُنَّ﴾: ما is the temporal maṣdar-particle; لم makes the verb jussive; تمسوهن is an imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; and the maṣdar-particle ما with the verb is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive by حتى, and the two are attached to the verb before them. [Translator's note: so in the source — there is no حتى in the verse; the intended sense is presumably an implied temporal adverb ("as long as").] ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿تَفْرِضُوا﴾: conjoined to تمسوهن.
Some said that أو here means: "unless you assign (إلا an تفرضوا)" ... and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted. ﴿لَهُنَّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿فَرِيضَةً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَمَتِّعُوهُنَّ﴾: the clause is conjoined to the omitted apodosis. ﴿عَلَى الْمُوسِعِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿قَدَرُهُ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause or resumptive. ﴿وَعَلَى الْمُقْتِرِ قَدَرُهُ﴾: conjoined.
﴿مَتاعاً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿بِالْمَعْرُوفِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to متاعا. ﴿حَقًّا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb. ﴿عَلَى الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to حقا.

daas-irab:237-237.t:
﴿وَإِنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿إِنْ﴾: a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive. ﴿طَلَّقْتُمُوهُنَّ﴾: a past verb; the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent) and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the mīm was given a ḍamma for lengthening (ishbāʿ); it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿أَنْ تَمَسُّوهُنَّ﴾: the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from the verb and the subjunctive-making an is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَقَدْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿فَرَضْتُمْ﴾: a verb and its fāʿil. ﴿لَهُنَّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to فرضتم. ﴿فَرِيضَةً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَنِصْفُ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); نصف is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "then what is due is half", or it is a mubtadaʾ, the implied form being "then upon you is half"; the clause is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis.
﴿ما فَرَضْتُمْ﴾: ما is a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction or of exception. ﴿إِنْ﴾: a maṣdar-particle that makes the verb subjunctive. [Translator's note: so in the source, written ﴿إِنْ﴾; the verse reads أَنْ.] ﴿يَعْفُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, and the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by a preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), the implied form being: "then half of what you assigned, except in the case of their pardoning". ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿يَعْفُوَا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) with fatḥa, conjoined. ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun, fāʿil. ﴿بِيَدِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿عُقْدَةُ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿النِّكاحِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive. [Translator's note: so in the source, written ﴿وَإِنْ﴾; the verse reads وَأَنْ.] ﴿أَنْ تَعْفُوا﴾: the interpreted maṣdar formed from the verb and the subjunctive-making an is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ, its implied form being: "and pardoning ...".
﴿أَقْرَبُ﴾: khabar. ﴿لِلتَّقْوى﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أقرب. ﴿وَلا تَنْسَوُا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive, making the verb jussive; تنسوا is a jussive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿الْفَضْلَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بَيْنَكُمْ﴾: an adverb of place, attached to an omitted ḥāl from الفضل; the clause is conjoined.
﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿بَصِيرٌ﴾: its khabar. ﴿بِما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to بصير; and the clause ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun; and the clause ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:86-86.t: ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, khabar (predicate). ﴿اشْتَرَوُا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿الْحَياةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿بِالْآخِرَةِ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) اشتروا. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; lā is negative. ﴿يُخَفَّفُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb. ﴿عَنْهُمُ﴾ attached to the verb before them. ﴿الْعَذابُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿وَلا هُمْ يُنْصَرُونَ﴾ the nominal clause is conjoined, and the verbal clause is the khabar.

daas-irab:87-87.t:
﴿قَفَّيْنا﴾ قفّاه originally means "he followed his track". القفا is the back of the neck, and from it comes قافية الشعر (the rhyme of a poem).
﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; the lām occurs in the response to an omitted oath; qad is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿آتَيْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿مُوسَى﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. The clause is the response to the oath, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿وَقَفَّيْنا﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِهِ بِالرُّسُلِ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb قفينا; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَآتَيْنا عِيسَى﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ابْنَ﴾ badal (substitute). ﴿مَرْيَمَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) with the fatḥa in place of the kasra, being a foreign proper name. ﴿الْبَيِّناتِ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra, being a sound feminine plural. The clause آتينا is conjoined. ﴿وَأَيَّدْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِرُوحِ﴾ attached to أيدناه. ﴿الْقُدُسِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَفَكُلَّما﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, the fāʾ is resumptive; كلما is a mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of time containing the sense of a condition and attached to its apodosis. ﴿جاءَكُمْ﴾ a past verb and a fronted mafʿūl bihi. ﴿رَسُولٌ﴾ a postponed fāʿil; the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِما﴾ attached to an adjective of رسول. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿تَهْوى﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif due to impossibility (taʿadhdhur). ﴿أَنْفُسُكُمُ﴾ fāʿil, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. [Translator's note: the source says "the hāʾ", though the attached pronoun here is كم.] ﴿فَفَرِيقاً﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and فريقا is a mafʿūl bihi fronted before the past verb. ﴿كَذَّبْتُمْ﴾ and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَفَرِيقاً تَقْتُلُونَ﴾ the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:88-89.t:
﴿وَقالُوا﴾ the wāw is resumptive; قالوا is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿قُلُوبُنا غُلْفٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of conjunction and digression (iḍrāb). ﴿لَعَنَهُمُ﴾ a past verb and mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿بِكُفْرِهِمْ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿فَقَلِيلًا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; قليلا is an adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), the implied form being "so they do not believe except with a little belief". ﴿ما﴾ a vague indefinite, an adjective of قليل. It is also said to be maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar is the fāʿil of قليل, the implied form being "little is their belief". The clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿وَلَمَّا﴾ the wāw is resumptive; لما is adverbial (ẓarfiyya) in the sense of "when" (ḥīniyya), conditional. ﴿جاءَهُمْ كِتابٌ﴾ a past verb, mafʿūl bihi and fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ عِنْدِ﴾ attached to an omitted adjective of كتاب. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مُصَدِّقٌ﴾ an adjective of كتاب. ﴿لَمَّا﴾ a relative noun in the position of genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to مصدق. [Translator's note: the source parses لِما (lām + mā) under this heading.] ﴿مَعَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of place attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَكانُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; kāna and its noun. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ min is a preposition; qablu is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of genitive by the preposition; it is made indeclinable because it is cut off from the iḍāfa, the original being "before that". The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the postponed verb يستفتحون; and the clause ﴿يَسْتَفْتِحُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, the clause being in the position of accusative as the khabar of kāna. ﴿عَلَى الَّذِينَ﴾ attached to يستفتحون. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿فَلَمَّا جاءَهُمْ ما عَرَفُوا﴾ لما is adverbial, conditional and non-jussive; جاءهم is a past verb and its object; mā is a relative noun in the position of nominative as fāʿil, and the clause عرفوا is its ṣila. The clause فلما جاءهم is conjoined, and the clause جاءهم is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa. As for the clause ﴿كَفَرُوا بِهِ﴾, it is the apodosis (jawāb) of the conditional لما. ﴿فَلَعْنَةُ﴾ the fāʾ is causal.
لعنة is mubtadaʾ. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلَى الْكافِرِينَ﴾ attached to an omitted khabar. The nominal clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:90-90.t:
﴿بِئْسَمَا﴾ بئس is a past verb for creating blame (inshāʾ al-dhamm); its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun in it, indicated by mā; mā is a complete indefinite (nakira tāmma), indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as tamyīz (specification), i.e. "evil is the purchase, a purchase…". ﴿اشْتَرَوْا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِهِ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) اشتروا. ﴿أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause is in the position of accusative as an adjective. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle. ﴿يَكْفُرُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by dropping the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil. أن and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar (predicate) is the clause بئس.
﴿بِما﴾ the bāʾ is a preposition; mā is a relative noun in the position of genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them.
﴿أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil. ﴿بَغْياً﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle.
﴿يُنَزِّلَ﴾ an imperfect verb, subjunctive; the interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is in the position of genitive by a preposition, the implied form being "out of envy that Allah sends down". ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ فَضْلِهِ﴾ attached to ينزل. ﴿عَلى مَنْ﴾ attached to ينزل. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb; the fāʿil is "he", and the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, being the object. ﴿مِنْ عِبادِهِ﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of this object, i.e. "upon whomever He wills of His servants". The clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿فَباؤُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; باءوا is a past verb and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿بِغَضَبٍ﴾ attached to the verb before them. ﴿عَلى غَضَبٍ﴾ attached to an omitted adjective of the first غضب. The clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿وَلِلْكافِرِينَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; الكافرين is a noun, genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿مُهِينٌ﴾ an adjective; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:91-91.t:
﴿وَإِذا قِيلَ لَهُمْ آمِنُوا بِما أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ﴾ the i'rab of the like of this has preceded in verse 11 and the previous verse. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿نُؤْمِنُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil being "we" (نحن). ﴿بِما﴾ mā is a relative noun in the position of genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb نؤمن. ﴿أَنْزَلَ﴾ a passive past verb, and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is "it". ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾ attached to أنزل; the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). [Translator's note: so in the source.] ﴿وَيَكْفُرُونَ﴾ the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿بِما﴾ mā is a relative noun in the position of genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يكفرون. ﴿وَراءَهُ﴾ mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of place attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial; هو is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْحَقُّ﴾ its khabar (predicate); the clause is circumstantial. ﴿مُصَدِّقاً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative. ﴿لِما﴾ mā is a relative noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to مصدقا. ﴿مَعَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of place attached to an omitted ṣila of the relative noun.
﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "you". ﴿فَلِمَ﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa, because it discloses an implied condition: "if you are truthful in your claim, then why do you kill". ﴿لم﴾ the lām is a preposition; mā is an interrogative noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn in the position of genitive by the lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the imperfect verb. ﴿تَقْتُلُونَ﴾ The alif of mā was dropped to distinguish between it and the informative (khabariyya) mā.
The clause تقتلون is the apodosis of the condition, and the condition with its apodosis is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). The clause قل is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَنْبِياءَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنْ﴾ a preposition. ﴿قَبْلُ﴾ a noun indeclinable on the ḍamma in the position of genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb تقتلون. ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun; the mīm is for the masculine plural. ﴿مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ khabar, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. The apodosis of the condition is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The clause إن كنتم is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:92-93.t:
﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; the lām occurs in the response to an oath; qad is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿جاءَكُمْ﴾ a past verb, and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مُوسى﴾ a postponed fāʿil (agent). ﴿بِالْبَيِّناتِ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿اتَّخَذْتُمُ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil. ﴿الْعِجْلَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِهِ﴾ attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial), the implied form being "then you took the calf, disbelieving, after him". ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ ظالِمُونَ﴾
the wāw is circumstantial, and mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of accusative as ḥāl. ﴿وَإِذْ أَخَذْنا مِيثاقَكُمْ وَرَفَعْنا فَوْقَكُمُ الطُّورَ خُذُوا ما آتَيْناكُمْ بِقُوَّةٍ وَاسْمَعُوا﴾ see verse 63.
﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿سَمِعْنا﴾ a past verb indeclinable on the sukūn, and نا is the fāʿil; and likewise ﴿وَعَصَيْنا﴾; the two clauses are the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَأُشْرِبُوا﴾ a passive past verb indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ﴾ attached to أشربوا, or to a ḥāl of العجل. ﴿الْعِجْلَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِكُفْرِهِمْ﴾ attached to أشربوا or to a ḥāl of العجل. ﴿الْعِجْلَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِكُفْرِهِمْ﴾ attached to أشربوا. [Translator's note: the last two items repeat in the source.] The clause أشربوا is circumstantial. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "you"; the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِئْسَما يَأْمُرُكُمْ بِهِ إِيمانُكُمْ﴾ بئس is a past verb for creating blame (inshāʾ al-dhamm), and mā is its fāʿil; the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) has been omitted, namely the love of the calf and its worship. يأمركم is an imperfect verb, the kāf is its object, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). [Translator's note: so in the source; the overt noun إيمانكم is the fāʿil of يأمر.] ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ its i'rab has preceded with verse 91, and the apodosis of the condition is omitted, its implied form being "then why did you worship the calf?".

daas-irab:94-94.t:
﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "you"; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنْ﴾ a jussive conditional particle. ﴿كانَتْ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿لَكُمُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) خالصة. ﴿الدَّارُ﴾ the noun of kāna.
﴿الْآخِرَةُ﴾ an adjective of الدار. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of place attached to خالصة. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿خالِصَةً﴾ the khabar (predicate) of kāna; it is also said to be a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ attached to the active participle خالصة. ﴿النَّاسِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. The conditional clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَتَمَنَّوُا﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis of the condition; تمنوا is an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on dropping the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿الْمَوْتَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صادِقِينَ﴾ like His saying, Exalted is He, ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ in the previous verse.

daas-irab:95-96.t:
﴿وَلَنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; lan is a particle of negation, the subjunctive and futurity. ﴿يَتَمَنَّوْهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by dropping the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَبَداً﴾ mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before it. ﴿بِما﴾ mā is a relative noun in the position of genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb يتمنوه. ﴿قَدَّمَتْ﴾ a past verb. ﴿أَيْدِيهِمْ﴾ fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ due to heaviness; the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of genitive by iḍāfa; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿عَلِيمٌ﴾ khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive, and it is also said to be circumstantial. ﴿بِالظَّالِمِينَ﴾ genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to عليم.
﴿وَلَتَجِدَنَّهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; the lām occurs in the response to an oath; تجدن is an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because of its connection with the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the nūn of emphasis has no grammatical position; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "you"; the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi, and the mīm is for the masculine plural. ﴿أَحْرَصَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿النَّاسِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَلى حَياةٍ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أحرص; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَمِنَ الَّذِينَ﴾ الذين is a relative noun indeclinable on the fatḥa in the position of genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted element, its implied form being "and more eager than those who associated partners".
﴿أَشْرَكُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿يَوَدُّ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿أَحَدُهُمْ﴾ fāʿil, nominative with the ḍamma; the clause is resumptive or circumstantial. ﴿لَوْ﴾ a maṣdar-forming particle. ﴿يُعَمَّرُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, nominative with the ḍamma; its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent pronoun implied as "he". The maṣdar-forming particle with the verb is interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, the implied form being "one of them wishes long life". ﴿أَلْفَ﴾ an adverb of time attached to يعمر. ﴿سَنَةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is circumstantial; mā is the Ḥijāzī negative mā that operates like laysa. ﴿هُوَ﴾ a detached nominative pronoun in the position of nominative as its noun.
﴿بِمُزَحْزِحِهِ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; مزحزحه is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position as the khabar of mā. ﴿مِنَ الْعَذابِ﴾ attached to مزحزح. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle. ﴿يُعَمَّرُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, subjunctive, and its nāʾib fāʿil is latent; أن and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of nominative as the fāʿil of the active participle مزحزح. The clause ما هو بمزحزحه is circumstantial. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ. ﴿بَصِيرٌ﴾ khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِما﴾ the bāʾ is a preposition; mā is a relative or maṣdar-forming particle in the position of genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to بصير.
﴿يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. The returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted: "of what they do (it)".

daas-irab:238-239.t: ﴿حافِظُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿عَلَى الصَّلَواتِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) حافظوا. ﴿وَالصَّلاةِ﴾: conjoined to الصلوات. ﴿الْوُسْطى﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿وَقُومُوا﴾: conjoined to حافظوا. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, genitive (majrūr) by the lām; the two are attached to قانتين. ﴿قانِتِينَ﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb) with yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. The clause ﴿حافِظُوا﴾ is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya), and ﴿وَقُومُوا﴾ is conjoined to it. ﴿فَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إن is conditional; خفتم is a past verb, it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is its fāʿil. ﴿فَرِجالًا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); رجالا is a ḥāl, the implied form being: "then pray on foot"; the clause is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis. ﴿أَوْ رُكْباناً﴾: conjoined to رجالا. ﴿فَإِذا﴾: إذا is an adverb for future time. ﴿أَمِنْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَاذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis; اذكروا الله: an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the Name of Majesty is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿كَما عَلَّمَكُمْ﴾: the kāf is a preposition; ما is the maṣdar-particle and, with the verb علمكم, is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive by the kāf; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective of a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, second mafʿūl bihi of علمكم. ﴿لَمْ تَكُونُوا﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its noun, and the clause ﴿تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the clause تكونوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.

daas-irab:240-240.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ يُتَوَفَّوْنَ مِنْكُمْ وَيَذَرُونَ أَزْواجاً﴾: its i'rab preceded with verse 233. [Translator's note: so in the source; the passage parsed earlier is verse 234.] ﴿وَصِيَّةً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, the implied form being: "they bequeath a bequest"; the implied clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) الذين. ﴿لِأَزْواجِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of وصية. ﴿مَتاعاً﴾: an accusative ḥāl (circumstantial); it is also said to be a badal (substitute) from وصية. ﴿إِلَى الْحَوْلِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective of متاع. ﴿غَيْرَ إِخْراجٍ﴾: غير is an accusative ḥāl, and it is also said to be an adjective of متاع; إخراج is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَإِنْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إن is conditional. ﴿خَرَجْنَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿فَلا جُناحَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِي ما فَعَلْنَ فِي أَنْفُسِهِنَّ مِنْ مَعْرُوفٍ﴾: its i'rab preceded with verse 233. ﴿وَاللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; الله, the Name of Majesty, is the mubtadaʾ, and عزيز and حكيم are two khabars.

daas-irab:241-241.t: ﴿وَلِلْمُطَلَّقاتِ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; للمطلقات is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مَتاعٌ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿بِالْمَعْرُوفِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to متاع. ﴿حَقًّا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being: "that is due as a due". ﴿عَلَى الْمُتَّقِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to حقا.

daas-irab:243-243.t: ﴿أَلَمْ﴾: the hamza is interrogative; لم is a particle that makes the verb jussive. ﴿تَرَ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil (agent) is "you" (anta). ﴿إِلَى الَّذِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb تر. ﴿خَرَجُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ دِيارِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خرجوا; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); هم is a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أُلُوفٌ﴾: khabar (predicate). ﴿حَذَرَ﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿الْمَوْتِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَقالَ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; قال is a past verb. ﴿لَهُمُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قال. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿مُوتُوا﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿أَحْياهُمْ﴾: a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is "he", referring to Allah. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿لَذُو﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). ﴿ذو﴾: khabar, nominative (marfūʿ) with wāw because it is one of the five nouns. ﴿فَضْلٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلَى النَّاسِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to فضل. ﴿وَلكِنَّ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لكن is a particle resembling the verb that conveys rectification (istidrāk). ﴿أَكْثَرَ﴾: its noun, accusative (manṣūb) with fatḥa. ﴿النَّاسِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا يَشْكُرُونَ﴾: لا is negating; يشكرون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of lākinna.

daas-irab:244-245.t: ﴿وَقاتِلُوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; قاتلوا is an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿فِي سَبِيلِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) قاتلوا. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined to an implied clause, the implied form being: "i.e. be patient and fight". ﴿وَاعْلَمُوا﴾: conjoined to قاتلوا. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾: anna, the Name of Majesty is its noun, and سميع and عليم are two khabars (predicates) of anna; and anna with what follows it stands in place of the two objects of اعلموا. ﴿مَنْ﴾: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿ذَا﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as khabar. ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun, in the position of nominative as an adjective of ذا; it is also said to be a badal (substitute); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿يُقْرِضُ اللَّهَ﴾: an imperfect verb, the Name of Majesty is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿قَرْضاً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) or mafʿūl bihi. ﴿حَسَناً﴾: an adjective. ﴿فَيُضاعِفَهُ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation (al-sababiyya); يضاعفه is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an an latent after the fāʾ of causation; the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "he", referring to Allah. ﴿لَهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يضاعفه. ﴿أَضْعافاً﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial) or mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿كَثِيرَةً﴾: an adjective. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; الله, the Name of Majesty, is the mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَقْبِضُ﴾: an imperfect verb; the clause is its khabar. ﴿وَيَبْصُطُ﴾: an imperfect verb; the clause is conjoined to يقبض. ﴿وَإِلَيْهِ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إليه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb ترجعون. ﴿تُرْجَعُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:6-7.t:
﴿الكفر﴾: denial and rejection. ﴿سَواءٌ﴾: a maṣdar (verbal noun) with the meaning of continuity; for this reason it is not put in the dual or the plural. We say هما سواء and هم سواء; when the dual form is intended, سيّان is said, and in the plural سواسية, against the regular pattern. ﴿غِشاوَةٌ﴾: a covering; its pattern is فعالة. ﴿خَتَمَ﴾: sealed; it is also said that الختم is covering.
﴿إِنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb (one of inna and its sisters). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of accusative as the noun of إنّ. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿سَواءٌ﴾: a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) سواء. ﴿أَأَنْذَرْتَهُمْ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; أنذرتهم is a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the mīm is for the masculine plural. The hamza and the verb after it are, by interpretation, a maṣdar in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the implied form is "إنذارك وعدمه سواء عليهم" (your warning and its absence are the same to them). ﴿أَمْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿لَمْ﴾: a particle of negation, of conversion [of the imperfect to past meaning] and of the jussive. ﴿تُنْذِرْهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm); the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت" (you); the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and the mīm is for the masculine plural; the clause is conjoined to the clause أنذرتهم. ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: لا is negative; يؤمنون is an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause يؤمنون is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya) or a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause. ﴿خَتَمَ﴾: a past verb. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. «[Translator's note: the source prints the word here as ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ with a kasra, although it is parsed as fāʿil; in the verse it is اللَّهُ.]» ﴿عَلى قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾: both attached to ختم. ﴿وَعَلى سَمْعِهِمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; على سمعهم is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَعَلى أَبْصارِهِمْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; على أبصارهم: both attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿غِشاوَةٌ﴾: a delayed mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَلَهُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لهم: both attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾: a delayed mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَظِيمٌ﴾: a naʿt (adjective). The two clauses are conjoined.

daas-irab:8-10.t:
﴿النَّاسِ﴾: a collective noun (ism jamʿ) with no singular from its own root; its original form is الأناس, its hamza having been dropped for lightness. ﴿يُخادِعُونَ﴾: الخداع is a person's showing something other than what is in himself. ﴿مرض القلب﴾: its weakness and its turning away from the truth.
﴿وَمِنَ النَّاسِ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; من الناس is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنَ﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of nominative as a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject). «[Translator's note: the source prints this word as ﴿مِنَ﴾; the relative noun in the verse is مَن.]» ﴿يَقُولُ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil (agent) is "هو" (he); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿آمَنَّا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn, and نا is an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive by the bāʾ; both are attached to the verb آمنا. The clause آمنا is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَبِالْيَوْمِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, conjoined to بالله. ﴿الْآخِرِ﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of اليوم. ﴿وَما هُمْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ما is negative, working like ليس; هم is a detached pronoun, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of nominative as its noun.
﴿بِمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition — or "connective" (ṣila), since there is no redundant letter in the Qur'an; مؤمنين is a noun, genitive in form and accusative in position, the khabar of ما; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿يُخادِعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾: the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi, accusative; the clause is resumptive, and it is also said to be circumstantial. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; الذين is a relative noun conjoined to الله. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of a relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; ما is negative. ﴿يَخْدَعُونَ﴾: like يخادعون. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the hāʾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa), and the mīm is for the plural. ﴿وَما يَشْعُرُونَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ما is negative; the clause يشعرون is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the khabar. ﴿مَرَضٌ﴾: a delayed mubtadaʾ. ﴿فَزادَهُمُ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; زاد is a past verb, and the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. ﴿مَرَضاً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَلَهُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction or resumptive; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, and the quasi-clause (shibh al-jumla) is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾: a delayed mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَلِيمٌ﴾: a naʿt of عذاب, nominative; the clause is conjoined or resumptive.
﴿بِما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition; ما is a relative noun, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of genitive; both are attached to أليم. ما may also be parsed as indefinite-qualified (mawṣūfa) or as maṣdariyya (forming a maṣdar). ﴿كانُوا﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb [one of kāna and its sisters], indeclinable on ḍamma, and the wāw is its noun. ﴿يَكْذِبُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of accusative as the khabar of كانوا, and the clause كانوا يكذبون is the ṣila of the relative noun.

daas-irab:11-13.t:
﴿الفساد في الأرض﴾: stirring up wars. ﴿السفه﴾: feebleness of mind; السفيه is the ignorant one.
﴿وَإِذا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إذا is an adverb for future time, putting its condition in the genitive [by annexation] and accusative by its apodosis (jawāb). ﴿قِيلَ﴾: a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is "هو" (it). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) قيل; the clause قيل is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿لا تُفْسِدُوا﴾: لا is the prohibitive lā that makes the verb jussive; تفسدوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn from its end because it is one of the five verbs, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb تفسدوا; the clause لا تفسدوا is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿إِنَّما﴾: [إنّ as] the restraining and restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿نَحْنُ﴾: a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مُصْلِحُونَ﴾: khabar (predicate), nominative, the sign of its nominative being the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl. ﴿أَلا﴾: a particle of drawing attention and of opening. ﴿إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ﴾: إنّ is a particle resembling the verb and the hāʾ is its noun, and the mīm is for the masculine plural. هم is a detached pronoun, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْمُفْسِدُونَ﴾: khabar, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the nominal clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ. هم may also be parsed as a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position, with المفسدون as the khabar of إنّ. ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk) with no grammatical position. ﴿لا يَشْعُرُونَ﴾: لا is negative; يشعرون is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَإِذا قِيلَ لَهُمْ﴾: discussed above. ﴿آمِنُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn because it is attached to the wāw of the plural, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl. ﴿كَما﴾: the kāf is a preposition; ما is maṣdariyya (forming a maṣdar). ﴿آمَنَ﴾: a past verb; ما al-maṣdariyya and the verb are, by interpretation, a maṣdar in the position of genitive by the kāf, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar functioning as a ḥāl (circumstantial) or as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the implied form is "آمنوا إيمانا كإيمان الناس" (believe with a belief like the belief of the people) ... ﴿النَّاسُ﴾: fāʿil, nominative. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿أَنُؤْمِنُ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; نؤمن is an imperfect verb and the fāʿil is "نحن" (we). ﴿كَما﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿آمَنَ السُّفَهاءُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿أَلا إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ السُّفَهاءُ وَلكِنْ لا يَعْلَمُونَ﴾: its i'rab has preceded in the previous verse. The clause أنؤمن is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl.

daas-irab:14-16.t:
﴿طغى طغيانا﴾: he exceeded the limit. ﴿يَعْمَهُونَ﴾: العمه is wavering, bewilderment and error of judgement. ﴿اشْتَرَوُا الضَّلالَةَ﴾: they took it in exchange. ﴿الهدى﴾: faith.
﴿وَإِذا﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿لَقُوا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: like لقوا, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, likewise. ﴿قالُوا﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿آمَنَّا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn because it is attached to نا denoting the agents, and ﴿نا﴾ is an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil; the verbal clause is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَإِذا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إذا is as in the previous verse. ﴿خَلَوْا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif, which was dropped to prevent the meeting of two quiescent letters, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿إِلى شَياطِينِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb خلوا; the hāʾ is in the position of genitive by annexation, and the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿إِنَّا﴾: إنّ is a particle resembling the verb; نا is an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as its noun. ﴿مَعَكُمْ﴾: مع is an adverb of place attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of إنّ, the implied form being "إنا كافرون معكم" (we are disbelievers with you). The kāf is an attached pronoun in the position of genitive by annexation, and the mīm is for the masculine plural; the clause ﴿إِنَّا مَعَكُمْ﴾ is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl. ﴿إِنَّما﴾: [إنّ as] the restraining and restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿نَحْنُ﴾: a detached nominative pronoun, indeclinable on ḍamma, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مُسْتَهْزِؤُنَ﴾: khabar, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), with no grammatical position, and it may also be parsed as a tawkīd (emphasis) of the clause ﴿إِنَّا مَعَكُمْ﴾ or as a badal (substitute) from it. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative. ﴿يَسْتَهْزِئُ﴾: an imperfect verb; its fāʿil is a pronoun latent (mustatir) by permission, its implied form being "هو" (He), referring back to Allah; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿بِهِمْ﴾: both attached to يستهزئ. The nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَيَمُدُّهُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; يمد is an imperfect verb, the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural; the fāʿil is a pronoun referring back to Allah. ﴿فِي طُغْيانِهِمْ﴾: both attached to the verb يمدهم; the hāʾ is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿يَعْمَهُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the accusative pronoun in يمدهم. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable on kasra, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, and the kāf is a particle of address. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of nominative as khabar. The nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿اشْتَرَوُا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on an implied ḍamma on the dropped alif, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿الضَّلالَةَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِالْهُدى﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb اشتروا.
The clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿فَما﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ما is negative. ﴿رَبِحَتْ﴾: a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿تِجارَتُهُمْ﴾: fāʿil, nominative; the hāʾ is in the position of genitive by annexation, and the mīm is for the plural. The verbal clause is conjoined to the ṣila clause اشتروا. ﴿وَما﴾: like the preceding one. ﴿كانُوا﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb [one of kāna and its sisters], and the wāw is its noun. ﴿مُهْتَدِينَ﴾: khabar, accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. The clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:168-169.t:
﴿يا أَيُّهَا﴾ يا is a vocative particle; أيّ is the one addressed (munādā), a specific indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative (naṣb); the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh). ﴿النَّاسُ﴾ badal (substitute) from أيّ. ﴿كُلُوا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِمَّا﴾ مِن and the relative ما; they are a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ both attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿حَلالًا﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial) from ما, or mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿طَيِّباً﴾ ṣifa (adjective). ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; لا is the prohibitive, jussive-governing lā. ﴿تَتَّبِعُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿خُطُواتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural.
﴿الشَّيْطانِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ إنّ and its noun (ism). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl of عدو, because it precedes it. ﴿عَدُوٌّ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿مُبِينٌ﴾ ṣifa of عدو. The clause إنه لكم is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.
﴿إِنَّما﴾ the restraining and restrained particles (kāffa wa-makfūfa), having no governing effect. ﴿يَأْمُرُكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb; the kāf is its object, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as "huwa" (he). ﴿بِالسُّوءِ﴾ both attached to يأمركم. ﴿وَالْفَحْشاءِ﴾ conjoined to السوء. ﴿وَأَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; أن is a maṣdar-forming particle that puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿تَقُولُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the deletion of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs (al-afʿāl al-khamsa), and the wāw is the fāʿil; أن and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) conjoined to الفحشاء, the implied form being "and saying what you do not know".
﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by على, and both are attached to the verb before them. ﴿ما لا﴾ ما is a relative noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and لا is negating. ﴿تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun.

daas-irab:170-170.t:
﴿وَإِذا﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); إذا is an adverb (ẓarf) for future time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb قالوا. ﴿قِيلَ﴾ a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as "huwa" (it). ﴿لَهُمُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to قيل; the clause قيل is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿اتَّبِعُوا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn because its imperfect is one of the five verbs, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction. ﴿نَتَّبِعُ﴾ an imperfect verb, the fāʿil being "نحن" (we); the clause is conjoined to an omitted clause, the implied form being: "we do not follow what Allah has sent down; rather, we follow". ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of the accusative, second mafʿūl bihi. [Translator's note: the source says "second mafʿūl bihi" here, though no first object of نتبع has been named.] ﴿أَلْفَيْنا﴾ a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and نا is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb before them; it has also been said that they are in the position of the accusative as the first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿آباءَنا﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَوَلَوْ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) or resumptive; لو is conditional, having no apodosis (jawāb). ﴿كانَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿آباؤُهُمْ﴾ its noun (ism). ﴿لا يَعْقِلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause كان آباؤهم is circumstantial or resumptive. ﴿وَلا يَهْتَدُونَ﴾ the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:171-171.t: ﴿وَمَثَلُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); مثل is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿كَمَثَلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of a mubtadaʾ implied as "huwa". [Translator's note: so in the source.] ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿يَنْعِقُ﴾ an imperfect verb, the fāʿil being "huwa" (he); the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿بِما﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to ينعق. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يَسْمَعُ﴾ an imperfect verb, the fāʿil being "huwa"; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿دُعاءً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَنِداءً﴾ conjoined. ﴿صُمٌّ بُكْمٌ عُمْيٌ﴾ three khabars of an omitted mubtadaʾ implied as "hum" (they); the nominal clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) or resumptive. ﴿فَهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; هم is mubtadaʾ. ﴿لا يَعْقِلُونَ﴾ the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ.

daas-irab:172-173.t:
﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ﴾ see its i'rab at verse 168. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿كُلُوا﴾ an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, being initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿مِنْ طَيِّباتِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of the omitted object.
﴿ما رَزَقْناكُمْ﴾ ما is a relative noun in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). رزقناكم: a past verb, its fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿وَاشْكُرُوا﴾ conjoined to كلوا. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by the lām, and both are attached to the verb before them. ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ﴾ إن is a jussive-governing conditional particle; كنتم is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, the tāʾ is its noun (ism), and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿إِيَّاهُ﴾ a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi. ﴿تَعْبُدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of كنتم, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. ﴿إِنَّما﴾ the restraining and restrained particles (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿حَرَّمَ﴾ a past verb, the fāʿil being "huwa" (he). ﴿عَلَيْكُمُ﴾ both attached to حرم. ﴿الْمَيْتَةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَالدَّمَ وَلَحْمَ﴾ two conjoined nouns.
﴿الْخِنْزِيرِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; ما is a relative noun conjoined to الميتة. ﴿أُهِلَّ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿بِهِ﴾ both attached to an omitted nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). [Translator's note: so in the source; the usual analysis is that the preposition and its genitive noun themselves are in the position of the nāʾib fāʿil.] ﴿لِغَيْرِ﴾ both attached to أهل. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; the clause أهل is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَمَنِ﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition); من is a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿اضْطُرَّ﴾ a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as "huwa", referring to اضطر; it is the protasis. [Translator's note: so in the source; the pronoun refers to مَن.] ﴿غَيْرَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative with the fatḥa. ﴿باغٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the deleted yāʾ. ﴿وَلا عادٍ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, لا is redundant (zāʾida), and عاد is conjoined to باغ. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis; لا is the lā of generic negation. ﴿إِثْمَ﴾ its noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ both attached to an omitted khabar of لا; the nominal clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, and the khabar of the mubtadaʾ is the protasis and its apodosis, according to the more likely view. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ إنّ and the Name of Majesty as its noun. ﴿غَفُورٌ﴾ its khabar. ﴿رَحِيمٌ﴾ a second khabar; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:174-174.t:
﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as the noun (ism) of إنّ.
﴿يَكْتُمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿ما أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ﴾ ما is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). أنزل الله: a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿مِنَ الْكِتابِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the omitted object. ﴿وَيَشْتَرُونَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to يشترون. ﴿ثَمَناً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾ ṣifa (adjective). ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, indeclinable on the kasra, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿ما يَأْكُلُونَ﴾ ما is negating; يأكلون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿فِي بُطُونِهِمْ﴾ both attached to the verb before them. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿النَّارَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿أُولئِكَ ما يَأْكُلُونَ﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ, and the clause ما يأكلون is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ أولئك. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is negating.
﴿يُكَلِّمُهُمُ اللَّهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, the hāʾ is its object, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time, attached to the verb before it.
﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَلا يُزَكِّيهِمْ﴾ the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَلَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted, fronted khabar. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَلِيمٌ﴾ ṣifa.

daas-irab:175-176.t:
﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, khabar (predicate). ﴿اشْتَرَوُا الضَّلالَةَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بِالْهُدى﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَالْعَذابَ﴾ a conjoined noun. ﴿بِالْمَغْفِرَةِ﴾ both attached to اشتروا. ﴿فَما﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); ما is a complete indefinite (nakira tāmma) in the sense of "a thing", indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ.
﴿أَصْبَرَهُمْ﴾ a non-inflecting (jāmid) past verb for expressing wonder (taʿajjub), indeclinable on the fatḥa; its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as "huwa", referring to ما, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ما. ﴿عَلَى النَّارِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to أصبر; the clause ما أصبرهم is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ the bāʾ is a preposition, and أنّ with the Name of Majesty as its noun (ism). أنّ with its noun and khabar are interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿نَزَّلَ الْكِتابَ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, the fāʿil being a latent pronoun referring to Allah; the clause is the khabar of أنّ.
﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ both attached to نزل. ﴿وَإِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿اخْتَلَفُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the nominal clause إن الذين is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿فِي الْكِتابِ﴾ both attached to اختلفوا. ﴿لَفِي﴾ the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). ﴿في شِقاقٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted khabar of إنّ. ﴿بَعِيدٍ﴾ ṣifa (adjective).

daas-irab:177-177.t:
﴿لَيْسَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿الْبِرَّ﴾ its fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿أَنْ تُوَلُّوا﴾ أن is a maṣdar-forming particle that puts the verb in the accusative; تولوا is an imperfect verb and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); أن and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) in the position of the nominative as the noun (ism) of ليس. ﴿وُجُوهَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿قِبَلَ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تولوا. ﴿الْمَشْرِقِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالْمَغْرِبِ﴾ conjoined. ﴿وَلكِنَّ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; لكنّ is a particle resembling the verb. ﴿الْبِرَّ﴾ its noun. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun, the khabar of لكنّ. ﴿آمَنَ﴾ a past verb; the clause آمن is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ both attached to آمن. ﴿وَالْيَوْمِ﴾ conjoined to الله. ﴿الْآخِرِ﴾ ṣifa (adjective). ﴿وَالْمَلائِكَةِ وَالْكِتابِ وَالنَّبِيِّينَ﴾ conjoined to الله. ﴿وَآتَى﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and آتى is a past verb. ﴿الْمالَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is "huwa" (he), referring to مَن, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَلى حُبِّهِ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from المال. ﴿ذَوِي﴾ second mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ in place of the fatḥa because it is treated like the sound masculine plural; the nūn has been deleted for annexation. ﴿الْقُرْبى﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif because of impossibility (taʿadhdhur). ﴿وَالْيَتامى وَالْمَساكِينَ وَابْنَ السَّبِيلِ وَالسَّائِلِينَ﴾ nouns conjoined to ذوي. ﴿وَفِي الرِّقابِ﴾ a conjoined preposition and genitive noun, i.e. "and gave wealth for freeing slaves". ﴿وَأَقامَ الصَّلاةَ﴾ a past verb, the fāʿil being "huwa", and الصلاة is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined, and likewise ﴿وَآتَى الزَّكاةَ﴾. ﴿وَالْمُوفُونَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; الموفون is conjoined.
﴿بِعَهْدِهِمْ﴾ both attached to الموفون. ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverb, attached to الموفون. ﴿عاهَدُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَالصَّابِرِينَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; الصابرين is a noun accusative as praise (ʿalā al-madḥ) by an omitted verb, its implied form being "I praise".
﴿فِي الْبَأْساءِ﴾ both attached to الصابرين. ﴿وَالضَّرَّاءِ﴾ conjoined to it. ﴿وَحِينَ الْبَأْسِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; حين is an adverb of time attached to الصابرين, and البأس is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, its khabar; the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿صَدَقُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿وَأُولئِكَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; أولئك is mubtadaʾ. ﴿هُمُ﴾ a second mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْمُتَّقُونَ﴾ khabar of هم; the nominal clause is the khabar of أولئك.

daas-irab:178-178.t:
﴿يا أَيُّهَا﴾ يا is a vocative particle. أيها: أيّ is the one addressed (munādā), a specific indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, and the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, badal (substitute) from أيّ. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿كُتِبَ﴾ a passive past verb.
﴿عَلَيْكُمُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) كتب. ﴿الْقِصاصُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿فِي الْقَتْلى﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from القصاص; the vocative clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿الْحُرُّ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿بِالْحُرِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to its omitted khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَالْعَبْدُ بِالْعَبْدِ﴾ conjoined, and likewise ﴿وَالْأُنْثى بِالْأُنْثى﴾ is conjoined in the same way. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; من is a jussive-governing conditional noun, mubtadaʾ; it has also been said that it is relative. ﴿عُفِيَ﴾ a passive past verb, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿لَهُ﴾ both attached to the verb عفي. ﴿مِنْ أَخِيهِ﴾ من is a preposition; أخيه is a noun genitive with the yāʾ because it is one of the five nouns, and the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl from شيء.
﴿شَيْءٌ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿فَاتِّباعٌ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). اتباع is a postponed mubtadaʾ and the khabar is omitted, the implied form being "then upon him is following"; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, and the khabar of the mubtadaʾ من is the protasis and its apodosis. ﴿بِالْمَعْرُوفِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the maṣdar أداء. [Translator's note: so in the source; one would expect attachment to اتباع, which immediately precedes it.] ﴿وَأَداءٌ﴾ conjoined to اتباع. ﴿بِإِحْسانٍ﴾ both attached to أداء also. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿تَخْفِيفٌ﴾ its khabar. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to تخفيف. ﴿وَرَحْمَةٌ﴾ conjoined to تخفيف.
﴿فَمَنْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; من is conditional, mubtadaʾ. ﴿اعْتَدى﴾ a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif because of impossibility (taʿadhdhur); it is the protasis, the fāʿil being "huwa" (he). ﴿بَعْدَ﴾ an adverb of time, attached to اعتدى. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿فَلَهُ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis. له: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ.
﴿أَلِيمٌ﴾ ṣifa (adjective); the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of مَن.

daas-irab:179-179.t: ﴿وَلَكُمْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿فِي الْقِصاصِ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿حَياةٌ﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يا أُولِي﴾ يا is a vocative particle; أولي is the one addressed (munādā), muḍāf, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural. ﴿الْأَلْبابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾ لعلّ and its noun (ism). ﴿تَتَّقُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar of لعلّ.

daas-irab:180-180.t:
﴿كُتِبَ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) كتب; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إِذا﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) for future time, attached to the omitted apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), i.e. "let him make a bequest". ﴿حَضَرَ﴾ a past verb.
﴿أَحَدَكُمُ﴾ a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الْمَوْتُ﴾ a postponed fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿إِنْ﴾ a jussive-governing conditional particle. ﴿تَرَكَ﴾ a past verb, the fāʿil being "huwa" (he); it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the apodosis is omitted, its implied form being: "if he leaves wealth, let him make a bequest". ﴿خَيْراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْوَصِيَّةُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of كتب; it has also been said that it is mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿لِلْوالِدَيْنِ﴾ both attached to الوصية. ﴿وَالْأَقْرَبِينَ﴾ conjoined to الوالدين, genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.
﴿بِالْمَعْرُوفِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from الوصية. ﴿حَقًّا﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) confirming the content of the clause before it. ﴿عَلَى الْمُتَّقِينَ﴾ both attached to حقا.

daas-irab:246-246.t: ﴿أَلَمْ﴾: the hamza is interrogative; لم is a particle of negation, jussive mood and conversion (to past meaning). ﴿تَرَ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil (agent) is "you" (anta). ﴿إِلَى الْمَلَإِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb تر. ﴿مِنْ بَنِي﴾: بني is a noun, genitive (majrūr) with yāʾ because it is treated like a sound masculine plural;
