the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from الملأ. ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with fatḥa, a diptote because it is a proper name and foreign. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from بني إسرائيل. ﴿مُوسى﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb for past time, attached to an omitted muḍāf, the implied form being: "Have you not seen the story of the chiefs"; and the clause ﴿قالُوا﴾ is a verbal clause in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِنَبِيٍّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قالوا. ﴿لَهُمُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of نبي. ﴿ابْعَثْ﴾: an imperative verb. ﴿لَنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ابعث. ﴿مَلِكاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿نُقاتِلْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab). ﴿فِي سَبِيلِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نقاتل. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb, and the fāʿil is "he"; the clause is resumptive. ﴿هَلْ﴾: an interrogative particle. ﴿عَسَيْتُمْ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun. ﴿إِنْ﴾: a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive. ﴿كُتِبَ﴾: a passive past verb; it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿عَلَيْكُمُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to كتب. ﴿الْقِتالُ﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being: "then you would not fight". ﴿أن﴾: a maṣdar-particle that makes the verb subjunctive. ﴿لا﴾: negating. ﴿تُقاتِلُوا﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative (subjunctive); and the clause هل عسيتم is the object of the saying. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لَنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَلَّا نُقاتِلَ﴾: the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from an and the verb is in the position of genitive by a preposition, the implied form being: "and what is with us in not fighting"; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿فِي سَبِيلِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نقاتل. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَقَدْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿أُخْرِجْنا﴾: a passive past verb, and نا is the nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ دِيارِنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أخرجنا. ﴿وَأَبْنائِنا﴾: conjoined to ديارنا; the clause is a ḥāl clause. ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; لما is temporal ("when"). ﴿كُتِبَ﴾: a passive past verb. ﴿عَلَيْهِمُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to كتب. ﴿الْقِتالُ﴾: nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿تَوَلَّوْا﴾: a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿أَلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. [Translator's note: so in the source, written ﴿أَلَّا﴾; the verse reads إِلَّا.] ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾: excepted, accusative (manṣūb). ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قليلا. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَلِيمٌ﴾: khabar. ﴿بِالظَّالِمِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to عليم.

daas-irab:247-247.t:
﴿وَقالَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; قال is a past verb. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) قال. ﴿نَبِيُّهُمْ﴾: fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿قَدْ﴾: a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿بَعَثَ لَكُمْ﴾: بعث is a past verb, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿طالُوتَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مَلِكاً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial); and the clause ﴿بَعَثَ﴾ is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar (predicate) of inna; and inna with what follows it is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنَّى﴾: an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as ḥāl. ﴿يَكُونُ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb. ﴿لَهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿الْمُلْكُ﴾: its noun. ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to الملك; and the clause ﴿يَكُونُ﴾ is the object of the saying. ﴿وَنَحْنُ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); نحن is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَحَقُّ﴾: khabar. ﴿بِالْمُلْكِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أحق, and likewise ﴿مِنْهُ﴾; the clause is a ḥāl clause. ﴿وَلَمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لم is a particle of negation, jussive mood and conversion (to past meaning). ﴿يُؤْتَ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter; it is passive, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is "he". ﴿سَعَةً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi, and the latent pronoun is the first object. ﴿مِنَ الْمالِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of سعة; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb, and the fāʿil is "he", referring to their prophet. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿اصْطَفاهُ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa; the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi and the fāʿil is "he"; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اصطفاه. ﴿وَزادَهُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; زاده is a past verb, its fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بَسْطَةً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فِي الْعِلْمِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to بسطة.
﴿وَالْجِسْمِ﴾: conjoined. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; الله, the Name of Majesty, is the mubtadaʾ. ﴿يُؤْتِي﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is "he"; the clause is the khabar. ﴿مُلْكَهُ﴾: first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنَ﴾: a relative noun, second mafʿūl bihi. [Translator's note: so in the source, written ﴿مِنَ﴾; the verse reads مَنْ.] ﴿يَشاءُ﴾: an imperfect verb; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; الله, the Name of Majesty, is the mubtadaʾ. ﴿واسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾: two khabars.

daas-irab:248-248.t: ﴿وَقالَ لَهُمْ نَبِيُّهُمْ﴾: its i'rab preceded in the previous verse. ﴿إِنَّ آيَةَ﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿مُلْكِهِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَنْ يَأْتِيَكُمُ﴾: the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar (predicate) of inna; and the clause ﴿إِنَّ آيَةَ﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿التَّابُوتُ﴾: fāʿil (agent). ﴿فِيهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿سَكِينَةٌ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of سكينة; the clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from التابوت. ﴿وَبَقِيَّةٌ﴾: conjoined to سكينة. ﴿مِمَّا﴾: ما is a relative noun in the position of genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective of بقية. ﴿تَرَكَ آلُ مُوسى﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and the muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَآلُ هارُونَ﴾: conjoined to آل موسى. ﴿تَحْمِلُهُ الْمَلائِكَةُ﴾: an imperfect verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a postponed fāʿil; the clause is a second ḥāl from التابوت. [Translator's note: the source has a stray word "imperfect" (مضارع) at this point.] ﴿إِنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb. ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾: ذا is a demonstrative in the position of genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective of the khabar. ﴿لَآيَةً﴾: and the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar. ﴿إِنَّ﴾: a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive. [Translator's note: so in the source, written ﴿إِنَّ﴾; the conditional particle in the verse is إِنْ.] ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun. ﴿مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: its khabar; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being: "then believe".

daas-irab:249-249.t: ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; لما is adverbial and conditional. ﴿فَصَلَ طالُوتُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿بِالْجُنُودِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) فصل; the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: inna, the Name of Majesty is its noun, and ﴿مُبْتَلِيكُمْ﴾ is its khabar (predicate). ﴿بِنَهَرٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the active participle مبتليكم; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); and the clause ﴿قالَ ... ﴾ is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; من is a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿شَرِبَ﴾: a past verb; it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil is "he". ﴿مِنْهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to شرب. ﴿فَلَيْسَ﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis; ليس is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he". ﴿مِنِّي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar; the clause is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis; and the protasis together with its apodosis is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ من. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; من is conditional, mubtadaʾ. ﴿لَمْ﴾: a particle that makes the verb jussive. ﴿يَطْعَمْهُ﴾: a jussive imperfect verb and its object, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿فَإِنَّهُ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis. ﴿إنه﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿مِنِّي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of inna; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the excepted. ﴿اغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةً﴾: a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بِيَدِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اغترف; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿فَشَرِبُوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; شربوا is a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to شربوا; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾: excepted, accusative. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قليلا. ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; لما is adverbial and conditional. ﴿جاوَزَهُ﴾: a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he", referring to Ṭālūt. ﴿هُوَ﴾: a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of nominative as tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent fāʿil in جاوزه. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, conjoined to هو. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مَعَهُ﴾: attached to آمنوا; and the clause آمنوا is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿لا طاقَةَ﴾: لا is the lā of generic negation; طاقة is its noun, indeclinable on fatḥa. ﴿لَنَا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of lā. ﴿الْيَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time, attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿بِجالُوتَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar; it is genitive with fatḥa because it is a proper name and foreign. ﴿وَجُنُودِهِ﴾: conjoined to جالوت. ﴿قالَ الَّذِينَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿يَظُنُّونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿أَنَّهُمْ﴾: anna and its noun. ﴿مُلاقُوا﴾: khabar, nominative with wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the nūn was dropped for the construct. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كَمْ﴾: predicative (khabariyya), for expressing large number, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿مِنْ فِئَةٍ﴾: من is a redundant (zāʾida) particle. ﴿فِئَةٍ﴾: a noun genitive in form and accusative in position, as tamyīz (specification). ﴿قَلِيلَةٍ﴾: an adjective. ﴿غَلَبَتْ﴾: a past verb, and its fāʿil is "she" (hiya). ﴿فِئَةٍ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كَثِيرَةً﴾: an adjective. ﴿بِإِذْنِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to غلبت. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; الله, the Name of Majesty, is the mubtadaʾ. ﴿مَعَ الصَّابِرِينَ﴾: مع is an adverb, attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿الصَّابِرِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. And anna with what follows it stands in place of the two objects of يظنون.

daas-irab:250-250.t: ﴿وَلَمَّا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لما is adverbial and temporal ("when"). ﴿بَرَزُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿لِجالُوتَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) برزوا. ﴿وَجُنُودِهِ﴾: conjoined to جالوت. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾: the one addressed in the vocative (munādā), in construct, accusative (manṣūb). ﴿أَفْرِغْ﴾: a verb of supplication. ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أفرغ. ﴿صَبْراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَثَبِّتْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ثبت is a verb of supplication. ﴿أَقْدامَنا﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَانْصُرْنا﴾: a verb of supplication and its object. ﴿عَلَى الْقَوْمِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to انصرنا. ﴿الْكافِرِينَ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa).

daas-irab:17-18.t:
﴿المثل﴾ (with fatḥa on the mīm and the thāʾ): a noun deeply immersed in vagueness, meaning "likeness" and "like". ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: its form is singular and its meaning plural; for this reason Allah the Exalted said ﴿ذَهَبَ اللَّهُ بِنُورِهِمْ ... ﴾. «[Translator's note: the source heads this gloss ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾, but the word in the verse and in the i'rab below is الَّذِي.]» ﴿اسْتَوْقَدَ﴾: kindled. أضاء: used both transitively and intransitively. ﴿صُمٌّ﴾: plural of أصم, one who does not hear. ﴿بُكْمٌ﴾: plural of أبكم, the mute. ﴿عُمْيٌ﴾: plural of أعمى (blind).
﴿مَثَلُهُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject); the hāʾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿كَمَثَلِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿اسْتَوْقَدَ﴾: a past verb; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (he), referring back to الذي. ﴿ناراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause استوقد is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The clause مثلهم is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; لما is an adverb meaning "when". ﴿أَضاءَتْ﴾: a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine, and the fāʿil is omitted, its implied form being "هي" (it), referring back to النار. ﴿ما حَوْلَهُ﴾: ما is a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; حوله is an adverb of place attached to an omitted ṣila of ما. Some said that أضاء is an intransitive verb and ما is redundant (zāʾida), i.e. "it lit up around him"; on this view the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) with no grammatical position, or muḍāf ilayhi on the view that ما is adverbial.
﴿ذَهَبَ﴾: a past verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. ﴿بِنُورِهِمْ﴾: both attached to the verb; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَتَرَكَهُمْ﴾: a past verb; the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi, the mīm is for the masculine plural, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو"; the clause is conjoined by the wāw. ﴿فِي ظُلُماتٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لا يُبْصِرُونَ﴾: لا is negative; يبصرون is an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. The clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun functioning as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿صُمٌّ﴾: a first khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هم صم" (they are deaf). ﴿بُكْمٌ﴾: a second khabar, nominative. ﴿عُمْيٌ﴾: a third khabar. The three clauses are resumptive. ﴿فَهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; هم is a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿لا يَرْجِعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. The clause is the khabar of هم, and the nominal clause فهم is conjoined.

daas-irab:19-20.t:
﴿الصيب﴾: rain; its original form is صيوب. Its verb is صاب يصوب.
﴿أَوْ كَصَيِّبٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, conjoined to كمثل. ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of صيب, the implied form being "صيب نازل" (a downpour descending). ﴿فِيهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of ظلمات. ﴿ظُلُماتٌ﴾: a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause is in the position of genitive as a second naʿt of صيب. ﴿وَرَعْدٌ وَبَرْقٌ﴾: both conjoined to ظلمات. ﴿يَجْعَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَصابِعَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فِي آذانِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb, and they are in the position of accusative as a second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنَ الصَّواعِقِ﴾: both attached to يجعلون. ﴿حَذَرَ﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿الْمَوْتِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; الله, the Name of Majesty, is mubtadaʾ. ﴿مُحِيطٌ﴾: its khabar. ﴿بِالْكافِرِينَ﴾: both attached to the khabar. The clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿يَكادُ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb. ﴿الْبَرْقُ﴾: its noun, nominative.
﴿يَخْطَفُ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is "هو" (it), referring back to البرق. The clause is in the position of accusative as the khabar of the defective verb.
﴿أَبْصارَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. The clause يكاد البرق is resumptive. ﴿كُلَّما﴾: كل is a mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of time, accusative; ما is maṣdariyya and is interpreted together with the past verb ﴿أَضاءَ﴾ as a maṣdar in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: both attached to the verb; the clause أضاء is the ṣila of a particle relative (mawṣūl ḥarfī), with no grammatical position. ﴿مَشَوْا﴾: parsed like خلوا; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿فِيهِ﴾: both attached to مشوا. ﴿وَإِذا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إذا is an adverb for future time, putting its condition in the genitive and accusative by its apodosis. ﴿أَظْلَمَ﴾: a past verb; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun referring back to البرق; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: both attached to أظلم. ﴿قامُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. The clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. لو is a particle of impossibility because of impossibility (ḥarf imtināʿ li-mtināʿ). ﴿شاءَ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. The clause شاء is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿لَذَهَبَ﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis; ذهب is a past verb, and the fāʿil is "هو" (He), referring back to Allah. ﴿بِسَمْعِهِمْ﴾: both attached to the verb ذهب. ﴿وَأَبْصارِهِمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أبصارهم is a conjoined noun. ﴿إِنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb (one of inna and its sisters). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, its noun, accusative. «[Translator's note: the source prints the word with a ḍamma (﴿اللَّهُ﴾) although it parses it as accusative; in the verse it is اللَّهَ.]» ﴿عَلى كُلِّ﴾: both attached to the delayed active participle قدير.
﴿شَيْءٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قَدِيرٌ﴾: khabar, nominative with ḍamma. The clause لذهب is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position.
The clause إن الله likewise has no grammatical position, because it is a causal (taʿlīliyya) clause.

daas-irab:21-22.t:
﴿أنداد﴾: plural of ند, which is "a like, an equal". ﴿يا﴾: a vocative particle. ﴿أي﴾: the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of accusative as a vocative. ﴿وها﴾: a particle of drawing attention. ﴿النَّاسُ﴾: a badal (substitute) from أي, nominative following the form. ﴿اعْبُدُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn because it is attached to the wāw of the plural, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿رَبَّكُمُ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the kāf is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective). ﴿خَلَقَكُمْ﴾: خلق is a past verb, and its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (He); the kāf is mafʿūl bihi, and the mīm is for the masculine plural. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of accusative, conjoined to the pronoun kāf in the verb خلقكم; the implied form is "وخلق الذين" (and He created those who). The clause خلقكم is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila; the implied form is "وخلق الذين عاشوا من قبلكم" (and He created those who lived before you). ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾: لعل is a particle resembling the verb. The kāf is an attached pronoun, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of accusative as its noun, and the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural. ﴿تَتَّقُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of لعل. The clause لعلكم تتقون is causal (taʿlīliyya), and some allowed it to be a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative as a naʿt of ربكم. ﴿جَعَلَ﴾: a past verb, and the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "هو". ﴿لَكُمُ﴾: both attached to جعل. ﴿الْأَرْضَ﴾: first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فِراشاً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. The clause جعل is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. فراشا may also be parsed as a ḥāl if جعل has the meaning of صيّر (made into). «[Translator's note: so in the source; the usual statement is the reverse — فراشا is a ḥāl when جعل means "created" (خلق), and a second object when it means صيّر.]»
﴿وَالسَّماءَ بِناءً﴾: both conjoined to الأرض [and فراشا]. «[Translator's note: "and فراشا" is added for clarity; the source says only "conjoined to الأرض".]» ﴿وَأَنْزَلَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. أنزل is a past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو". ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾: both attached to أنزل. ﴿ماءً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَأَخْرَجَ﴾: a past verb conjoined to أنزل.
﴿بِهِ﴾: both attached to أخرج. Likewise ﴿مِنَ الثَّمَراتِ﴾: both attached to أخرج, or to an omitted ḥāl from رزق. ﴿رِزْقاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لَكُمُ﴾: both attached to an omitted naʿt of رزق. من الثمرات was attached to an omitted ḥāl because it was originally a naʿt [and was fronted before its noun].
﴿فَلا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, on the view that conjoining a performative (inshāʾ) to a declarative (khabar) is permissible. لا is the prohibitive lā that makes the verb jussive. ﴿تَجْعَلُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. The clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive by the lām; both are attached to a ḥāl from أندادا, or to the verb تجعلوا. ﴿أَنْداداً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. The clause of the implied condition is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), with no grammatical position.
﴿وَأَنْتُمْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). أنتم is a detached nominative pronoun, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿تَعْلَمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil. The clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ أنتم, and the nominal clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.

daas-irab:23-24.t:
﴿الريب﴾: doubt. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إن is conditional and jussive, making two imperfect verbs jussive. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb [one of kāna and its sisters] in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is its noun. The clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿فِي رَيْبٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of كان. ﴿مِمَّا﴾: its original form is من ما; ما is a relative noun in the position of genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the maṣdar ريب. ﴿نَزَّلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). The clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿عَلى عَبْدِنا﴾: both attached to the verb نزلنا; its returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, the implied form being "نزلناه" (We sent it down). ﴿فَأْتُوا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis. أتوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. The clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿بِسُورَةٍ﴾: both attached to the verb فأتوا. ﴿مِنْ مِثْلِهِ﴾: both attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of سورة; the hāʾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَادْعُوا﴾: like ﴿اعْبُدُوا﴾.
﴿شُهَداءَكُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the kāf is in the position of genitive by annexation, and the mīm is for the masculine plural. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb ادعوا, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from شهداءكم, the implied form being "منفردين عن الله" (apart from Allah). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ﴾: its i'rab is as in the first verse. ﴿صادِقِينَ﴾: khabar of كان, accusative with the yāʾ. The apodosis is omitted, its implied form being "فأتوا بها" (then bring it) ... ﴿فَإِنْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; ﴿إن﴾ is conditional. ﴿لَمْ تَفْعَلُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs, and the wāw is the fāʿil. The clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position.
﴿وَلَنْ﴾: the wāw is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya); لن is a particle making the verb subjunctive. ﴿تَفْعَلُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by the dropping of the nūn. The clause is initial, with no grammatical position. «[Translator's note: so in the source; having called the wāw parenthetical, the clause would ordinarily be described as a parenthetical clause with no grammatical position.]» ﴿فَاتَّقُوا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis; اتقوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn because it is attached to the wāw of the plural, and the wāw is the fāʿil. The clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿النَّارَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
﴿الَّتِي﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative as a naʿt. ﴿وَقُودُهَا﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject); the hāʾ is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿النَّاسُ﴾: khabar. ﴿وَالْحِجارَةُ﴾: a noun conjoined to الناس. The clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿أُعِدَّتْ﴾: a passive past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هي" (it). ﴿لِلْكافِرِينَ﴾: both attached to the verb أعدت.
The clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl from النار; it is also said to be resumptive.

daas-irab:97-98.t:
﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "you". ﴿مَنْ﴾ a jussive conditional noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كانَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun referring to man; it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿عَدُوًّا﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿لِجِبْرِيلَ﴾ جبريل is a noun, genitive (majrūr) with the fatḥa in place of the kasra because it is a foreign proper name; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective of عدو. The clause قل is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The clause من is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), and the apodosis of the condition is omitted, its implied form being "whoever is an enemy to Jibrīl, let him do what he wishes, for he has brought it down". ﴿فَإِنَّهُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction joining to the omitted apodosis; إنه is inna and its noun. ﴿نَزَّلَهُ﴾ a past verb, the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun implied as "he", referring to the Book. [Translator's note: so in the source; the commentators usually take the subject of نزّله as Jibrīl and its object as the Qur'an.]
The clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿عَلى قَلْبِكَ﴾ attached to the verb نزل, and likewise ﴿بِإِذْنِ﴾. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿مُصَدِّقاً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative. ﴿لِما﴾ mā is a relative noun in the position of genitive by the lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to مصدقا. ﴿بَيْنَ﴾ an adverb of place attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause). ﴿يَدَيْهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the yāʾ because it is a dual; the nūn has been dropped for the iḍāfa.
﴿وَهُدىً وَبُشْرى﴾ two nouns conjoined to مصدقا, accusative with the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa. ﴿لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ a noun genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to one of the two preceding maṣdars, or to an omitted adjective of them. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿كانَ﴾ a defective past verb; its noun is a latent pronoun; it is the protasis. ﴿عَدُوًّا﴾ its khabar. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, genitive by the lām, and they are attached to an omitted adjective of عدو. ﴿وَمَلائِكَتِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ وَجِبْرِيلَ وَمِيكالَ﴾ nouns conjoined to the Name of Majesty الله, genitive like it; جبريل and ميكال are made genitive with the fatḥa in place of the kasra because they are foreign proper names; see the previous verse. ﴿فَإِنَّ﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis of the condition; it is also said that the apodosis is omitted and the conjunction is onto that omitted apodosis. ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ عَدُوٌّ﴾ inna, the Name of Majesty is its noun, and عدو is its khabar. ﴿لِلْكافِرِينَ﴾ attached to an omitted adjective of عدو; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), or conjoined to it.

daas-irab:99-101.t:
﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; the lām occurs in the response to an omitted oath; qad is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿أَنْزَلْنا﴾ a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and نا is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنزلنا. ﴿آياتٍ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra in place of the fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural; the preposition and its genitive noun إليك are attached to the verb أنزلنا. ﴿بَيِّناتٍ﴾ an adjective of آيات, accusative. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction or circumstantial; mā is negative. ﴿يَكْفُرُ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿بِها﴾ attached to يكفر. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿الْفاسِقُونَ﴾ fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural. The clause is conjoined to the response of the oath; it is also said to be circumstantial. ﴿أَوَكُلَّما﴾ the hamza is for disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī); the wāw is a conjunction; كلما is a mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of time containing the sense of a condition. ﴿عاهَدُوا﴾ a past verb indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿عَهْداً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi of the verb عاهدوا; the first object is omitted, its implied form being "they made a covenant with Allah". It is also said to be a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf).
﴿نَبَذَهُ﴾ a past verb, and the hāʾ is a fronted mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَرِيقٌ﴾ a postponed fāʿil. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ attached to an adjective of فريق.
The clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of the condition. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction. ﴿أَكْثَرُهُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject); هم is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ lā is negative; يؤمنون is an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. The nominal clause is conjoined to the one before it. ﴿وَلَمَّا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; لما is adverbial (ẓarfiyya) in the sense of "when" (ḥīniyya).
﴿جاءَهُمْ﴾ a past verb, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿رَسُولٌ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿مِنْ عِنْدِ﴾ attached to an omitted adjective of رسول. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مُصَدِّقٌ﴾ an adjective of رسول. ﴿لَمَّا﴾ a relative noun in the position of genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to مصدق. [Translator's note: the source parses لِما (lām + mā) under this heading.] ﴿مَعَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of place attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿نَبَذَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿فَرِيقٌ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿مِنَ الَّذِينَ﴾ attached to فريق or to an adjective of it.
﴿أُوتُوا﴾ a passive past verb indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi of the verb أوتوا. ﴿كِتابَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi of the verb نبذ. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَراءَ﴾ mafʿūl fīhi, an adverb of place attached to the verb نبذ; it is also said to be a second mafʿūl bihi, on the basis that نبذ is made to carry the sense of جعل ("made"). ﴿ظُهُورِهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the hāʾ is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa, and the mīm is for the masculine plural. The clause نبذ is the apodosis of a condition, with no grammatical position, and the clause أوتوا الكتاب has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿كَأَنَّهُمْ﴾ كأن and its noun. ﴿لا يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كأن, and the clause كأنهم is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

daas-irab:102-102.t:
﴿وَاتَّبَعُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; اتبعوا is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿تَتْلُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the wāw due to heaviness. ﴿الشَّياطِينُ﴾ fāʿil.
﴿عَلى مُلْكِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) تتلو. ﴿سُلَيْمانَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the fatḥa in place of the kasra, a diptote because of being a proper name and the added alif and nūn; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, its implied form being "what they recite (it)". ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is circumstantial; mā is negative. ﴿كَفَرَ سُلَيْمانُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿وَلكِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb (ḥarf mushabbah bi-l-fiʿl) conveying rectification (istidrāk). ﴿الشَّياطِينُ﴾ its noun. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of lākinna. ﴿يُعَلِّمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿النَّاسَ﴾ first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿السِّحْرَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; mā is a relative noun conjoined to السحر. The clause يعلمون is circumstantial, and it is also said to be a second khabar. ﴿أُنْزِلَ﴾ a passive past verb, and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is "it". ﴿عَلَى الْمَلَكَيْنِ﴾ attached to the verb أنزل.
﴿بِبابِلَ﴾ بابل is a noun genitive with the fatḥa instead of the kasra, a diptote because of being a proper name and foreign; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb أنزل or to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الملكين. ﴿هارُوتَ وَمارُوتَ﴾ a badal (substitute) of الملكين, genitive with the fatḥa in place of the kasra, diptotes because of being proper names and foreign. It is also said to be ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition), because it is clearer than it. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive; mā is negative. ﴿يُعَلِّمانِ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs, and the alif is the fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ أَحَدٍ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and min is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya) and a preposition. ﴿يَقُولا﴾ an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by an implied an after حتى; the sign of its subjunctive is the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs, and the alif is the fāʿil. The implied an with the verb is interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of genitive by the preposition, and they are attached to the verb يعلمان. ﴿إِنَّما﴾ the restraining (kāffa) and restrained (makfūfa) particles.
﴿نَحْنُ فِتْنَةٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar. The clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa, because it discloses a condition, the implied form being "since we have taught you, then do not disbelieve"; lā is the jussive lā of prohibition. ﴿تَكْفُرْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the fāʿil is "you"; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of an implied condition. ﴿فَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; يتعلمون is an imperfect verb nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "they learn". ﴿مِنْهُما﴾ attached to the verb before them. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يُفَرِّقُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِهِ﴾ attached to يفرقون. ﴿بَيْنَ﴾ mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of place attached to the verb. ﴿الْمَرْءِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَزَوْجِهِ﴾ conjoined. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is circumstantial; mā is the Ḥijāzī mā that operates like laysa. ﴿هُمْ﴾ a detached pronoun, its noun. ﴿بِضارِّينَ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant preposition; ضارين is a noun genitive in form with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural, and accusative in position because it is the khabar of mā. The clause is circumstantial. ﴿بِهِ﴾ attached to ضارين. ﴿مِنْ أَحَدٍ﴾ min is a redundant preposition; أحد is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position as the mafʿūl bihi of the active participle ضارين. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿بِإِذْنِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl of the latent (mustatir) pronoun in the active participle ضارين, or to an omitted ḥāl of the object أحد. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿وَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَضُرُّهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "it"; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, and the clause ﴿وَلا يَنْفَعُهُمْ﴾ is conjoined to it. ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; the lām occurs in the response to an oath; qad is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿عَلِمُوا﴾ a past verb indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the response to the oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَمَنِ﴾ the lām is the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ); man is a relative noun indeclinable on the sukūn in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ.
﴿اشْتَراهُ﴾ a past verb indeclinable on the implied fatḥa; the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi and the fāʿil is "he"; the clause has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿ما﴾ negative; it is also said to be Ḥijāzī. ﴿لَهُ﴾ attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿فِي الْآخِرَةِ﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl of خلاق, because they have been placed before it. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant preposition. ﴿خَلاقٍ﴾ a noun genitive in form and nominative in position as a postponed mubtadaʾ. The clause ماله is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿لَمَنِ اشْتَراهُ﴾ stands in place of the two objects of علموا, which is suspended (muʿallaq) from operating because of the lām of inception. ﴿وَلَبِئْسَ ما شَرَوْا بِهِ أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is for the oath. بئس is a non-inflecting (jāmid) past verb for creating blame (inshāʾ al-dhamm); the i'rab of what resembles it preceded at verse 90. ﴿لَوْ﴾ a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿كانُوا﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw is its noun. ﴿يُعَلِّمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. [Translator's note: so in the source, though the Qur'anic word here is يَعْلَمُونَ.] The clause is in the position of accusative as the khabar of كانوا, and the apodosis of law is omitted, its implied form being "had they known that, they would not have practised magic".

daas-irab:103-104.t:
﴿راعِنا﴾ grant us respite. ﴿انْظُرْنا﴾ give us time. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; law is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿أَنَّهُمْ﴾ a particle resembling the verb (ḥarf mushabbah bi-l-fiʿl); the hāʾ is its noun and the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of anna, and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿وَاتَّقَوْا﴾ conjoined to آمنوا. Anna with its noun and its khabar is interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and the khabar is omitted, its implied form being "if their belief were established"; or it is in the position of nominative as the fāʿil of an omitted verb, its implied form being "if their belief were sound". ﴿لَمَثُوبَةٌ﴾ the lām occurs in the apodosis of the condition, or is the lām of inception (ibtidāʾ); مثوبة is a nominative mubtadaʾ, and beginning with an indefinite is permitted because it has been qualified. ﴿مِنْ عِنْدِ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective of مثوبة. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿خَيْرٌ﴾ the khabar of مثوبة. The nominal clause is the apodosis of the condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَوْ كانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ its i'rab has preceded in the previous verse. ﴿يا أَيُّهَا﴾ yā is a vocative particle; ayy is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda) indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, and the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, badal (substitute) of ayy. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿لا تَقُولُوا﴾ lā is the jussive lā of prohibition; تقولوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by dropping the nūn because it is one of the five verbs, and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause has no grammatical position, being initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿راعِنا﴾ an imperative verb indeclinable on dropping the weak letter, which is the yāʾ, the kasra being an indication of it; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as "you", and نا is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَقُولُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; قولوا is an imperative verb indeclinable on dropping the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. The clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿انْظُرْنا﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil is "you", and نا is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a mafʿūl bihi, the object of the saying. ﴿وَاسْمَعُوا﴾ an imperative and its fāʿil, and its object is omitted, its implied form being "and listen to the speech of your Messenger"; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَلِلْكافِرِينَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; للكافرين is attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَلِيمٌ﴾ an adjective, nominative; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:105-105.t:
﴿ما يَوَدُّ﴾ mā is negative; يود is an imperfect verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent). ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿مِنْ أَهْلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of الذين كفروا. ﴿الْكِتابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وَلَا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; lā is redundant (zāʾida), for negation. ﴿الْمُشْرِكِينَ﴾ conjoined to أهل, genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle. ﴿يُنَزَّلَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb); أن and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb يود. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ attached to ينزل. ﴿مِنْ خَيْرٍ﴾ min is a redundant preposition; خير is a noun genitive in form and nominative in position as the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of the verb ينزل. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ﴾ attached to خير or to an omitted adjective of it. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; الله, the Name of Majesty, is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَخْتَصُّ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is "He"; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿بِرَحْمَتِهِ﴾ attached to the verb before them. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a relative noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. [Translator's note: the word is مَنْ.] ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is "He", referring to Allah; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; الله, the Name of Majesty, is mubtadaʾ.
﴿ذُو﴾ khabar, nominative with the wāw because it is one of the five nouns. ﴿الْفَضْلِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْعَظِيمِ﴾ an adjective of الفضل.

daas-irab:106-107.t:
﴿ما﴾ a jussive conditional noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb ننسخ. ﴿نَنْسَخْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) with the sukūn; it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil (agent) is "we". ﴿مِنْ آيَةٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of mā, the meaning being "whatever thing of the verses We abrogate"; it is also said they are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of mā; and some said min is redundant (zāʾida) and آية is tamyīz (specification). The clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿نُنْسِها﴾ an imperfect verb conjoined to ننسخ, jussive like it, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the yāʾ; the fāʿil is implied as "we", and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to the clause ننسخ. ﴿نَأْتِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive by dropping the yāʾ because it is the apodosis of the condition, and the fāʿil is "we". ﴿بِخَيْرٍ﴾ attached to the verb before them. ﴿مِنْها﴾ attached to the elative (ism al-tafḍīl) خير. ﴿أَوْ مِثْلِها﴾ a noun conjoined to خير. The clause نأت has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a jussive condition not joined by the fāʾ or the إذا of surprise. ﴿أَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation; lam is a particle of jussive, negation and conversion (qalb, i.e. to the past). ﴿تَعْلَمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive. ﴿أَنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb (ḥarf mushabbah bi-l-fiʿl). ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its noun. ﴿عَلى كُلِّ﴾ attached to قدير. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿قَدِيرٌ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of anna; anna and what it governs stand in place of the two objects of تعلم. The clause ألم تعلم is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَهُ مُلْكُ﴾ له is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; ملك is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to السموات.
﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; mā is negative. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl of ولي, or to the omitted khabar. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. ﴿مِنْ وَلِيٍّ﴾ a noun genitive in form and nominative in position as mubtadaʾ. [Translator's note: the source does not separately mention that min here is redundant.] ﴿وَلا نَصِيرٍ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; lā is negative; نصير is a noun conjoined to ولي.

daas-irab:251-251.t:
﴿فَهَزَمُوهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; هزموهم is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بِإِذْنِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined to an omitted clause, the implied form being: "the two armies fought, and they defeated them". ﴿وَقَتَلَ داوُدُ جالُوتَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَآتاهُ﴾: a past verb and its object. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, its fāʿil.
﴿الْمُلْكَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَالْحِكْمَةَ﴾: conjoined to الملك; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَعَلَّمَهُ﴾: a past verb and its object. ﴿مِمَّا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to علمه. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾: an imperfect verb; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَلَوْلا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; لولا is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿دَفْعُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿النَّاسَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi of the maṣdar (verbal noun). ﴿بَعْضَهُمْ﴾: بعض is a badal (substitute) from الناس. ﴿بِبَعْضٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to دفع. ﴿لَفَسَدَتِ﴾: the lām occurs in the answer of لولا. ﴿فسدت الْأَرْضُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, being the answer of لولا. ﴿وَلكِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: lākinna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿ذُو﴾: its khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) with wāw because it is one of the five nouns. ﴿فَضْلٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلَى الْعالَمِينَ﴾: a noun genitive (majrūr) with yāʾ because it is treated like a sound masculine plural; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to فضل; and the clause ﴿وَلكِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ is resumptive.

daas-irab:252-252.t: ﴿تِلْكَ﴾: a demonstrative, in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿آياتُ﴾: khabar (predicate). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿نَتْلُوها﴾: an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) نتلوها. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as ḥāl. ﴿وَإِنَّكَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; inna and its noun. ﴿لَمِنَ﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). ﴿من الْمُرْسَلِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:253-253.t:
﴿تِلْكَ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الرُّسُلُ﴾: badal (substitute) from تلك. ﴿فَضَّلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿بَعْضَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿عَلى بَعْضٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) فضلنا; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ تلك. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative noun, in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ. ﴿كَلَّمَ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; the resumptive pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, its implied form being: "Allah spoke to him". ﴿وَرَفَعَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿رَفَعَ بَعْضَهُمْ﴾: a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "he". ﴿دَرَجاتٍ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَآتَيْنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and آتينا is a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عِيسَى﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ابْنَ﴾: badal from عيسى. ﴿مَرْيَمَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْبَيِّناتِ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿وَأَيَّدْناهُ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِرُوحِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أيدنا. ﴿الْقُدُسِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; لو is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿شاءَ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil. ﴿مَا اقْتَتَلَ الَّذِينَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and ما is negating. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause); the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اقتتل. ﴿مَا﴾: the maṣdar-particle. ﴿جاءَتْهُمُ﴾: a verb and its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْبَيِّناتِ﴾: fāʿil; and the maṣdar-particle ما with the verb is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلكِنِ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk). ﴿اخْتَلَفُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿فَمِنْهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle; منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿آمَنَ﴾: a past verb, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun.
﴿وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ كَفَرَ﴾: its i'rab is like the preceding one, and it is conjoined to it. ﴿وَلَوْ شاءَ اللَّهُ مَا اقْتَتَلُوا﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿وَلكِنِ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; لكن is a particle resembling the verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, its noun. ﴿يَفْعَلُ﴾: an imperfect verb; the clause is the khabar of lākinna. ﴿ما يُرِيدُ﴾: ما is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يُرِيدُ﴾: an imperfect verb; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun.

daas-irab:254-254.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا﴾: يا is the vocative particle; أي is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma in the position of accusative (manṣūb), and the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, badal (substitute) from أيها. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿أَنْفِقُوا﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مِمَّا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنفقوا. ﴿رَزَقْناكُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun; and the clause أنفقوا is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أنفقوا. ﴿أَنْ يَأْتِيَ﴾: the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَوْمٌ﴾: fāʿil. ﴿لا بَيْعٌ﴾: لا is the lā of generic negation, which makes the noun accusative and the predicate nominative, but it does not operate here because it is repeated; and بيع is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فِيهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿وَلا خُلَّةٌ﴾: conjoined to لا بيع. ﴿وَلا شَفاعَةٌ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَالْكافِرُونَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; الكافرون is mubtadaʾ. ﴿هُمُ﴾: a second mubtadaʾ. ﴿الظَّالِمُونَ﴾: khabar of the second mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is the khabar of the first mubtadaʾ.

daas-irab:255-255.t: ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لا﴾: the lā of generic negation. ﴿إِلهَ﴾: its noun. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿هُوَ﴾: badal (substitute) from the position of lā and its noun; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ الله. ﴿الْحَيُّ﴾: a second khabar. ﴿الْقَيُّومُ﴾: a third khabar; or the two are adjectives of الله. ﴿لا تَأْخُذُهُ﴾: لا is negating; تأخذه is an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿سِنَةٌ﴾: fāʿil (agent). ﴿وَلا نَوْمٌ﴾: conjoined to سنة; the clause is resumptive or a khabar. ﴿لَهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted element in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as a fronted khabar. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَما فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: conjoined to ما في السموات. ﴿مَنْ ذَا﴾: من is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿ذَا﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of nominative as khabar. ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun, an adjective or a badal. ﴿يَشْفَعُ﴾: an imperfect verb; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿عِنْدَهُ﴾: an adverb of place, attached to يشفع. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction. ﴿بِإِذْنِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿يَعْلَمُ ما﴾: an imperfect verb, and a relative noun as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بَيْنَ﴾: an adverb of place, attached to an omitted ṣila. ﴿أَيْدِيهِمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with an implied (muqaddar) kasra on the yāʾ. ﴿وَما﴾: conjoined to the first ما. ﴿خَلْفَهُمْ﴾: an adverb of place, likewise attached to the omitted ṣila. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is negating. ﴿يُحِيطُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِشَيْءٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before them. ﴿مِنْ عِلْمِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of شيء. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction. ﴿بِما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted badal from شيء; and the clause ﴿شاءَ﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّماواتِ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَالْأَرْضَ﴾: conjoined to السموات. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is negating. ﴿يَؤُدُهُ حِفْظُهُما﴾: an imperfect verb, its object and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; هو is mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْعَلِيُّ﴾: first khabar. ﴿الْعَظِيمُ﴾: second khabar.

daas-irab:256-257.t: ﴿لا إِكْراهَ﴾: لا is the lā of generic negation; إكراه is its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa. ﴿فِي الدِّينِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿قَدْ تَبَيَّنَ الرُّشْدُ﴾: قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq), and an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent). [Translator's note: so in the source; تبيّن is a past verb.] ﴿مِنَ الْغَيِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from الرشد, or to تبين. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; من is a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَكْفُرْ﴾: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm). ﴿بِالطَّاغُوتِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يكفر. ﴿وَيُؤْمِنْ بِاللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يؤمن; the clause is conjoined to يكفر. ﴿فَقَدِ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); قد is a particle of verification. ﴿اسْتَمْسَكَ بِالْعُرْوَةِ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿الْوُثْقى﴾: an adjective (ṣifa); the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿لَا انْفِصامَ لَها﴾: the lā of generic negation; انفصام is its noun, and لها is attached to the omitted khabar; the clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as ḥāl. ﴿وَاللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾: the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ, and its two khabars; the clause is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya) or resumptive. ﴿اللَّهُ وَلِيُّ﴾: the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ, and its khabar. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿يُخْرِجُهُمْ مِنَ الظُّلُماتِ إِلَى النُّورِ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the two prepositional phrases are attached, and its fāʿil is "he"; the clause is in the position of accusative as ḥāl. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿أَوْلِياؤُهُمُ الطَّاغُوتُ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ الذين. ﴿يُخْرِجُونَهُمْ مِنَ النُّورِ إِلَى الظُّلُماتِ﴾: like the preceding يخرجونهم of the verse, except that the wāw is the fāʿil. [Translator's note: so in the source; the preceding verb in the verse is يُخْرِجُهُمْ.] ﴿أُولئِكَ أَصْحابُ النَّارِ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar, and النار is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿هُمْ فِيها خالِدُونَ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar خالدون; the clause is a ḥāl clause.

daas-irab:25-25.t:
﴿وَبَشِّرِ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; بشر is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, vowelled with kasra to prevent the meeting of two quiescent letters; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت" (you). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿وَعَمِلُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿الصَّالِحاتِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative with kasra in place of fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿أَنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb (one of inna and its sisters). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of أنّ. ﴿جَنَّاتٍ﴾: its noun, accusative with kasra. ﴿تَجْرِي﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ because of heaviness. ﴿مِنْ تَحْتِهَا﴾: both attached to the verb تجري. ﴿الْأَنْهارُ﴾: fāʿil, nominative. The clause تجري is in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of جنات. أنّ and what follows it are, by interpretation, a maṣdar in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition ... ﴿كُلَّما﴾: كل is a mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of time; ما is maṣdariyya. ﴿رُزِقُوا﴾: a passive past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The clause has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of a particle relative (mawṣūl ḥarfī). ﴿مِنْها﴾: both attached to رزقوا. ﴿مِنْ ثَمَرَةٍ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are a badal (substitute) from His saying ﴿مِنْها﴾. ما and the verb رزقوا after it are, by interpretation, a maṣdar in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿رِزْقاً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi.
The first object is the nāʾib fāʿil in the verb رزقوا. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. The clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. ﴿هذَا﴾: the hāʾ is for drawing attention; ذا is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun, khabar. The nominal clause is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿رُزِقْنا﴾: a passive past verb, and نا is the nāʾib fāʿil. The clause رزقنا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, its implied form being "رزقناه" (we were provided with it). ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾: من is a preposition; قبل is an adverb, indeclinable on ḍamma because it is cut off from annexation, in the position of genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb رزقنا. ﴿وَأُتُوا﴾: the wāw is resumptive. أتوا is a passive past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿بِهِ﴾: both attached to the verb before them. ﴿مُتَشابِهاً﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative. The clause أتوا is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿وَلَهُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لهم: both attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿فِيها﴾: both attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿أَزْواجٌ﴾: a delayed mubtadaʾ. ﴿مُطَهَّرَةٌ﴾: a naʿt of أزواج.
The clause is conjoined. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; هم is a detached nominative pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِيها﴾: both attached to the khabar خالدون. ﴿خالِدُونَ﴾: khabar; the nominal clause هم فيها خالدون is conjoined.

daas-irab:26-27.t: ﴿إِنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb (one of inna and its sisters). ﴿اللَّهَ﴾: the Name of Majesty, its noun, accusative. ﴿لا يَسْتَحْيِي﴾: لا is negative; يستحيي is an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ because of heaviness, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (He). The clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. ﴿أَنْ يَضْرِبَ﴾: أن is a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle; يضرب is an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb). أن and what follows it are, by interpretation, a maṣdar in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, the implied form being "من ضرب مثل" (from striking a parable); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو". ﴿مَثَلًا ما بَعُوضَةً﴾: there are several views on its i'rab, perhaps the easiest of which is: مثلا is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ما is a naʿt (adjective); بعوضة is a badal (substitute) from مثلا, accusative. ﴿فَما﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ما is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of accusative because it is conjoined to بعوضة. ﴿فَوْقَها﴾: mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of place attached to an omitted ṣila of ما. ﴿فَأَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; أما is a particle of condition, detailing and emphasis. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. The clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿فَيَعْلَمُونَ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis; يعلمون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. The clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿أَنَّهُ﴾: a particle resembling the verb, and the hāʾ is its noun. ﴿الْحَقُّ﴾: its khabar. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from الحق, the implied form being "منزلا من ربهم" (sent down from their Lord). أنّ with its noun and khabar takes the place of the two objects of يعلمون. ﴿وَأَمَّا﴾: like the first أما. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. The clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿فَيَقُولُونَ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis; يقولون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. The clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿ماذا﴾: an interrogative noun, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; or ما is an interrogative noun and ذا is a relative noun, the khabar. ﴿أَرادَ﴾: a past verb. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. «[Translator's note: the source prints the word with a fatḥa (﴿اللَّهَ﴾) although it parses it as fāʿil; in the verse it is اللَّهُ.]» ﴿بِهذا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to أراد. ﴿مَثَلًا﴾: tamyīz (specification), accusative with fatḥa. The clause ﴿أَرادَ اللَّهُ﴾ is in the position of nominative as khabar. The clause ماذا أراد الله is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿يُضِلُّ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو". ﴿بِهِ﴾: both attached to يضل. ﴿كَثِيراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative. The clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَيَهْدِي بِهِ كَثِيراً﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and its i'rab is like the preceding one. The clause is conjoined. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ما is negative. ﴿يُضِلُّ﴾: an imperfect verb. ﴿بِهِ﴾: both attached to يضل. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿الْفاسِقِينَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the yāʾ. The clause is resumptive. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of accusative as a naʿt of الفاسقين. ﴿يَنْقُضُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿عَهْدَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. The clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾: both attached to ينقضون. ﴿مِيثاقِهِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَيَقْطَعُونَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; يقطعون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿ما أَمَرَ﴾: ما is a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; أمر is a past verb. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. «[Translator's note: the source prints the word with a kasra (﴿اللَّهِ﴾) although it parses it as fāʿil; in the verse it is اللَّهُ.]» ﴿بِهِ﴾: both attached to أمر. ﴿أَنْ﴾: a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle. ﴿يُوصَلَ﴾: an imperfect verb, subjunctive, passive. The nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (it). أن and what follows it are, by interpretation, a maṣdar that is a badal from the pronoun in به; it is also said to be a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), the implied form being "كراهية أن يوصل" (out of dislike that it be joined). ﴿وَيُفْسِدُونَ﴾: like يقطعون. The clause is conjoined. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: both attached to يفسدون. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿هُمُ﴾: a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الْخاسِرُونَ﴾: khabar of the mubtadaʾ. The nominal clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa).

daas-irab:28-29.t:
﴿كَيْفَ﴾: an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿تَكْفُرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
The clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive by the bāʾ; both are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تكفرون. ﴿وَكُنْتُمْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and قد is implied before the past verb كنتم, which is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb [one of kāna and its sisters]; the tāʾ is its noun, and the mīm is for the plural. ﴿أَمْواتاً﴾: its khabar (predicate).
The clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿فَأَحْياكُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; أحياكم is a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (He). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿يُمِيتُكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "هو". ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿يُحْيِيكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object; the mīm is for the plural, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction.
﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾: both attached to the verb after it, ﴿تُرْجَعُونَ﴾; the clause is conjoined. ﴿هُوَ﴾: a detached nominative pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of nominative as khabar. The nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿خَلَقَ﴾: a past verb, and its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "هو". ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: both attached to خلق. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: both attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, its implied form being "ما يسخر في الأرض" (what is made subservient in the earth). ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾: a ḥāl from the relative noun ما. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿اسْتَوى﴾: a past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو", referring back to Allah the Exalted. The clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِلَى السَّماءِ﴾: both attached to استوى. ﴿فَسَوَّاهُنَّ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿سوى﴾ is a past verb, indeclinable on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa; the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and the nūn denotes the feminine plural. The clause is conjoined. ﴿سَبْعَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi of سوى, taking it in the sense of صيّر (made into); if it has the meaning of خلق (created), it is a ḥāl. ﴿سَماواتٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَهُوَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; هو is a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿بِكُلِّ﴾: both attached to the khabar عليم. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَلِيمٌ﴾: khabar.

daas-irab:30-30.t:
جاعل: creating. التقديس: declaring the Creator free of whatever is unbefitting of Him.
﴿وَإِذْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إذ is an adverb of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb اذكر (remember). It is also said to be mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the omitted verb اذكر. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb. ﴿رَبُّكَ﴾: fāʿil (agent), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لِلْمَلائِكَةِ﴾: both attached to the verb قال. The clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿إِنِّي﴾: إنّ is a particle resembling the verb (one of inna and its sisters), and the yāʾ is its noun. ﴿جاعِلٌ﴾: its khabar (predicate). ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the active participle جاعل. ﴿خَلِيفَةً﴾: mafʿūl bihi of the active participle جاعل. The nominal clause is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya).
﴿أَتَجْعَلُ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; تجعل is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت" (you). ﴿فِيها﴾: both attached to the verb before them, or in the position of accusative as the first mafʿūl bihi if تجعل has the meaning of تصيّر (make into). ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi. The clause is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl. ﴿يُفْسِدُ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is "هو" (he). The clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿فِيها﴾: both attached to يفسد. ﴿وَيَسْفِكُ﴾: conjoined to يفسد. ﴿الدِّماءَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَنَحْنُ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); نحن is a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿نُسَبِّحُ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "نحن" (we). The clause نسبح is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. The nominal clause نحن نسبح is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿بِحَمْدِكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl, the implied form being "متلبسين بحمدك" (engaged in Your praise).
﴿وَنُقَدِّسُ﴾: an imperfect verb conjoined to نسبح. ﴿لَكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to نقدس; it is also said that the kāf is mafʿūl bihi and the lām redundant (zāʾida). ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (He); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿إِنِّي﴾: إنّ is a particle resembling the verb, and the yāʾ is its noun. ﴿أَعْلَمُ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is "أنا" (I). The clause is the khabar of إنّ. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لا تَعْلَمُونَ﴾: لا is negative and تعلمون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, the implied form being "ما لا تعلمونه" (what you do not know). The clause إني أعلم is mafʿūl bihi, maqūl al-qawl. The clause تعلمون is the ṣila of the relative noun.

daas-irab:181-182.t:
﴿فَمَنْ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle; من is a jussive-governing conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿بَدَّلَهُ﴾ a past verb, the fāʿil (agent) being "huwa" (he), and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verb is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿بَعْدَ﴾ an adverb of time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb بدل. ﴿ما﴾ maṣdariyya (infinitival). ﴿سَمِعَهُ﴾ a past verb, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; ما together with the verb is interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar), its implied form being "after his hearing it", in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
﴿فَإِنَّما﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb); إنما: the restraining and restrained particles (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿إِثْمُهُ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَلَى الَّذِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿يُبَدِّلُونَهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the nominal clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ إنّ and the Name of Majesty as its noun (ism). ﴿سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾ two khabars; the clause is resumptive, for threat. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); من is a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿خافَ﴾ a past verb, the fāʿil being "huwa", referring to مَن; it is the protasis. ﴿مِنْ مُوصٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to جنفا or to خاف. ﴿جَنَفاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿إِثْماً﴾ conjoined to جنفا. ﴿فَأَصْلَحَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; أصلح is a past verb, the fāʿil being "huwa"; the clause is conjoined.
﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to أصلح. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis; لا is the lā of generic negation. ﴿إِثْمَ﴾ the noun of لا, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted khabar of لا. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾ the i'rab of something similar has preceded in the previous verse.

daas-irab:183-184.t:
﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الصِّيامُ﴾ see its i'rab at verse 177. [Translator's note: so in the source; the parallel wording is analysed at verse 178.] ﴿كَما﴾ the kāf is a preposition and ما is maṣdariyya (infinitival). ﴿كُتِبَ﴾ a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is "huwa" (it), referring to الصيام. ﴿عَلَى الَّذِينَ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) كتب. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾ لعلّ and its noun (ism).
﴿تَتَّقُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of لعلّ, and the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīliyya). ﴿أَيَّاماً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by an omitted verb, its implied form being "fast for days". ﴿مَعْدُوداتٍ﴾ ṣifa (adjective), accusative with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); من is a jussive-governing conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كانَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as "huwa" (he), and it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿مَرِيضاً﴾ khabar of كان. ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿عَلى سَفَرٍ﴾ both conjoined to مريضا. ﴿فَعِدَّةٌ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). عدة is mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, the implied form being "upon him is a number"; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿مِنْ أَيَّامٍ﴾ both attached to an omitted ṣifa of عدة. ﴿أُخَرَ﴾ ṣifa of أيام, genitive (majrūr) with the fatḥa in place of the kasra, a diptote because of being an adjective and of deflection (ʿadl). ﴿وَعَلَى الَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; على الذين is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted, fronted khabar.
﴿يُطِيقُونَهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿فِدْيَةٌ﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿طَعامُ﴾ a nominative badal (substitute). ﴿مِسْكِينٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the nominal clause is conjoined. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive. من is a jussive-governing conditional noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿تَطَوَّعَ﴾ a past verb; it is the protasis. ﴿خَيْراً﴾ accusative by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ). ﴿فَهُوَ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis; هو is mubtadaʾ. ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾ its khabar. ﴿لَهُ﴾ both attached to the elative noun (ism al-tafḍīl) خير; the nominal clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿وَأَنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; أن is a maṣdar-forming particle that puts the verb in the accusative, interpreted together with the verb تصوموا after it as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿تَصُومُوا﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾ its khabar. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ both attached to the elative noun خير; the implied form of the speech is "your fasting is better for you". ﴿أَنْ﴾ a jussive-governing conditional particle. [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿أَنْ﴾; the conditional particle in the Quranic text is ﴿إِنْ﴾.] ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ an incomplete past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis, and the tāʾ is its noun. ﴿تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كنتم; the clause كنتم is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position, and the apodosis is omitted.

daas-irab:185-185.t:
