﴿شَهْرُ﴾ khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "huwa" (it). ﴿رَمَضانَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun in the position of the nominative as a ṣifa (adjective). ﴿أُنْزِلَ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنزل. ﴿الْقُرْآنُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿هُدىً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb) with the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the deleted alif, its implied sense being "guiding".
﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾ both attached to هدى. ﴿وَبَيِّناتٍ﴾ conjoined to هدى. ﴿مِنَ الْهُدى﴾ both attached to بينات. ﴿وَالْفُرْقانِ﴾ conjoined to الهدى. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); من is conditional, mubtadaʾ. ﴿شَهِدَ﴾ a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿مِنْكُمُ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿الشَّهْرَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); it has also been said that it is an adverb of time.
﴿فَلْيَصُمْهُ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); يصم is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command, and the hāʾ is a pronoun in the position of the accusative by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e. "let him fast in it"; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of the mubtadaʾ من.
﴿وَمَنْ كانَ مَرِيضاً أَوْ عَلى سَفَرٍ فَعِدَّةٌ مِنْ أَيَّامٍ أُخَرَ﴾ see the previous verse. ﴿يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ بِكُمُ الْيُسْرَ﴾ an imperfect verb, the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil, اليسر is the mafʿūl bihi, and the preposition and its genitive noun بكم are attached to the verb يريد. ﴿وَلا يُرِيدُ بِكُمُ الْعُسْرَ﴾ conjoined to the clause before it. ﴿وَلِتُكْمِلُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl); تكملوا is an imperfect verb, accusative by an أن concealed after the lām of causation, the sign of its accusative being the deletion of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the concealed أن and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are conjoined to what precedes them. ﴿الْعِدَّةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وَلِتُكَبِّرُوا اللَّهَ﴾ its i'rab is like ولتكملوا العدة, and it is conjoined to it. ﴿عَلى ما هَداكُمْ﴾ ما is maṣdariyya (infinitival); هداكم is a past verb, the fāʿil being "huwa", referring to Allah, and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi; the maṣdariyya ما with the verb is interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of the genitive by على, its implied form being "for His guiding you", and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تكبروا. ﴿وَلَعَلَّكُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; لعلكم: لعلّ and its noun (ism).
﴿تَشْكُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of لعلّ. The nominal clause لعلكم is conjoined.

daas-irab:186-186.t:
﴿وَإِذا﴾ the wāw is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya); إذا is an adverb (ẓarf) for future time. ﴿سَأَلَكَ﴾ a past verb, and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿عِبادِي﴾ fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, and the yāʾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿عَنِّي﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) سألك; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿فَإِنِّي﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). إني: إنّ and its noun (ism).
﴿قَرِيبٌ﴾ its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is the apodosis of a jussive condition, with no grammatical position; it has also been said that it is the object of an omitted saying, its implied form being: "then say to them: I am near". [Translator's note: so in the source, although إذا is described above as a non-jussive adverb.] ﴿أُجِيبُ﴾ an imperfect verb, the fāʿil being "أنا" (I). ﴿دَعْوَةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الدَّاعِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the kasra implied on the deleted yāʾ. ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverb of time, attached to أجيب. ﴿دَعانِ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the implied fatḥa, the fāʿil being "huwa" (he), and the deleted yāʾ is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the clause دعان is in the position of the genitive by annexation, and the clause أجيب is in the position of the nominative as a second khabar; it has also been said that it is a ṣifa (adjective). ﴿فَلْيَسْتَجِيبُوا﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition), i.e. "if that is so, then let them respond"; the lām is the lām of command; يستجيبوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿لِي﴾ both attached to the verb before them. ﴿وَلْيُؤْمِنُوا بِي﴾ like وليستجيبوا لي. ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْشُدُونَ﴾ like ﴿وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ﴾ in the verse that preceded it.

daas-irab:187-187.t:
﴿أُحِلَّ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) أحل. ﴿لَيْلَةَ﴾ an adverb of time, attached to the verb before it; some have said otherwise. ﴿الصِّيامِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الرَّفَثُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿إِلى نِسائِكُمْ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿هُنَّ لِباسٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ both attached to an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of لباس; the clause is explicative (tafsīriyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ لِباسٌ لَهُنَّ﴾ parsed like the one before it, and it is conjoined to it.
﴿عَلِمَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَنَّكُمْ﴾ أنّ and its noun (ism). ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun; the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of أنّ. ﴿تَخْتانُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿أَنْفُسَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar of كان, and أنّ with what follows it stands in place of the two objects of علم. ﴿فَتابَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; تاب is a past verb, the fāʿil being "huwa" (He), referring to Allah. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ both attached to تاب. ﴿وَعَفا عَنْكُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; the clause is conjoined to the clause تاب, which is conjoined to an omitted, implied clause, i.e. "so you repented, and He turned to you". ﴿فَالْآنَ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle; الآن is an adverb of time, attached to باشروهن. ﴿بَاشِرُوهُنَّ﴾ an imperative verb, the wāw is the fāʿil, and هنّ is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وَابْتَغُوا﴾ like باشروا, conjoined. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كَتَبَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ both attached to كتب; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَكُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا﴾ two imperative verbs and their two fāʿils; the two clauses are conjoined to what precedes them. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya) and genitive. ﴿يَتَبَيَّنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an أن concealed after حتى; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to كلوا. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ both attached to the verb before them. ﴿الْخَيْطُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿الْأَبْيَضُ﴾ ṣifa. ﴿مِنَ الْخَيْطِ﴾ both attached to تبين, or to an omitted ḥāl from الخيط. ﴿الْأَسْوَدِ﴾ ṣifa. ﴿مِنَ الْفَجْرِ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl from الخيط الأبيض. ﴿ثُمَّ أَتِمُّوا الصِّيامَ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِلَى اللَّيْلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to أتموا. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; لا is the prohibitive, jussive-governing lā. ﴿تُبَاشِرُوهُنَّ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw is the fāʿil and هنّ is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); أنتم is mubtadaʾ. ﴿عاكِفُونَ﴾ its khabar. ﴿فِي الْمَساجِدِ﴾ both attached to عاكفون; the clause is circumstantial. ﴿تِلْكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ.
﴿حُدُودُ﴾ its khabar. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ with ḍamma; as muḍāf ilayhi the word is ﴿اللَّهِ﴾.] ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition); لا is the prohibitive, jussive-governing lā. ﴿تَقْرَبُوها﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive by the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿يُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil. ﴿آياتِهِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾ both attached to يبين; the clause is resumptive.
﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ﴾ لعلّ, its noun and the clause that is its khabar; the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīliyya).

daas-irab:188-188.t:
﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is for resumption (istiʾnāf); لا is the prohibitive, jussive-governing lā. ﴿تَأْكُلُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَمْوالَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بَيْنَكُمْ﴾ an adverb, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from أموالكم.
﴿بِالْباطِلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to تأكلوا. ﴿وَتُدْلُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; تدلوا is conjoined to تأكلوا; it has also been said that it is accusative by a concealed أن. ﴿بِها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb before them. ﴿إِلَى الْحُكَّامِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb before them. ﴿لِتَأْكُلُوا﴾ the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl); تأكلوا is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an أن concealed after the lām of causation, the sign of its accusative being the deletion of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are in the position of the accusative as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿فَرِيقاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْ أَمْوالِ﴾ both attached to فريقا.
﴿النَّاسِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بِالْإِثْمِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb لتأكلوا. ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); أنتم is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. The nominal clause is circumstantial.

daas-irab:189-189.t:
﴿يَسْئَلُونَكَ﴾ an imperfect verb; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿عَنِ الْأَهِلَّةِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them; the clause is resumptive. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, the fāʿil being "anta" (you); the clause is resumptive. ﴿هِيَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مَواقِيتُ﴾ its khabar (predicate); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾ both attached to an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of مواقيت. ﴿وَالْحَجِّ﴾ conjoined to الناس; the clause ﴿قُلْ﴾ is resumptive. ﴿وَلَيْسَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); ليس is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿الْبِرُّ﴾ its noun (ism). ﴿بِأَنْ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾid) preposition; أن is a maṣdar-forming particle that puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿تَأْتُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; أن and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) in the position of the accusative as the khabar of ليس. ﴿الْبُيُوتَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْ ظُهُورِها﴾ both attached to the verb before them.
﴿وَلكِنَّ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; لكنّ is a particle resembling the verb. ﴿الْبِرُّ﴾ its noun. [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿الْبِرُّ﴾ with ḍamma here; as the noun of لكنّ in the Ḥafṣ reading it is ﴿الْبِرَّ﴾.] ﴿مِنْ﴾ a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative as the khabar of لكنّ. [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿مِنْ﴾; the relative noun is ﴿مَنِ﴾.] ﴿اتَّقى﴾ a past verb, the fāʿil being "huwa" (he); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَأْتُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; أتوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿الْبُيُوتَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْ أَبْوابِها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb before them. ﴿وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the Name of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾ لعلّ and its noun. ﴿تُفْلِحُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar, and the nominal clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

daas-irab:190-190.t: ﴿وَقاتِلُوا﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); قاتلوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿فِي سَبِيلِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) قاتلوا. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). [Translator's note: the source passes over ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ after ﴿سَبِيلِ﴾, which is muḍāf ilayhi.] ﴿يُقاتِلُونَكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb; the wāw is the fāʿil and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَلا تَعْتَدُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; لا is the prohibitive, jussive-governing lā; تعتدوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ إنّ and the Name of Majesty as its noun (ism). ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يُحِبُّ﴾ an imperfect verb, the fāʿil being "huwa" (He), referring to Allah the Exalted. ﴿الْمُعْتَدِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ, and the nominal clause إن الله is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:108-108.t:
﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction in the sense of bal. ﴿تُرِيدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle. ﴿تَسْئَلُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by dropping the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; أن and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿رَسُولَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كَما﴾ the kāf is a preposition; mā is maṣdariyya.
﴿سُئِلَ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿مُوسى﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; the maṣdariyya mā and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of genitive by the preposition. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ min is a preposition; qablu is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb سئل. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; man is a jussive conditional noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَتَبَدَّلِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); it is given a kasra because of the meeting of two sukūns.
﴿الْكُفْرَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِالْإِيمانِ﴾ attached to يتبدل. ﴿فَقَدْ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis of the condition; qad is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq).
﴿ضَلَّ﴾ a past verb, and the fāʿil is "he". ﴿سَواءَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿السَّبِيلِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the clause من يتبدل is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:109-109.t:
﴿وَدَّ﴾ a past verb. ﴿كَثِيرٌ﴾ fāʿil (agent), nominative. ﴿مِنْ أَهْلِ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) كثير or to an omitted adjective of it. ﴿الْكِتابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لَوْ﴾ a maṣdar-forming particle. ﴿يَرُدُّونَكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the kāf is an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the wāw is the fāʿil. Law and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ attached to يردونكم. ﴿إِيمانِكُمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كُفَّاراً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi of the verb يردون. ﴿حَسَداً﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).
﴿مِنْ عِنْدِ﴾ attached to حسدا. ﴿أَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ attached to the verb ود. ﴿ما تَبَيَّنَ﴾ mā is maṣdariyya; تبين is a past verb, and together with the maṣdariyya mā it is interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿لَهُمُ﴾ attached to the verb تبين. ﴿الْحَقُّ﴾ fāʿil, nominative. ﴿فَاعْفُوا﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa; اعفوا is an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on dropping the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿وَاصْفَحُوا﴾ conjoined to اعفوا. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya) and a preposition. ﴿يَأْتِيَ﴾ an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) after حتى, and the fāʿil is "He". ﴿بِأَمْرِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the verb يأتي. The implied an and the verb after it are interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of genitive by حتى. [Translator's note: the source names the word ﴿يَأْتِيَ﴾; the Qur'anic text reads ﴿حَتَّى يَأْتِيَ اللَّهُ بِأَمْرِهِ﴾, with the Name of Majesty as the overt fāʿil.] ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ﴾ see verse 20.

daas-irab:110-111.t:
﴿وَأَقِيمُوا﴾ the wāw is resumptive; أقيموا is an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on dropping the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿الصَّلاةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَآتُوا الزَّكاةَ﴾ the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿وَما﴾ mā is a jussive conditional noun indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi of the verb تقدموا. ﴿تُقَدِّمُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by dropping the nūn; it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿لِأَنْفُسِكُمْ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿مِنْ خَيْرٍ﴾ attached to an omitted element in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of mā.
﴿تَجِدُوهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive by dropping the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place attached to the verb before it. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The verbal clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition not joined by the fāʾ or the إذا of surprise. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿بِما﴾ mā is a relative noun in the position of genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar (predicate) بصير. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. [Translator's note: so in the source; elsewhere the book treats such a clause as the ṣila of the relative noun.] ﴿بَصِيرٌ﴾ khabar, nominative. ﴿وَقالُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; قالوا is a past verb indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to the clause ود كثير.
﴿لَنْ﴾ a subjunctive particle. ﴿يَدْخُلَ﴾ an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb). ﴿الْجَنَّةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative by extension (tawassuʿ) through dropping the preposition; it is also said to be an adverb of place. The clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun indeclinable on the sukūn in the position of nominative as fāʿil. ﴿كانَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as "he". ﴿هُوداً﴾ its khabar. ﴿أَوْ نَصارى﴾ conjoined to هودا. The clause كان هودا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿تِلْكَ﴾ a demonstrative indeclinable on the kasra in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the kāf is for address and the lām for distance.
﴿أَمانِيُّهُمْ﴾ khabar, nominative; the clause is parenthetical, between وقالوا and قل هاتوا برهانكم. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb. ﴿هاتُوا﴾ an imperative verb indeclinable on dropping the nūn because of its connection with the wāw of the plural, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying, in the position of accusative.
﴿بُرْهانَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the kāf is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa and the mīm is for the masculine plural. The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صادِقِينَ﴾ the i'rab of what resembles it preceded in verse 91.

daas-irab:112-112.t:
﴿بَلى﴾ a particle of answer. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَسْلَمَ﴾ a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "he". ﴿وَجْهَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, genitive by the lām; they are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أسلم. ﴿وَهُوَ مُحْسِنٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَلَهُ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis; له is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿أَجْرُهُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ.
﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place attached to an omitted khabar, i.e. "kept with his Lord"; it is also said to be attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿رَبِّهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وَلا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ﴾ its i'rab has preceded in verse 38.

daas-irab:113-113.t:
﴿وَقالَتِ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; قال is a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿الْيَهُودُ﴾ fāʿil (agent). ﴿لَيْسَتِ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿النَّصارى﴾ its noun, nominative with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif due to impossibility (taʿadhdhur). ﴿عَلى شَيْءٍ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of laysa; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). The clause وقالت is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿وَقالَتِ النَّصارى لَيْسَتِ الْيَهُودُ عَلى شَيْءٍ﴾ is conjoined to the first قالت and is parsed in the same way. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial; هم is a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَتْلُونَ الْكِتابَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil and الكتاب is its object; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ the kāf is a preposition; dhā is a demonstrative in the position of genitive by the preposition; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "they said a saying like that". ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of nominative as fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ lā is negative; يعلمون is an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿مِثْلَ﴾ an adjective of an omitted maṣdar, i.e. "a saying like their saying". ﴿قَوْلِهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the hāʾ is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa and the mīm is for the masculine plural. ﴿فَاللَّهُ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; الله, the Name of Majesty, is mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَحْكُمُ﴾ an imperfect verb; the clause is the khabar. ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of place attached to the verb before it. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of time also attached to the verb.
﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. The clause الله يحكم بينهم is resumptive. ﴿فِيما﴾ mā is a relative noun in the position of genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يحكم. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ attached to يختلفون; and the clause ﴿يَخْتَلِفُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, the clause being in the position of accusative as the khabar of كانوا.

daas-irab:114-114.t:
﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; man is a jussive conditional noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). [Translator's note: so in the source; man here is interrogative (istifhāmiyya), not conditional.] ﴿أَظْلَمُ﴾ khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive.
﴿مِمَّنْ﴾ min is a preposition; man is a relative noun in the position of genitive by min; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أظلم. ﴿مَنَعَ﴾ a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "he"; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿مَساجِدَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿أَنْ﴾ a subjunctive particle. ﴿يُذْكَرَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb); أن and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi of منع; it has also been parsed as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "out of dislike that His name be mentioned in them". ﴿فِيهَا﴾ attached to يذكر.
﴿اسْمُهُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of the passive verb يذكر. ﴿وَسَعى﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; سعى is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif due to impossibility (taʿadhdhur), and the fāʿil is "he", referring to man. ﴿فِي خَرابِها﴾ attached to the verb before them.
﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative indeclinable on the kasra in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; the kāf is for address. ﴿ما كانَ﴾ mā is negative; kāna is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a subjunctive particle. ﴿يَدْخُلُوها﴾ an imperfect verb, subjunctive by dropping the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; أن and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of nominative as the noun of kāna. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿خائِفِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. The clause ما كان لهم is in the position of nominative as the khabar of أولئك, and the nominal clause أولئك is resumptive. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿فِي الدُّنْيا﴾ also attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿خِزْيٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وَلَهُمْ فِي الْآخِرَةِ عَذابٌ﴾ like لهم في الدنيا خزي, conjoined to the preceding. ﴿عَظِيمٌ﴾ an adjective.

daas-irab:115-115.t: ﴿وَلِلَّهِ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; لله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿الْمَشْرِقُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿وَالْمَغْرِبُ﴾ a conjoined noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَأَيْنَما﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; أينما is a jussive conditional noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as an adverb of place, attached to the verb تولوا. ﴿تُوَلُّوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by dropping the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the clause is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa, or initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿فَثَمَّ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis of the condition. ﴿ثم﴾ an adverb of place, mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), indeclinable on the fatḥa in the position of accusative, attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿وَجْهُ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the nominal clause. [Translator's note: the sentence breaks off thus in the source.] ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ واسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾ inna, the Name of Majesty is its noun, and واسع and عليم are its two khabars; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:116-116.t: ﴿وَقالُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; قالوا is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to the clause قالت اليهود. ﴿اتَّخَذَ﴾ a past verb; it is also said to be in the sense of صيّر ("made"), which takes two objects. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿وَلَداً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿سُبْحانَهُ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb; the hāʾ is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa. The clause of the omitted verb is parenthetical, with no grammatical position. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿لَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of nominative as a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause), its implied form being "what He created …". ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined. The clause له ما في السموات is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿كُلٌّ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿لَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the khabar قانتون. ﴿قانِتُونَ﴾ khabar, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural. The nominal clause is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:117-117.t:
﴿بَدِيعُ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "Allah is the Originator". ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined. The nominal clause is parenthetical, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَإِذا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; إذا is an adverb for future time, governing its condition in the genitive and made accusative by its apodosis. ﴿قَضى﴾ a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, its appearance prevented by impossibility (taʿadhdhur); the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as "He".
﴿أَمْراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿فَإِنَّما﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis of the condition; إنما is the restraining (kāffa) and restrained (makfūfa) particles, with no grammatical position. ﴿يَقُولُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil is "He". ﴿لَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) يقول; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿كُنْ﴾ a complete (tāmm) imperative verb, and its fāʿil is a latent pronoun implied as "you". ﴿فَيَكُونُ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; يكون is a complete imperfect verb in the sense of "comes about", and its fāʿil is "it". The clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "so it is, or comes about"; the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The clause كن فيكون is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of accusative.

daas-irab:118-119.t:
﴿وَقالَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; قال is a past verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive.
﴿لا يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ lā is negative; يعلمون is an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَوْلا﴾ a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). ﴿يُكَلِّمُنَا﴾ an imperfect verb, and نا is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil; the clause is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿تَأْتِينا﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ due to heaviness, and نا is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿آيَةٌ﴾ fāʿil, nominative; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ the kāf is a preposition; ذلك is a demonstrative in the position of genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).
See verse 73. ﴿قالَ الَّذِينَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿مِثْلَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قَوْلِهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿تَشابَهَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿بَيَّنَّا﴾ a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and نا is the fāʿil. ﴿الْآياتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the kasra in place of the fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the verb before them. ﴿يُوقِنُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is an adjective of قوم. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna is a particle resembling the verb (ḥarf mushabbah bi-l-fiʿl), and نا is its noun. ﴿أَرْسَلْناكَ﴾ a past verb; نا is the fāʿil and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi. The clause is in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate), and the nominal clause إنا أرسلناك is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, its implied form being "bringing glad tidings with the truth". ﴿بَشِيراً﴾ ḥāl, accusative. ﴿وَنَذِيراً﴾ conjoined. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is resumptive; lā is negative. ﴿تُسْئَلُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is "you". ﴿عَنْ أَصْحابِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the verb. ﴿الْجَحِيمِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:31-33.t:
﴿وَعَلَّمَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; علم is a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو" (He), referring back to Allah the Exalted. ﴿آدَمَ﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with fatḥa. ﴿الْأَسْماءَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كُلَّها﴾: tawkīd (emphasis) of الأسماء; ها is an attached pronoun in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). The clause علم is conjoined to the clause قال. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿عَرَضَهُمْ﴾: a past verb; the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو". ﴿عَلَى الْمَلائِكَةِ﴾: both attached to (mutaʿalliq) عرض. The clause is conjoined. ﴿فَقالَ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction. قال is a past verb, and the fāʿil refers back to ربك; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَنْبِئُونِي﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn because it is attached to the wāw of the plural; the wāw is the fāʿil, the nūn is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and the yāʾ is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِأَسْماءِ﴾: both attached to the verb before them. ﴿هؤُلاءِ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of genitive by annexation. The clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صادِقِينَ﴾: see verse 23. The apodosis of the conditional إن is omitted, what precedes it pointing to it. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿سُبْحانَكَ﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb; the kāf is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿لا عِلْمَ﴾: لا is the lā of generic negation, working like إنّ; علم is its noun, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of accusative. ﴿لَنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of لا; the nominal clause has no grammatical position, being resumptive. The clause of the maṣdar is maqūl al-qawl. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿ما عَلَّمْتَنا﴾: ما is a relative noun, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of nominative as a badal (substitute) from ما and what it governs. «[Translator's note: so in the source; what is meant is evidently a badal from the position of لا together with its noun (محل لا ومعمولها).]» The returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, its implied form being "ما علمتنا إياه" (what You taught us of it). علمتنا is a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi. The clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾: a particle resembling the verb (one of inna and its sisters), and the kāf is its noun.
﴿أَنْتَ﴾: a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position. ﴿الْعَلِيمُ﴾: khabar of إنّ, nominative. ﴿الْحَكِيمُ﴾: a second khabar; the clause إنك العليم is resumptive. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb, and its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "هو". The clause is resumptive. ﴿يا آدَمُ﴾: يا is a vocative particle. آدم is the one addressed (munādā), a singular proper noun, indeclinable on ḍamma, in the position of accusative. ﴿أَنْبِئْهُمْ﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on sukūn; the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, the mīm is for the masculine plural, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنت" (you). ﴿بِأَسْمائِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb, in the place of the second object. ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; لما is adverbial, meaning "when". ﴿أَنْبَأَهُمْ﴾: a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "هو"; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿بِأَسْمائِهِمْ﴾: both attached to أنبأهم. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿أَلَمْ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; لم is a particle of negation, of the jussive and of conversion [of the imperfect to past meaning]. ﴿أَقُلْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the fāʿil is "أنا" (I). The clause is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: both attached to أقل. ﴿إِنِّي﴾: إنّ is a particle resembling the verb, and the yāʾ is its noun. ﴿أَعْلَمُ﴾: an imperfect verb; the clause is the khabar of إنّ, and the fāʿil is "أنا". The nominal clause is maqūl al-qawl. ﴿غَيْبَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾: conjoined to السموات. ﴿وَأَعْلَمُ﴾: an imperfect verb. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿تُبْدُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. The clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. The clause أعلم is conjoined. ﴿وَما﴾: a relative noun conjoined to the preceding ما. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb [one of kāna and its sisters]; the tāʾ is its noun, and the mīm is for the masculine plural. ﴿تَكْتُمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كنتم. The clause كنتم is the ṣila of the relative noun.

daas-irab:34-34.t:
﴿وَإِذْ قُلْنا لِلْمَلائِكَةِ﴾: see verse 30. ﴿اسْجُدُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لِآدَمَ﴾: both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿فَسَجَدُوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; سجدوا is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿إِبْلِيسَ﴾: excepted (mustathnā), accusative. ﴿أَبى﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif, its appearance prevented by impossibility; the fāʿil is "هو" (he), referring back to إبليس. The clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَاسْتَكْبَرَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the clause is conjoined to the clause أبى. ﴿وَكانَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb [one of kāna and its sisters], and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". ﴿مِنَ الْكافِرِينَ﴾: both attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). The clause is conjoined to the clause استكبر.

daas-irab:35-36.t:
﴿وَقُلْنا﴾: the clause is conjoined to the first قلنا. ﴿يا آدَمُ﴾: the one addressed (munādā). ﴿اسْكُنْ﴾: an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت" (you); the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَنْتَ﴾: a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as a tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent fāʿil. ﴿وَزَوْجُكَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; زوجك is a noun conjoined to the latent pronoun, and the kāf is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
﴿الْجَنَّةَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَكُلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; كلا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn because it is attached to the alif of the dual, and the alif is the fāʿil. The clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مِنْها﴾: both attached to (mutaʿalliq) كلا. ﴿رَغَداً﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), the implied form being "كلا أكلا رغدا" (eat an abundant eating); it may also be parsed as a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (nāʾib mafʿūl muṭlaq). ﴿حَيْثُ﴾: mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of place, indeclinable on ḍamma, in the position of accusative, attached to the verb كلا. ﴿شِئْتُما﴾: a past verb; the tāʾ is the fāʿil and ما is for the dual; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is the prohibitive lā that makes the verb jussive. ﴿تَقْرَبا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the alif is the fāʿil. ﴿هذِهِ﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable on kasra, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the hāʾ is for drawing attention. ﴿الشَّجَرَةَ﴾: a badal (substitute) from the demonstrative, accusative. ﴿فَتَكُونا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation (fāʾ al-sababiyya); تكونا is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the fāʾ of causation, the sign of its subjunctive being the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs, and the alif is its noun. ﴿مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ﴾: both attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿فَأَزَلَّهُمَا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; أزلهما is a past verb and its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿الشَّيْطانُ﴾: fāʿil. ﴿عَنْها﴾: both attached to أزلهما. ﴿فَأَخْرَجَهُما﴾: conjoined. ﴿مِمَّا﴾: من is a preposition; ما is a relative noun in the position of genitive by the preposition, and both are attached to the verb أخرجهما.
﴿كانا﴾: a defective past verb [one of kāna and its sisters], and the alif is its noun. ﴿فِيهِ﴾: both attached to an omitted khabar of كانا. ﴿وَقُلْنَا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction.
The clause is conjoined to the clause كانا, and the clause كانا has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. «[Translator's note: so in the source; the clause وقلنا is presumably conjoined to the clause فأزلهما rather than to the ṣila clause كانا.]» ﴿اهْبِطُوا﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is maqūl al-qawl. ﴿بَعْضُكُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لِبَعْضٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the khabar. ﴿عَدُوٌّ﴾: khabar, nominative; the nominal clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَلَكُمْ﴾: both attached to an omitted fronted khabar, and the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: both attached to مستقر. ﴿مُسْتَقَرٌّ﴾: a delayed mubtadaʾ. The clause is conjoined. ﴿وَمَتاعٌ﴾: a noun conjoined to مستقر. ﴿إِلى حِينٍ﴾: both attached to an omitted naʿt of متاع.

daas-irab:37-38.t:
﴿فَتَلَقَّى﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive. تلقى is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa. ﴿آدَمُ﴾: fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنْ رَبِّهِ﴾: both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿كَلِماتٍ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with kasra in place of fatḥa. ﴿فَتابَ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; تاب is a past verb, and the clause is conjoined to something omitted, the implied form being "قالها فتاب" (he said them, and He relented). ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾: both attached to the verb تاب. The clause تلقى is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿إِنَّهُ هُوَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ﴾: see verse 32. ﴿قُلْنَا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive.
﴿اهْبِطُوا﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿مِنْها﴾: both attached to اهبطوا. ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative.
﴿فَإِمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إن is conditional, and ما is redundant (zāʾida). ﴿يَأْتِيَنَّكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, indeclinable on fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the nūn is a particle with no grammatical position, the kāf is mafʿūl bihi, and the mīm is for the masculine plural. ﴿مِنِّي﴾: both attached to يأتينكم. ﴿هُدىً﴾: fāʿil, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the dropped alif. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis; من is a jussive conditional noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿تَبِعَ﴾: a past verb, and the fāʿil is "هو" (he); the clause تبع is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of من. The clause من تبع is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). The clause يأتينكم is resumptive. ﴿هُدايَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative with an implied fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person; the yāʾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَلا﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis. لا is negative, with no [governing] effect because it is repeated. ﴿خَوْفٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: both attached to an omitted khabar.
﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is negative. ﴿هُمْ﴾: a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَحْزَنُونَ﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar. The clause لا خوف عليهم is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. The clause لا هم يحزنون is conjoined.

daas-irab:39-40.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; الذين is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَكَذَّبُوا﴾: conjoined to كفروا. ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾: both attached to (mutaʿalliq) كذبوا. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on kasra; the kāf is a particle of address, and it is in the position of nominative as a second mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَصْحابُ﴾: khabar (predicate) of أولئك; the clause أولئك أصحاب is the khabar of الذين. ﴿النَّارِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿هُمْ﴾: a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِيها﴾: both attached to the khabar. ﴿خالِدُونَ﴾: khabar, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural. The clause هم فيها خالدون is a khabar of أولئك, or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿يا بَنِي﴾: يا is a vocative particle; بني is the one addressed (munādā), annexed (muḍāf), accusative with the yāʾ because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural. ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with fatḥa in place of kasra, a diptote, being a foreign proper noun. ﴿اذْكُرُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿نِعْمَتِيَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الَّتِي﴾: a relative noun, naʿt (adjective) of نعمة. ﴿أَنْعَمْتُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: both attached to أنعمت. The clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. The clause اذكروا is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَأَوْفُوا﴾: conjoined to اذكروا. ﴿بِعَهْدِي﴾: both attached to أوفوا. ﴿أُوفِ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to a command (jawāb al-ṭalab), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنا" (I); the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the command. ﴿بِعَهْدِكُمْ﴾: both attached to أوف. ﴿وَإِيَّايَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إياي is a detached accusative pronoun, indeclinable on an implied fatḥa, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb. ﴿فَارْهَبُونِ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction or redundant (zāʾida); ارهبون is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn; the nūn is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and the omitted yāʾ is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. The verbal clause reinforces the omitted clause ارهبوا.

daas-irab:258-258.t: ﴿أَلَمْ﴾: the hamza is interrogative; لم is a particle that makes the verb jussive. ﴿تَرَ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter. ﴿إِلَى الَّذِي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تر. ﴿حَاجَّ إِبْراهِيمَ﴾: a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is "he". ﴿فِي رَبِّهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to حاج. ﴿أَنْ﴾: a maṣdar-particle that makes the verb subjunctive. ﴿آتاهُ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif, in the position of accusative (manṣūb), and the hāʾ is its object. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿الْمُلْكَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from an and the verb is in the position of genitive by a preposition, the implied form being: "because of His giving him the kingship"; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to حاج. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb for past time, attached to آتاه. ﴿قالَ إِبْراهِيمُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿رَبِّيَ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied ḍamma on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person. ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ﴾: two imperfect verbs; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb, and the fāʿil is "he". ﴿أَنَا﴾: a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿أُحْيِي﴾: an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil is "I" (أنا); the clause is the khabar; and the clause ﴿أَنَا أُحْيِي﴾ is the object of the saying. ﴿وَأُمِيتُ﴾: conjoined to أحيي. ﴿قالَ إِبْراهِيمُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; إن الله: inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿يَأْتِي﴾: the clause is the khabar of inna; and the clause ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْتِي﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of an implied condition. ﴿بِالشَّمْسِ مِنَ الْمَشْرِقِ﴾: prepositional phrases attached to the verb يأتي. ﴿فَأْتِ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; أت is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil is "you" (anta). ﴿بِها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before them. ﴿مِنَ الْمَغْرِبِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to the verb. ﴿فَبُهِتَ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; بهت is a passive past verb. ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun, nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿كَفَرَ﴾: the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; الله, the Name of Majesty, is the mubtadaʾ. ﴿لا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ﴾: لا is negating, and an imperfect verb and its object. ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa); the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ.

daas-irab:259-259.t: ﴿أَوْ كَالَّذِي﴾: أو is a conjunction; the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb; the clause is conjoined to the first ألم تر, the implied form being: "or have you seen the like of ...". It is also said that the kāf is redundant (zāʾida). الذي is a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مَرَّ عَلى قَرْيَةٍ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَهِيَ خاوِيَةٌ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and the nominal clause made of the mubtadaʾ (subject) and the khabar (predicate) is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿عَلى عُرُوشِها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خاوية. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنَّى﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as ḥāl; it is also said to be an adverb. ﴿يُحْيِي﴾: an imperfect verb; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿هذِهِ﴾: a demonstrative, fronted mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, postponed fāʿil (agent). ﴿بَعْدَ﴾: an adverb of time, mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), attached to يحيي. ﴿مَوْتِها﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَأَماتَهُ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿أماته اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil. ﴿مِائَةَ﴾: an adverb of time, attached to أماته. ﴿عامٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿بَعَثَهُ﴾: a verb and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿قالَ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَمْ﴾: an interrogative noun, mafʿūl bihi, in the position of accusative as an adverb of time, attached to لبثت; its tamyīz (specification) is omitted, the implied form being: "how many years did you remain?" [Translator's note: so in the source, which calls كم both a mafʿūl bihi and an adverb.] ﴿لَبِثْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَبِثْتُ يَوْماً﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil, and an adverb. ﴿أَوْ بَعْضَ﴾: conjoined to يوما. ﴿يَوْمٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿قالَ بَلْ لَبِثْتَ﴾: قال is a resumptive clause; بل is a conjunction, and the clause is the object of the saying; لبثت is a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مِائَةَ﴾: an adverb of time, attached to لبثت; the clause is conjoined to an omitted clause, the implied form being: "Did I remain a day or part of a day?" ﴿عامٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَانْظُرْ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa. ﴿انظر إِلى طَعامِكَ وَشَرابِكَ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to انظر. ﴿لَمْ يَتَسَنَّهْ﴾: يتسنه is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) with the sukūn overt on its end; it is also said to be jussive by the dropping of the weak letter, with the hāʾ being the hāʾ of pause (al-sakt); the clause is in the position of accusative as ḥāl. ﴿وَانْظُرْ إِلى حِمارِكَ﴾: conjoined to the first وانظر. ﴿وَلِنَجْعَلَكَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is the lām of causation (al-taʿlīl); نجعل is an imperfect verb, accusative (subjunctive) by an implied an, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being: "We caused you to die and then raised you in order to make you a sign"; and the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿آيَةً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of آية. ﴿وَانْظُرْ إِلَى الْعِظامِ﴾: conjoined to the انظر before it. ﴿كَيْفَ﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as ḥāl. ﴿نُنْشِزُها﴾: an imperfect verb, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of accusative as ḥāl. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿نَكْسُوها لَحْماً﴾: an imperfect verb; the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi and لحما is the second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; لما is adverbial, attached to قال. ﴿تَبَيَّنَ لَهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تبين; the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قالَ﴾: the clause is the answer of لمّا, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَعْلَمُ﴾: an imperfect verb. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: anna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿عَلى كُلِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قدير. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قَدِيرٌ﴾: khabar; and anna with what it governs stands in place of the two objects of أعلم; and the clause أعلم is the object of the saying.

daas-irab:260-260.t: ﴿وَإِذْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إذ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember". ﴿قالَ إِبْراهِيمُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿رَبِّ﴾: the one addressed in the vocative (munādā), in construct, accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person. ﴿أَرِنِي﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter; the nūn is the nūn of protection (al-wiqāya), the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is "you" (anta). ﴿كَيْفَ﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿تُحْيِ﴾: an imperfect verb. ﴿الْمَوْتى﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi of أرني; and the clause أرني is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَوَلَمْ﴾: the hamza is an interrogative particle, the wāw is a conjunction, and لم is a particle that makes the verb jussive. ﴿تُؤْمِنْ﴾: a jussive (majzūm) imperfect verb; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb. ﴿بَلى﴾: a particle of answer; the omitted clause is the object of the saying, the implied form being: "Yes, I have believed". ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لكن is for rectification (istidrāk). ﴿لِيَطْمَئِنَّ﴾: the lām is the lām of causation (al-taʿlīl); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from the verb يطمئن and the latent an is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the two are attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being: "I asked You for the reassurance of my heart". ﴿قَلْبِي﴾: fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied ḍamma on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person. ﴿قالَ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَخُذْ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa. ﴿خذ أَرْبَعَةً مِنَ الطَّيْرِ﴾: an imperative verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and أربعة is its object. ﴿فَصُرْهُنَّ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; صرهن is an imperative verb, the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil. [Translator's note: so in the source; in صُرْهُنَّ the fāʿil is the latent "you" (anta), and هنّ as a whole is the object.] ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to صرهن. ﴿ثُمَّ اجْعَلْ﴾: conjoined to صرهن. ﴿عَلى كُلِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اجعل. ﴿جَبَلٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْهُنَّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from جزءا. ﴿جُزْءاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ثُمَّ ادْعُهُنَّ﴾: conjoined; ادعهن is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil is "you"; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَأْتِينَكَ﴾: an imperfect verb, indeclinable on sukūn because it is joined to the nūn of the feminine plural, and the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil; it is in the position of jussive as the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the request. ﴿سَعْياً﴾: an accusative ḥāl. ﴿وَاعْلَمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اعلم is an imperative verb. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ﴾: anna, the Name of Majesty is its noun, and عزيز and حكيم are its two khabars (predicates); and anna with what follows it stands in place of the two objects of اعلم.

daas-irab:261-262.t: ﴿مَثَلُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يُنْفِقُونَ أَمْوالَهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فِي سَبِيلِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ينفقون. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿كَمَثَلِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿حَبَّةٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. There is an ellipsis in the wording, the implied form being: "the likeness of the spending of those ... is like the likeness of one who sows a grain". [Translator's note: the source has الدين, a slip for الذين.] ﴿أَنْبَتَتْ﴾: a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿سَبْعَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿سَنابِلَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with fatḥa, being on the pattern mafāʿil; the clause is in the position of genitive as an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿فِي كُلِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿سُنْبُلَةٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِائَةُ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿حَبَّةٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is in the position of genitive as an adjective of سنابل. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; الله, the Name of Majesty, is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause ﴿يُضاعِفُ﴾. ﴿لِمَنْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يضاعف. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾: an imperfect verb; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; الله, the Name of Majesty, is the mubtadaʾ. ﴿واسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾: its two khabars. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ, or a badal (substitute) from the الذين before it; and the clause ﴿يُنْفِقُونَ أَمْوالَهُمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿ثُمَّ لا يُتْبِعُونَ﴾: ثم is a conjunction; لا is negating; يتبعون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَنْفَقُوا﴾: a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿مَنًّا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is redundant (zāʾida). ﴿أَذىً﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَجْرُهُمْ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾: an adverb, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and the clause ﴿لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ﴾ is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ الذين. ﴿وَلا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ﴾: its i'rab has preceded.

daas-irab:263-264.t:
﴿قَوْلٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مَعْرُوفٌ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿وَمَغْفِرَةٌ﴾: conjoined to قول. ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾: khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿مِنْ صَدَقَةٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar. ﴿يَتْبَعُها أَذىً﴾: an imperfect verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a postponed fāʿil (agent). ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive. ﴿وَاللَّهُ غَنِيٌّ حَلِيمٌ﴾: the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ, and غني and حليم are its two khabars.
﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾: for its i'rab see verse 253. [Translator's note: so in the source; the phrase was parsed at verse 254.] ﴿لا تُبْطِلُوا﴾: لا is prohibitive, making the verb jussive; تبطلوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿صَدَقاتِكُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with kasra, being a sound feminine plural. ﴿بِالْمَنِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تبطلوا. ﴿وَالْأَذى﴾: conjoined to المن; the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَالَّذِي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial): "do not void your charities, acting like the one who ...", or attached to a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object): "a voiding like that of the one who ...". ﴿يُنْفِقُ مالَهُ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil is "he". ﴿رِئاءَ﴾: a ḥāl, in the sense of "showing off", or mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿النَّاسِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is negating; يؤمن is an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the clause is conjoined to ينفق and is likewise a ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فَمَثَلُهُ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; مثله is mubtadaʾ. ﴿كَمَثَلِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿صَفْوانٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿تُرابٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ; the clause is in the position of genitive as an adjective of صفوان. ﴿فَأَصابَهُ وابِلٌ﴾:
a past verb, its mafʿūl bihi and a postponed fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَتَرَكَهُ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; تركه is a past verb and its first mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿صَلْداً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لا يَقْدِرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَلى شَيْءٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يقدر; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِمَّا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of شيء. ﴿كَسَبُوا﴾: the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun ما. ﴿وَاللَّهُ لا يَهْدِي﴾: the wāw is resumptive; الله, the Name of Majesty, is the mubtadaʾ; لا is negating; يهدي is an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; and the clause ﴿لا يَهْدِي﴾ is its khabar. ﴿الْقَوْمَ﴾: its object. ﴿الْكافِرِينَ﴾: an adjective; and the clause ﴿وَاللَّهُ ... ﴾ is resumptive.

daas-irab:191-191.t: ﴿وَاقْتُلُوهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; اقتلوهم is an imperative verb, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined. ﴿حَيْثُ﴾ an adverb of place, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) اقتلوهم. ﴿ثَقِفْتُمُوهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural and the wāw is added for prolongation (ishbāʿ); the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi and the mīm is for the absent masculines; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَأَخْرِجُوهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; the clause is conjoined to واقتلوهم. ﴿مِنْ حَيْثُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb أخرجوهم. ﴿أَخْرَجُوكُمْ﴾ the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿وَالْفِتْنَةُ﴾ the wāw is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya); الفتنة is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَشَدُّ﴾ its khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنَ الْقَتْلِ﴾ both attached to أشد; the clause is parenthetical. ﴿وَلا تُقاتِلُوهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is prohibitive; تقاتلوهم is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to يقاتلوهم. [Translator's note: so in the source; the verb meant is تقاتلوهم.] ﴿الْمَسْجِدِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْحَرامِ﴾ ṣifa (adjective). ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya) and genitive. ﴿يُقاتِلُوكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an أن concealed after حتى; the wāw is its fāʿil and the kāf its object. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ both attached to قاتلوكم; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿فَإِنْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿قاتَلُوكُمْ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma because of its connection to the wāw of the group; the wāw is the fāʿil and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi; it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) of إن. ﴿فَاقْتُلُوهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); اقتلوهم is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ the kāf is a preposition; ذلك is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted, fronted khabar. ﴿جَزاءُ﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْكافِرِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the yāʾ; the nominal clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:192-192.t: ﴿فَإِنِ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); إن is a jussive-governing conditional particle. ﴿انْتَهَوْا﴾ a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَإِنِ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); إنّ is a particle resembling the verb. [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿فَإِنِ﴾ here; the Quranic text is ﴿فَإِنَّ﴾.] ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its noun (ism). ﴿غَفُورٌ﴾ its khabar (predicate). ﴿رَحِيمٌ﴾ a second khabar; the nominal clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.

daas-irab:193-194.t:
﴿وَقاتِلُوهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; قاتلوهم is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya) and genitive. ﴿لا تَكُونَ﴾ لا is negating; تكون is a complete (tāmm) imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by a concealed أن, which with the verb is interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) in the position of the genitive by حتى; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿فِتْنَةٌ﴾ fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿وَيَكُونَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; يكون is conjoined to the first تكون, and it may also be parsed as incomplete (nāqiṣ). ﴿الدِّينُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by the lām; both are attached to the verb يكون, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَإِنِ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya) and إن is conditional. ﴿انْتَهَوْا﴾ a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). لا is the lā of generic negation, operating like إنّ. ﴿عُدْوانَ﴾ its noun (ism), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿عَلَى الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ. [Translator's note: so in the source; what is meant is the khabar of لا.]
﴿الشَّهْرُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْحَرامُ﴾ ṣifa (adjective). ﴿بِالشَّهْرِ﴾ both attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, the implied form being "this month is in return for this month". ﴿الْحَرامُ﴾ ṣifa; the clause is resumptive. [Translator's note: the source prints this second ﴿الْحَرامُ﴾ with ḍamma; as the adjective of بالشهر it is ﴿الْحَرامِ﴾.] ﴿وَالْحُرُماتُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; الحرمات is mubtadaʾ. ﴿قِصاصٌ﴾ its khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَمَنِ﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition); من is a jussive-governing conditional noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿اعْتَدى﴾ a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis, the fāʿil being "huwa" (he). ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb before them. ﴿فَاعْتَدُوا﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis; اعتدوا is an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ both attached to اعتدوا. ﴿بِمِثْلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to اعتدوا; it has also been said that the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾid) preposition and مثل is a ṣifa of an omitted maṣdar: "a transgression like". ﴿مَا﴾ maṣdariyya (infinitival).
﴿اعْتَدى﴾ a past verb, interpreted together with ما as a maṣdar in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa), i.e. "with the like of his transgression", and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause فاعتدوا is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿وَاتَّقُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; اتقوا is an imperative verb and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَاعْلَمُوا﴾ conjoined to اتقوا. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ أنّ and the Name of Majesty as its noun. ﴿مَعَ الْمُتَّقِينَ﴾ مع is an adverb of place, attached to an omitted khabar of أنّ. المتقين is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. أنّ and what follows it stand in place of the two objects of اعلموا.

daas-irab:195-195.t: ﴿وَأَنْفِقُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; أنفقوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿فِي سَبِيلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; لا is the prohibitive, jussive-governing lā. ﴿تُلْقُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿بِأَيْدِيكُمْ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾid) preposition. أيديكم is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative in position and genitive in form. ﴿إِلَى التَّهْلُكَةِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to تلقوا. ﴿وَأَحْسِنُوا﴾ like وأنفقوا, and the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ إنّ and the Name of Majesty as its noun (ism). ﴿يُحِبُّ﴾ an imperfect verb, the fāʿil being "huwa" (He), referring to Allah. ﴿الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ, and the nominal clause إن الله is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:196-196.t:
﴿وَأَتِمُّوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; أتموا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿الْحَجَّ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وَالْعُمْرَةَ﴾ conjoined to it. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by the lām, and both are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from الحج and العمرة; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَإِنْ﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition); إن is a jussive-governing conditional particle. ﴿أُحْصِرْتُمْ﴾ a passive past verb; it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); أحصرتم means "you were prevented from the Hajj and the ʿUmra".
﴿فَمَا﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); ما is a relative noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being: "then upon you is what is easy". The clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿اسْتَيْسَرَ﴾ a past verb, the fāʿil being "huwa" (it); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿مِنَ الْهَدْيِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl, the implied form being:
"offered from the sacrificial animals". ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; لا is the prohibitive, jussive-governing lā. ﴿تَحْلِقُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿رُؤُسَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb); the interpreted maṣdar from the verb and the أن concealed after حتى is in the position of the genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تحلق. ﴿الْهَدْيِ﴾ fāʿil. [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿الْهَدْيِ﴾ with kasra; as fāʿil it is ﴿الْهَدْيُ﴾.]
﴿مَحِلَّهُ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to the verb يبلغ; it has also been said that it is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَمَنْ كانَ مِنْكُمْ مَرِيضاً﴾ see verse 184. ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿بِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted, fronted khabar. ﴿أَذىً﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif that was deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters. ﴿مِنْ رَأْسِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of أذى.
﴿فَفِدْيَةٌ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis; فدية is mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, its implied form being: "then upon him is a ransom"; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿مِنْ صِيامٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ṣifa of فدية. ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction.
﴿صَدَقَةٍ أَوْ نُسُكٍ﴾ two nouns conjoined to صيام; the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar. ﴿فَإِذا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); إذا is an adverb (ẓarf) for future time. ﴿أَمِنْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis of إذا; من is a jussive-governing conditional noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿تَمَتَّعَ﴾ a past verb; it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis, the fāʿil being "huwa" (he). ﴿بِالْعُمْرَةِ﴾ both attached to تمتع. ﴿إِلَى الْحَجِّ﴾ both attached to an omitted verb, i.e. "and his enjoyment continued until the Hajj". ﴿فَمَا﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis; ما is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ, and its khabar is omitted, i.e. "then upon him is what…".
﴿اسْتَيْسَرَ﴾ a past verb; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنَ الْهَدْيِ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; من is a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿لَمْ يَجِدْ﴾ يجد is an imperfect verb, jussive; it is the protasis, and the fāʿil refers back to مَن. ﴿فَصِيامُ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis; صيام is mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, its implied form being: "then upon him is the fasting", and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿ثَلاثَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَيَّامٍ﴾ a second muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِي الْحَجِّ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl of ثلاثة. ﴿وَسَبْعَةٍ﴾ conjoined to ثلاثة.
﴿إِذا﴾ an adverb for future time. ﴿رَجَعْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿تِلْكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَشَرَةٌ﴾ its khabar. ﴿كامِلَةٌ﴾ ṣifa. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿لِمَنْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted khabar; من is relative. ﴿لَمْ يَكُنْ﴾ يكن is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive. ﴿أَهْلُهُ﴾ its noun (ism).
﴿حاضِرِي﴾ its khabar, accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural, its nūn deleted for annexation; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun.
﴿الْمَسْجِدِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْحَرامِ﴾ ṣifa; the nominal clause ﴿ذلِكَ لِمَنْ﴾ is resumptive. ﴿وَاتَّقُوا﴾ an imperative, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَاعْلَمُوا﴾ like واتقوا, and it is conjoined to it. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ أنّ and the Name of Majesty as its noun. ﴿شَدِيدُ﴾ its khabar. ﴿الْعِقابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. أنّ and what follows it stand in place of the two objects of اعلموا.

daas-irab:197-197.t:
﴿الْحَجُّ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَشْهُرٌ﴾ its khabar (predicate). ﴿مَعْلُوماتٌ﴾ ṣifa (adjective). ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition); من is a jussive-governing conditional noun, mubtadaʾ.
﴿فَرَضَ﴾ a past verb, the fāʿil (agent) being "huwa" (he); it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿فِيهِنَّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) فرض. ﴿الْحَجُّ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause فرض is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position, and the nominal clause ﴿الْحَجُّ أَشْهُرٌ﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. [Translator's note: so in the source: the word ﴿الْحَجَّ﴾ is printed with ḍamma although parsed as mafʿūl bihi, and the clause فرض is called an apodosis although it was just parsed as the protasis.] ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); لا is the lā of generic negation, operating like إنّ. ﴿رَفَثَ﴾ its noun (ism), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿وَلا فُسُوقَ﴾ conjoined to فلا رفث. ﴿وَلا جِدالَ﴾ conjoined to it. ﴿فِي الْحَجِّ﴾ both attached to an omitted khabar of لا; the clause لا رفث is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis and its apodosis are in the position of the nominative as the khabar of مَن. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); ما is a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi. ﴿تَفْعَلُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ خَيْرٍ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ما. ﴿يَعْلَمْهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَتَزَوَّدُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; تزودوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَإِنَّ﴾ the fāʾ is causal (taʿlīliyya); إنّ is a particle resembling the verb. ﴿خَيْرٍ﴾ its noun. [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿خَيْرٍ﴾ with kasra; as the noun of إنّ it is ﴿خَيْرَ﴾.] ﴿الزَّادِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿التَّقْوى﴾ its khabar; the clause has no grammatical position, being causal. ﴿وَاتَّقُونِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; اتقون is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil and the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya); the deleted yāʾ of the first person, indicated by the kasra, is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يا أُولِي﴾ يا is a vocative particle; أولي is the one addressed (munādā), muḍāf, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural. ﴿الْأَلْبابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi.
