daas-irab:198-198.t: ﴿لَيْسَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿جُناحٌ﴾ its postponed noun (ism). ﴿أَنْ تَبْتَغُوا﴾ أن is a maṣdar-forming particle that puts the verb in the accusative. تبتغوا is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); أن and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) in the position of the genitive by a preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to جناح. [Translator's note: the preposition is not in the text; an implied في ("in seeking") is meant.] ﴿فَضْلًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ﴾ both attached to the verb before them. ﴿فَإِذا أَفَضْتُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); إذا is an adverb (ẓarf) for future time; أفضتم is a past verb and the tāʾ is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿مِنْ عَرَفاتٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to أفضتم. ﴿فَاذْكُرُوا﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); اذكروا is an imperative verb and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to اذكروا. ﴿الْمَشْعَرِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْحَرامِ﴾ ṣifa (adjective); the clause اذكروا is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَاذْكُرُوهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; اذكروه is an imperative verb, its fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿كَما﴾ the kāf is a preposition; ما is maṣdariyya (infinitival). ﴿هَداكُمْ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, the fāʿil being "huwa" (He), referring to Allah; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted word in the position of the accusative as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "remember Him with a good remembrance resembling His guiding of you". ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); إن is lightened from the heavy إنّ (mukhaffafa min al-thaqīla). ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ an incomplete past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لَمِنَ﴾ the lām is the distinguishing lām (al-fāriqa) between the lightened إن and the negating إن. ﴿الضَّالِّينَ﴾ a genitive noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar of كنتم; the clause إن كنتم is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl.

daas-irab:199-199.t: ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿أَفِيضُوا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنْ حَيْثُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) أفيضوا. ﴿أَفاضَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿النَّاسُ﴾ its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. [Translator's note: so in the source; the clause أفاض الناس is usually parsed as in the position of the genitive by annexation to حيث.] ﴿وَاسْتَغْفِرُوا﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ﴾ إنّ, the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism) and غفور its khabar (predicate); the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿رَحِيمٌ﴾ a second khabar.

daas-irab:41-41.t:
﴿وَآمِنُوا﴾: the clause is conjoined to اذكروا. ﴿بِما﴾: ما is a relative noun in the position of genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) آمنوا.
﴿أَنْزَلْتُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted: "بما أنزلته" (in what I sent down). The clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿مُصَدِّقاً﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the omitted pronoun. ﴿لِما﴾: like بما; both are attached to مصدقا. ﴿مَعَكُمْ﴾: an adverb of place attached to the omitted ṣila of لما, its implied form being "للذي وجد معكم" (to that which is found with you). ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is the prohibitive lā that makes the verb jussive. ﴿تَكُونُوا﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb [one of kāna and its sisters], jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its noun. ﴿أَوَّلَ﴾: its khabar (predicate). ﴿كافِرٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بِهِ﴾: both attached to كافر. ﴿وَلا تَشْتَرُوا﴾: the i'rab of something like it has preceded. ﴿بِآياتِي﴾: both attached to تشتروا. ﴿ثَمَناً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾: a naʿt (adjective). ﴿وَإِيَّايَ فَاتَّقُونِ﴾: the i'rab of something like it has preceded shortly before, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:42-43.t:
﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is the prohibitive lā that makes the verb jussive. ﴿تَلْبِسُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). The clause is conjoined. ﴿الْحَقَّ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بِالْباطِلِ﴾: both attached to (mutaʿalliq) تلبسوا. ﴿وَتَكْتُمُوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; تكتموا is an imperfect verb, jussive like تلبسوا, and the clause is conjoined. The wāw may also be parsed as circumstantial (ḥāliyya), with تلبسوا an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the wāw. «[Translator's note: so in the source; the verb meant here is evidently تكتموا, the verb that follows the wāw.]» ﴿الْحَقَّ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; أنتم is mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause تعلمون is the khabar (predicate). The nominal clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿تَعْلَمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil.
﴿وَأَقِيمُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. The clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿الصَّلاةَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَآتُوا الزَّكاةَ﴾: its i'rab is like أقيموا الصلاة. ﴿وَارْكَعُوا﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مَعَ﴾: an adverb of time attached to اركعوا. ﴿الرَّاكِعِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural, and the nūn is a substitute for the tanwīn in the singular noun. The clause اركعوا is conjoined.

daas-irab:44-46.t:
﴿أَتَأْمُرُونَ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation and rebuke. تأمرون is an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿النَّاسَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿بِالْبِرِّ﴾: both attached to (mutaʿalliq) تأمرون. ﴿وَتَنْسَوْنَ﴾: the clause is conjoined to تأمرون, with no grammatical position, resumptive like it. ﴿أَنْفُسَكُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ﴾: the wāw is the wāw of the ḥāl (circumstantial); أنتم is a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿تَتْلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause تتلون is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause أنتم تتلون is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَفَلا﴾: the hamza is for disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لا is negative. ﴿تَعْقِلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَاسْتَعِينُوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; استعينوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِالصَّبْرِ﴾: both attached to استعينوا. ﴿وَالصَّلاةِ﴾: conjoined to الصبر. ﴿وَإِنَّها﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); إنّ is a particle resembling the verb (one of inna and its sisters), and the hāʾ is its noun. ﴿لَكَبِيرَةٌ﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and كبيرة is the khabar of إنّ. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿عَلَى الْخاشِعِينَ﴾: both attached to كبيرة. The clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of الخاشعين. ﴿يَظُنُّونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. The clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿أَنَّهُمْ﴾: أنّ and its noun, and the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural. ﴿مُلاقُوا﴾: its khabar, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the nūn was dropped because of the annexation.
﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive. ﴿وَأَنَّهُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أنّ is a particle resembling the verb, and the hāʾ is its noun. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾: both attached to راجعون. ﴿راجِعُونَ﴾: khabar. The clause أنهم إليه راجعون is conjoined, and [the two clauses] take the place of the two objects of يظنون.

daas-irab:47-48.t:
﴿يا بَنِي إِسْرائِيلَ اذْكُرُوا نِعْمَتِيَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: its i'rab has passed at verse 40. ﴿وَأَنِّي﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أنّ is a particle resembling the verb (one of inna and its sisters), and the yāʾ is its noun; أنّ and what follows it are conjoined to نعمتي. ﴿فَضَّلْتُكُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the mīm is for the masculine plural. The clause is the khabar (predicate) of أني. ﴿عَلَى الْعالَمِينَ﴾: a noun, genitive with the yāʾ because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) فضلتكم. ﴿وَاتَّقُوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the clause اتقوا is conjoined to اذكروا. ﴿يَوْماً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لا تَجْزِي﴾: لا is negative; تجزي is an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ because of heaviness. ﴿نَفْسٌ﴾: fāʿil; the clause is in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective). ﴿عَنْ نَفْسٍ﴾: both attached to تجزي. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is negative. ﴿يُقْبَلُ﴾: a passive imperfect verb. ﴿مِنْها﴾: both attached to يقبل.
﴿شَفاعَةٌ﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is negative. ﴿يُؤْخَذُ مِنْها عَدْلٌ﴾: its i'rab is like the i'rab of the preceding clause, and it is conjoined to it. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is negative. ﴿هُمْ﴾: a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يُنْصَرُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil. The clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the pronoun هم, and the nominal clause ولا هم ينصرون is conjoined.

daas-irab:49-49.t:
﴿يَسُومُونَكُمْ﴾: they make you taste. ﴿سُوءَ الْعَذابِ﴾: its worst and most severe. ﴿يَسْتَحْيُونَ نِساءَكُمْ﴾: they leave them alive.
﴿وَإِذْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إذ is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb اذكروا (remember). ﴿نَجَّيْناكُمْ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn because it is attached to نا of the agents; نا is the fāʿil (agent), the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural. The clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿مِنْ آلِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb. ﴿فِرْعَوْنَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with fatḥa in place of kasra, a foreign proper noun [and so a diptote]. ﴿يَسُومُونَكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, the kāf is mafʿūl bihi, and the mīm is for the masculine plural. ﴿سُوءَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْعَذابِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. The clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿يُذَبِّحُونَ﴾: like يسومون. The clause is explicative (mufassira) of the clause يسومون. ﴿أَبْناءَكُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَيَسْتَحْيُونَ﴾: conjoined to the clause يذبحون. ﴿نِساءَكُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَفِي ذلِكُمْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; في ذلكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿بَلاءٌ﴾: a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ﴾: both attached to بلاء or to its naʿt (adjective). ﴿عَظِيمٌ﴾: a naʿt of بلاء.

daas-irab:50-52.t:
﴿فرقنا البحر﴾: We separated it with dry land.
﴿وَإِذْ﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿فَرَقْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بِكُمُ﴾: both attached to (mutaʿalliq) فرقنا. ﴿الْبَحْرَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَأَنْجَيْناكُمْ﴾: the clause is conjoined, and it is like it. ﴿وَأَغْرَقْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿آلَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فِرْعَوْنَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); أنتم is mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿تَنْظُرُونَ﴾ is its khabar (predicate). The nominal clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَإِذْ﴾: conjoined. ﴿واعَدْنا﴾: a past verb, and its fāʿil is نا denoting the agents. ﴿مُوسى﴾: first mafʿūl bihi, accusative with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa. ﴿أَرْبَعِينَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the yāʾ, assimilated to the masculine plural.
﴿لَيْلَةً﴾: tamyīz (specification). The clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿اتَّخَذْتُمُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿الْعِجْلَ﴾: first mafʿūl bihi; the second object is omitted, the implied form being "ثم اتخذتم العجل معبودا" (then you took the calf as an object of worship).
﴿مِنْ بَعْدِهِ﴾: both attached to the verb اتخذتم. ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; أنتم is mubtadaʾ. ﴿ظالِمُونَ﴾: its khabar; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿عَفَوْنا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَنْكُمْ﴾: both attached to the verb, and likewise ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾: both attached to the verb. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of genitive by annexation; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾: a particle resembling the verb (one of inna and its sisters), and the kāf is its noun. ﴿تَشْكُرُونَ﴾: the clause is its khabar. The clause لعلكم تشكرون is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), the implied form being "حال كونكم شاكرين" (while you are grateful).

daas-irab:265-265.t:
﴿وَمَثَلُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; مثل is mubtadaʾ (subject), and after it there is an omitted muḍāf ilayhi, its implied form being: "and the likeness of the charities of ...". ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يُنْفِقُونَ أَمْوالَهُمُ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿ابْتِغاءَ﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿مَرْضاتِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَتَثْبِيتاً﴾: conjoined to ابتغاء. ﴿مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (verbal noun) تثبيتا. ﴿كَمَثَلِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ مثل. ﴿جَنَّةٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِرَبْوَةٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of جنة. ﴿أَصابَها وابِلٌ﴾: a past verb, its mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil; the clause is an adjective of جنة. ﴿فَآتَتْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿آتت أُكُلَها﴾: a past verb and its object. ﴿ضِعْفَيْنِ﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb) with yāʾ because it is a dual; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَإِنْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إن is conditional, making two verbs jussive. ﴿لَمْ﴾: a particle of jussive mood. ﴿يُصِبْها﴾: a jussive (majzūm) imperfect verb and its object; it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿وابِلٌ﴾: fāʿil. ﴿فَطَلٌّ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); طل is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being: "then what strikes it is a drizzle", or it is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted.
﴿وَاللَّهُ بِما تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ﴾: the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ; بما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar بصير; and the clause تعلمون is the ṣila of the relative noun ما; and the clause ﴿وَاللَّهُ ... ﴾ is resumptive. [Translator's note: the source writes تعلمون here, a slip for تعملون.]

daas-irab:266-266.t: ﴿أَيَوَدُّ﴾: the hamza is interrogative. ﴿يَوَدُّ أَحَدُكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَنْ تَكُونَ﴾: the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لَهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿جَنَّةٌ﴾: the noun of تكون. ﴿مِنْ نَخِيلٍ وَأَعْنابٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of جنة. ﴿وَأَعْنابٍ﴾: conjoined to نخيل. ﴿تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهارُ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and its fāʿil; the clause is an adjective of جنة. ﴿لَهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿فِيها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to the omitted khabar, the implied form being: "abundant provision is his in it". ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الثَّمَراتِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is a third adjective of جنة. ﴿وَأَصابَهُ الْكِبَرُ﴾: a past verb, its mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), with قد implied. ﴿وَلَهُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; له is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿ذُرِّيَّةٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿ضُعَفاءُ﴾: an adjective; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَأَصابَها إِعْصارٌ﴾: the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِيهِ نارٌ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ نار; the clause is an adjective of إعصار. ﴿فَاحْتَرَقَتْ﴾: conjoined to أصابها. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿يُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ لَكُمُ الْآياتِ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil, and its mafʿūl bihi, accusative with kasra; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb; the clause يبين is resumptive. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَفَكَّرُونَ﴾: لعل and its noun, and the clause تتفكرون is its khabar; the nominal clause is in the position of accusative as ḥāl.

daas-irab:267-267.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَنْفِقُوا﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿مِنْ طَيِّباتِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنفقوا. ﴿ما كَسَبْتُمْ﴾: ما is a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كَسَبْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَمِمَّا﴾: conjoined to طيبات. ﴿أَخْرَجْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أخرجنا. ﴿مِنَ الْأَرْضِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أخرجنا. ﴿وَلا تَيَمَّمُوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾: prohibitive, making the verb jussive. ﴿تَيَمَّمُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿الْخَبِيثَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنْهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from الخبيث, or to تنفقون after it. ﴿تُنْفِقُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, with an omitted mafʿūl bihi, i.e. "you spend it"; the clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as ḥāl. ﴿وَلَسْتُمْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); laysa and its noun. ﴿بِآخِذِيهِ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of laysa, and the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; the clause is in the position of accusative as ḥāl. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنْ تُغْمِضُوا﴾: the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of genitive by a preposition, the implied form being "except by closing the eyes to it"; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to آخذيه. ﴿وَاعْلَمُوا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; اعلموا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٌ﴾: anna, the Name of Majesty is its noun, and غني and حميد are its two khabars; and anna with what it governs stands in place of the two objects of اعلموا.

daas-irab:268-268.t: ﴿الشَّيْطانُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَعِدُكُمُ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object. ﴿الْفَقْرَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), or accusative by removal of the preposition; the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿وَيَأْمُرُكُمْ بِالْفَحْشاءِ﴾: the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَاللَّهُ يَعِدُكُمْ مَغْفِرَةً﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) مغفرة. ﴿وَفَضْلًا﴾: conjoined to مغفرة. ﴿وَاللَّهُ واسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾: the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ, and its two khabars; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:269-270.t:
﴿يُؤْتِي﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma, and the fāʿil (agent) is "he". ﴿الْحِكْمَةَ﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative noun, second mafʿūl bihi; and the clause ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; من is a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يُؤْتَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter; it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is "he". ﴿الْحِكْمَةَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi, the nāʾib fāʿil being the first; and the clause ﴿وَمَنْ ... ﴾ is resumptive. ﴿فَقَدْ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿قد﴾: a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿أُوتِيَ﴾: a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil is "he". ﴿خَيْراً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كَثِيراً﴾: an adjective (ṣifa); and the clause ﴿قد أُوتِيَ ... ﴾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿ما﴾: negating. ﴿يَذَّكَّرُ﴾: an imperfect verb. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أُولُوا﴾: fāʿil, nominative with wāw because it is treated like a sound masculine plural. ﴿الْأَلْبابِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined.
﴿وَما أَنْفَقْتُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿ما﴾: a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَنْفَقْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ نَفَقَةٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿نَذَرْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ نَذْرٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نذرتم. ﴿فَإِنَّ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis. ﴿إن اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُهُ﴾: inna, the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause is its khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ما is negating. ﴿لِلظَّالِمِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿مِنْ أَنْصارٍ﴾: من is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; أنصار is a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:271-271.t: ﴿إِنْ تُبْدُوا﴾: إن is conditional; تبدوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿الصَّدَقاتِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with kasra; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَنِعِمَّا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); نعم is an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing praise, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun explained by what follows it. ﴿ما﴾: a complete indefinite (nakira tāmma), indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of accusative as tamyīz (specification); and the clause ﴿فَنِعِمَّا﴾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿هِيَ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being: "the deed (al-khaṣla) is it"; it is also said to be a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَإِنْ تُخْفُوها وَتُؤْتُوهَا الْفُقَراءَ﴾: إن is conditional; تخفوها is an imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; تؤتوها is likewise; and الفقراء is the second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis; هو and خير are mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) خير; the clause is the apodosis. ﴿وَيُكَفِّرُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; يكفر is a nominative (marfūʿ) imperfect verb. ﴿عَنْكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يكفر. ﴿مِنْ سَيِّئاتِكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of an omitted mafʿūl bihi, i.e. "some of your misdeeds"; it is also said that من is redundant (zāʾida). ﴿وَاللَّهُ بِما تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ﴾: the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ, and خبير is the khabar, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the clause is resumptive, and the clause تعملون is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.

daas-irab:272-272.t:
﴿لَيْسَ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿هُداهُمْ﴾: its noun, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلكِنَّ اللَّهَ يَهْدِي﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; lākinna, the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause يهدي is its khabar; the nominal clause is conjoined. ﴿مَنْ يَشاءُ﴾: من is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause يشاء is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَما تُنْفِقُوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is conditional, making the verb jussive, in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a fronted mafʿūl bihi of تنفقوا. ﴿مِنْ خَيْرٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَلِأَنْفُسِكُمْ﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); لأنفسكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being:
"a benefit for yourselves"; the clause is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis. ﴿وَما تُنْفِقُونَ﴾: ما is negating; تنفقون is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿إِلَّا ابْتِغاءَ﴾: إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ابتغاء is mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿وَجْهِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَما تُنْفِقُوا مِنْ خَيْرٍ﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿يُوَفَّ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis, by the dropping of the weak letter, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is "he". ﴿إِلَيْكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يوف. ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ لا تُظْلَمُونَ﴾: أنتم is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause تظلمون; and the clause ﴿أَنْتُمْ لا تُظْلَمُونَ﴾ is in the position of accusative as ḥāl.

daas-irab:120-120.t:
﴿وَلَنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; lan is a particle of negation, the subjunctive and futurity. ﴿تَرْضى﴾ an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) with the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif due to impossibility (taʿadhdhur). ﴿عَنْكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿الْيَهُودُ﴾ fāʿil (agent). ﴿وَلَا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; lā is negative. ﴿النَّصارى﴾ conjoined to اليهود; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya) and a preposition. ﴿تَتَّبِعَ﴾ an imperfect verb, subjunctive by an implied an after حتى; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as "you". The implied an and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of genitive by the preposition, the implied form being "until following their religion". ﴿مِلَّتَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "you"; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb (ḥarf mushabbah bi-l-fiʿl). ﴿هُدَى﴾ its noun, accusative with the implied fatḥa.
The clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿هُوَ﴾ a detached nominative pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿الْهُدى﴾ its khabar (predicate), nominative with the ḍamma implied on the alif. The nominal clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna. ﴿وَلَئِنِ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle; the lām paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam); in is a jussive conditional particle. ﴿اتَّبَعْتَ﴾ a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because of its connection with the tāʾ of the agent; the tāʾ is the fāʿil, and it is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿أَهْواءَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بَعْدَ﴾ an adverb of time attached to the verb اتبعت; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun in the position of genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿جاءَكَ﴾ a past verb and mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun referring to الذي. ﴿مِنَ الْعِلْمِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿ما لَكَ﴾ mā is negative, with no governing effect; لك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the postponed ولي. [Translator's note: so in the source; below, ولي is parsed as a mubtadaʾ, which implies لك is the fronted khabar.] ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by min; they are attached to an omitted ḥāl of ولي. ﴿مِنْ وَلِيٍّ﴾ min is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; ولي is a noun genitive in form and nominative in position as a postponed mubtadaʾ. The clause is the response to the oath, and the apodosis of the condition is omitted, indicated by this response to the oath. ﴿وَلا نَصِيرٍ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; lā is negative; نصير is conjoined to ولي.

daas-irab:121-121.t:
﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿آتَيْناهُمُ﴾ a past verb; نا is the fāʿil (agent) and the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿يَتْلُونَهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object; the clause is in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate). ﴿حَقَّ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿تِلاوَتِهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the hāʾ is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative indeclinable on the kasra in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ.
﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿بِهِ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them.
The nominal clause is in the position of nominative as a second khabar. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; man is a jussive conditional noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَكْفُرْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil is "he". ﴿بِهِ﴾ attached to يكفر. ﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis; أولئك is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿هُمُ الْخاسِرُونَ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is the khabar of أولئك.
The clause من يكفر is resumptive.

daas-irab:122-123.t: For their i'rab, see verses 47 and 48, for their i'rab has preceded.

daas-irab:124-124.t:
﴿وَإِذِ﴾ the wāw is resumptive. Idh is an adverb for past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb اذكر ("remember"), and it is in the position of accusative. ﴿ابْتَلى﴾ a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif due to impossibility (taʿadhdhur). ﴿إِبْراهِيمَ﴾ a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿رَبُّهُ﴾ a postponed fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿بِكَلِماتٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the verb ابتلى. ﴿فَأَتَمَّهُنَّ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; أتم is a past verb, the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as "he", referring to Ibrāhīm; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, and the fāʿil is "He", referring to Allah. ﴿إِنِّي﴾ a particle resembling the verb (ḥarf mushabbah bi-l-fiʿl), and the yāʾ is its noun. ﴿جاعِلُكَ﴾ its khabar (predicate), and the kāf is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾ attached to جاعل, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of إماما. ﴿إِماماً﴾ mafʿūl bihi of the active participle جاعل; the nominal clause إني جاعلك is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, and the fāʿil is "he", referring to Ibrāhīm. ﴿وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِي﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; ذريتي is a noun genitive with the kasra implied on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the yāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of genitive by iḍāfa. The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "make of my offspring an imam". The clause ﴿قالَ وَمِنْ﴾ is resumptive, and the clause ﴿وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِي﴾ is the object of the saying. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, and its fāʿil is a pronoun referring to Allah. ﴿لا يَنالُ﴾ lā is negative; ينال is an imperfect verb. ﴿عَهْدِي﴾ fāʿil, nominative with the ḍamma implied on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker. ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. It was also read with ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ in the nominative, as the fāʿil, with عهدي a fronted mafʿūl bihi.
The clause لا ينال عهدي الظالمين is the object of the saying, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. The clause قال is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:125-125.t:
﴿وَإِذْ﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿جَعَلْنَا﴾ a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and نا is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿الْبَيْتَ﴾ first mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿مَثابَةً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi of جعل. ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) مثابة or to an adjective of it. ﴿وَأَمْناً﴾ conjoined to مثابة; the clause is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿وَاتَّخِذُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; اتخذوا is an imperative verb indeclinable on dropping the nūn because of its connection with the wāw of the plural, and the wāw is an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil. The clause is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted verb conjoined to جعلنا, its implied form being "and We said: take…". ﴿مِنْ مَقامِ﴾ attached to اتخذوا, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of مصلى. ﴿إِبْراهِيمَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the fatḥa in place of the kasra, a diptote because of being a proper name and foreign. ﴿مُصَلًّى﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif due to impossibility (taʿadhdhur). ﴿وَعَهِدْنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; عهدنا is a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿إِلى إِبْراهِيمَ﴾ attached to the verb before them. ﴿وَإِسْماعِيلَ﴾ conjoined to ابراهيم. ﴿أَنْ﴾ explicative (tafsīriyya). ﴿طَهِّرا﴾ an imperative verb indeclinable on dropping the nūn, and the alif of the dual is the fāʿil. ﴿بَيْتِيَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the fatḥa implied on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the yāʾ is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿لِلطَّائِفِينَ﴾ a noun genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb. ﴿وَالْعاكِفِينَ﴾ a conjoined noun. ﴿وَالرُّكَّعِ السُّجُودِ﴾ two conjoined nouns, treated as a single noun because they are both of the prayer, which is one, so the conjunction was dropped. The clause عهدنا is conjoined to the clause جعلنا, and the clause طهرا is explicative, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:126-126.t:
﴿وَإِذْ﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿قالَ إِبْراهِيمُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿رَبِّ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), with the vocative yāʾ omitted, accusative with the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, which is dropped for lightness and is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa. [Translator's note: "the vocative yāʾ" here means the vocative particle يا.] ﴿اجْعَلْ﴾ an imperative verb for supplication, and its fāʿil is "you". ﴿هذا﴾ the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh), and dhā is a demonstrative indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn in the position of accusative as the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بَلَداً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿آمِناً﴾ an adjective of بلد. The clause رب اجعل is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَارْزُقْ﴾ conjoined to اجعل, and its fāʿil is "you". ﴿أَهْلَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنَ الثَّمَراتِ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb ارزق; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿مِنَ﴾ a relative noun indeclinable on the sukūn in the position of accusative as badal (substitute) of أهله. [Translator's note: the word is مَنْ.] ﴿آمَنَ﴾ a past verb, and its fāʿil is "he", referring to man; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of آمن. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, genitive by the bāʾ; they are attached to the verb آمن. ﴿وَالْيَوْمِ﴾ conjoined to الله. ﴿الْآخِرِ﴾ an adjective of اليوم. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, and its fāʿil is "He", Allah; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; man is a relative noun indeclinable on the sukūn in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being "and provide for whoever disbelieved"; this clause is the object of the saying, in the position of accusative. The clause ﴿كَفَرَ﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَأُمَتِّعُهُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; أمتعه is an imperfect verb and mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "I"; the clause is conjoined. ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾ an adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), its implied form being "I will give him enjoyment, a little enjoyment". ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿أَضْطَرُّهُ﴾ an imperfect verb and mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "I"; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلى عَذابِ﴾ attached to أضطره. ﴿النَّارِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَبِئْسَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; بئس is a non-inflecting (jāmid) past verb for creating blame (inshāʾ al-dhamm). ﴿الْمَصِيرُ﴾ the fāʿil of بئس; the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being "his destination"; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:127-128.t:
﴿وَإِذْ﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿يَرْفَعُ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿إِبْراهِيمُ﴾ fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa.
﴿الْقَواعِدَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنَ الْبَيْتِ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of القواعد. ﴿وَإِسْماعِيلُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; إسماعيل is conjoined to ابراهيم. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾ the one addressed (munādā), with the vocative yāʾ omitted, accusative; it is a muḍāf, and نا is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿تَقَبَّلْ﴾ an imperative verb for supplication, and the fāʿil is "you", referring to Allah. ﴿مِنَّا﴾ attached to the verb. The clause تقبل منا is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "they both say" or "they both supplicate". ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿أَنْتَ﴾ a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ﴾ two khabars (predicates); the nominal clause is the khabar of إنك. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾ its i'rab has preceded in the previous verse. ﴿وَاجْعَلْنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; اجعلنا is an imperative verb for supplication; نا is mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "you". ﴿مُسْلِمَيْنِ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the yāʾ because it is a dual. ﴿لَكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of المسلمين. ﴿وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "and make of our offspring"; this clause is conjoined to the clause اجعلنا. ﴿أُمَّةً﴾ the second mafʿūl bihi of the omitted verb اجعل, and the preposition and its genitive noun من ذريتنا are in the place of its first object. ﴿مُسْلِمَةً﴾ an adjective of أمة. ﴿لَكَ﴾ attached to مسلمة. ﴿وَأَرِنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; أرنا is an imperative verb for supplication, indeclinable (mabnī) on dropping the weak letter because the verb ends in a weak letter; نا is mafʿūl bihi and the fāʿil is "you". ﴿مَناسِكَنا﴾ the second mafʿūl bihi of أرنا; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَتُبْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; تب is an imperative verb for supplication, and the fāʿil is "you". ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾ attached to the verb تب; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿أَنْتَ﴾ a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ.
﴿التَّوَّابُ﴾ first khabar. ﴿الرَّحِيمُ﴾ second khabar; the nominal clause is the khabar of إنك.

daas-irab:129-129.t:
﴿رَبَّنا﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿وَابْعَثْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; ابعث — the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿فِيهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb ابعث. ﴿رَسُولًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ attached to an omitted adjective of رسول. ﴿يَتْلُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the wāw due to heaviness; the clause is in the position of accusative as an adjective of رسولا, or in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial), because رسولا has been qualified by منهم. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ attached to يتلو. ﴿آياتِكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; يعلمهم is an imperfect verb and its first mafʿūl bihi, and the mīm is for the masculine plural. ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وَالْحِكْمَةَ﴾ conjoined to الكتاب; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَيُزَكِّيهِمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; يزكي is an imperfect verb, nominative with the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ﴾ its i'rab is like the i'rab of إنك أنت السميع العليم before it.

daas-irab:130-130.t:
﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; man is an interrogative noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَرْغَبُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as "he". ﴿عَنْ مِلَّةِ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb يرغب. ﴿إِبْراهِيمَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the fatḥa because of being a proper name and foreign; the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of man. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun indeclinable on the sukūn in the position of nominative as badal (substitute) of the latent pronoun in يرغب. ﴿سَفِهَ﴾ a past verb, and the fāʿil is "he", referring to man. ﴿نَفْسَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); it is also said to be accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "he was foolish in himself". The clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَلَقَدِ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; the lām is for the oath; qad is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿اصْطَفَيْناهُ﴾ a past verb indeclinable on the sukūn; نا is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object.
﴿فِي الدُّنْيا﴾ attached to the verb before them. The clause occurs as the response to the oath. ﴿وَإِنَّهُ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial; inna is a particle resembling the verb (ḥarf mushabbah bi-l-fiʿl), and the hāʾ is its noun. ﴿فِي الْآخِرَةِ﴾ attached to الصالحين. ﴿لَمِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ﴾ the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); من الصالحين is attached to the omitted khabar of inna, the implied form being "he is counted among the righteous in the Hereafter". The clause ﴿وَإِنَّهُ فِي الْآخِرَةِ ... ﴾ is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

daas-irab:131-132.t:
﴿إِذْ﴾ its i'rab is like the i'rab of idh above. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿لَهُ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) قال. ﴿رَبُّهُ﴾ fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿أَسْلِمْ﴾ an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "you"; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir).
﴿أَسْلَمْتُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿لِرَبِّ﴾ attached to أسلمت. ﴿الْعالَمِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the yāʾ because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural. ﴿وَوَصَّى﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; وصى is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif due to impossibility (taʿadhdhur). ﴿بِها﴾ attached to وصى. ﴿إِبْراهِيمُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿بَنِيهِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with the yāʾ because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural; the hāʾ is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿وَيَعْقُوبُ﴾ conjoined to ابراهيم. ﴿يا بَنِيَّ﴾ yā is a vocative particle; بني is the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative with the yāʾ because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural; the nūn has been dropped for the iḍāfa, and the yāʾ is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb (ḥarf mushabbah bi-l-fiʿl). ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, the noun of inna. ﴿اصْطَفى﴾ a past verb; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿لَكُمُ﴾ attached to اصطفى. ﴿الدِّينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. The clause ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ ... ﴾ is the object of an omitted saying, on the tongue of Ibrāhīm. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa; lā is the jussive lā of prohibition. ﴿تَمُوتُنَّ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by dropping the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the dropped wāw is the fāʿil, its original form being تموتونن; the heavy nūn of emphasis has no grammatical position.
﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial; أنتم is a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مُسْلِمُونَ﴾ khabar, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and the clause تموتن is the apodosis of an implied condition.

daas-irab:200-201.t:
﴿فَإِذا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); إذا is an adverb (ẓarf) for future time. ﴿قَضَيْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿مَناسِكَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَاذْكُرُوا﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); اذكروا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿كَذِكْرِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣifa (adjective), i.e. "remember Allah with a remembrance like your remembrance of your fathers".
﴿آباءَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi of the maṣdar (verbal noun) ذكر, and the kāf is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿أَوْ أَشَدَّ﴾ أو is a conjunction; أشد is conjoined to ذكر, genitive (majrūr) with the fatḥa in place of the kasra, a diptote because it is an adjective on the pattern afʿal.
﴿ذِكْراً﴾ tamyīz (specification), accusative (manṣūb). ﴿فَمِنَ النَّاسِ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the nominative as a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَقُولُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil being "huwa" (he), referring to مَن; the verbal clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the clause من يقول is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾ the one addressed (munādā), muḍāf, accusative, and نا is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿آتِنا﴾ a verb of supplication (fiʿl duʿāʾ), indeclinable on the deletion of the weak letter, indicated by the kasra; the fāʿil is "anta" (you), نا is the first mafʿūl bihi, and the second object is omitted, i.e. "good". ﴿فِي الدُّنْيا﴾ both attached to the verb before them; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ما is negating. ﴿لَهُ﴾ both attached to an omitted, fronted khabar. ﴿فِي الْآخِرَةِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنْ خَلاقٍ﴾ من is a redundant (zāʾid) preposition; خلاق is a noun genitive in form and nominative in position as mubtadaʾ; the clause is circumstantial. ﴿وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَقُولُ: رَبَّنا آتِنا فِي الدُّنْيا﴾ see its i'rab in the previous verse. ﴿حَسَنَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَقِنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; قِ is a verb of supplication, indeclinable on the deletion of the weak letter; the fāʿil is "anta", referring to ربنا, and نا is the first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عَذابَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿النَّارِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause وقنا is conjoined to the clause آتنا, and so, like it, is the maqūl al-qawl.

daas-irab:202-202.t: ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the postponed نصيب. [Translator's note: so in the source; i.e. attached to an omitted, fronted khabar of نصيب.] ﴿نَصِيبٌ﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is the khabar of أولئك, and the clause أولئك is resumptive. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ ما is a relative noun in the position of the genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of نصيب. ﴿كَسَبُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ. ﴿سَرِيعُ﴾ khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿الْحِسابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

daas-irab:203-203.t:
﴿وَاذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ﴾ an imperative verb, the wāw is its fāʿil (agent) and the Name of Majesty its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِي أَيَّامٍ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them.
﴿مَعْدُوداتٍ﴾ ṣifa (adjective) of أيام. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); من is a jussive-governing conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿تَعَجَّلَ﴾ a past verb; it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the fāʿil being "huwa" (he). ﴿فِي يَوْمَيْنِ﴾ a noun genitive with the yāʾ because it is dual; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تعجل.
﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb); لا is the lā of generic negation. ﴿إِثْمَ﴾ its noun (ism), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to its omitted khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, and the clause of the protasis and its apodosis is the khabar of مَن. ﴿وَمَنْ تَأَخَّرَ فَلا إِثْمَ عَلَيْهِ﴾ parsed like the one before it, and it is conjoined. ﴿لِمَنِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted khabar, the implied form being: "that", attached to its omitted khabar; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, and the clause of the protasis and its apodosis is the khabar of مَن. ﴿وَمَنْ تَأَخَّرَ فَلا إِثْمَ عَلَيْهِ﴾ parsed like the one before it, and it is conjoined. [Translator's note: the passage from the first ﴿لِمَنِ﴾ to this point is a garbled duplication in the source; the complete statement follows.] ﴿لِمَنِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted khabar, the implied form being: "that delaying or hastening is for whoever is mindful of Allah". ﴿اتَّقى﴾ a past verb; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَاتَّقُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; اتقوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَاعْلَمُوا﴾ conjoined to اتقوا. ﴿أَنَّكُمْ﴾ أنّ and its noun; أنّ and what follows it stand in place of the two objects of اعلموا. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ both attached to the verb after them. ﴿تُحْشَرُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the khabar of إنّ. [Translator's note: so in the source; the particle is أنّ.]

daas-irab:204-205.t:
﴿وَمِنَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿مِنَ النَّاسِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنَ﴾ a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿مِنَ﴾; the relative noun is ﴿مَنْ﴾.] ﴿يُعْجِبُكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the kāf is its object. ﴿قَوْلُهُ﴾ its postponed fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿فِي الْحَياةِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb before them. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ ṣifa (adjective) of الحياة. ﴿وَيُشْهِدُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); يشهد is an imperfect verb, the fāʿil being "huwa" (he). ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَلى ما﴾ ما is a relative noun in the position of the genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يشهد. ﴿فِي قَلْبِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); هو is mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَلَدُّ﴾ its khabar. ﴿الْخِصامِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is circumstantial. ﴿وَإِذا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; إذا is an adverb (ẓarf) for future time, attached to يشهد. [Translator's note: so in the source; the governing verb would ordinarily be سعى.] ﴿تَوَلَّى﴾ a past verb, the fāʿil being "huwa"; the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position. [Translator's note: so in the source; the apodosis is ordinarily سعى, while تولى is in the position of the genitive by annexation.] ﴿سَعى﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ both attached to سعى. ﴿لِيُفْسِدَ﴾ the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl); يفسد is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an أن concealed after the lām of causation, the fāʿil being "huwa", referring to مَن; أن and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) in the position of the genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يسعى. ﴿فِيها﴾ both attached to يفسد. ﴿وَيُهْلِكَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; يهلك is an imperfect verb. ﴿الْحَرْثَ﴾ its object.
﴿وَالنَّسْلَ﴾ conjoined; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; الله, the Name of Majesty, is mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿لا يُحِبُّ الْفَسادَ﴾ is its khabar; the nominal clause والله is resumptive.

daas-irab:206-206.t:
﴿وَإِذا﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); إذا is an adverb (ẓarf) for future time, putting its condition in the genitive and itself made accusative by its apodosis (jawāb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) أخذته.
﴿قِيلَ﴾ a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is omitted, its implied form being "the saying". ﴿لَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to قيل. ﴿اتَّقِ﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the weak letter, the fāʿil (agent) being "anta" (you). ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying), and the clause قيل is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿أَخَذَتْهُ﴾ a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿الْعِزَّةُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿بِالْإِثْمِ﴾ both attached to أخذته; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿فَحَسْبُهُ﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition); حسب is a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿جَهَنَّمُ﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is the apodosis of an implied non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position.
﴿وَلَبِئْسَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; the lām occurs in the response to an oath (jawāb al-qasam); بئس is a non-inflecting (jāmid) past verb for blame. ﴿الْمِهادُ﴾ fāʿil, and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, i.e. "it"; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the response to the oath.

daas-irab:207-208.t:
﴿وَمِنَ النَّاسِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنَ﴾ a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿مِنَ﴾; the relative noun is ﴿مَنْ﴾.] ﴿يَشْرِي﴾ an imperfect verb, the fāʿil (agent) being "huwa" (he). ﴿نَفْسَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿ابْتِغاءَ﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿مَرْضاتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; the nominal clause من الناس is conjoined, and the clause يشري is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); الله, the Name of Majesty, is mubtadaʾ. ﴿رَؤُفٌ﴾ khabar. ﴿بِالْعِبادِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to رؤوف. ﴿يا أَيُّهَا﴾ يا is a vocative particle; أيّ is the one addressed (munādā), a specific indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, and ها is for drawing attention (tanbīh). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as a badal (substitute). ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿ادْخُلُوا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿فِي السِّلْمِ﴾ both attached to ادخلوا.
﴿كَافَّةً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb). ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; لا is the prohibitive, jussive-governing lā. ﴿تَتَّبِعُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿خُطُواتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural; the clause is conjoined to the clause ادخلوا. ﴿الشَّيْطانِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ إنّ and its noun (ism). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to عدو. ﴿عَدُوٌّ﴾ its khabar. ﴿مُبِينٌ﴾ ṣifa (adjective); the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:209-209.t: ﴿فَإِنْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); إن is a jussive-governing conditional particle. ﴿زَلَلْتُمْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) زللتم. ﴿ما﴾ maṣdariyya (infinitival). ﴿جاءَتْكُمُ﴾ a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الْبَيِّناتُ﴾ fāʿil; ما with the verb is interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَاعْلَمُوا﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); اعلموا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ﴾ أنّ, the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism) and عزيز its khabar (predicate). ﴿حَكِيمٌ﴾ a second khabar; أنّ and what follows it stand in place of the two objects of اعلموا.

daas-irab:210-211.t:
﴿هَلْ﴾ an interrogative particle. ﴿يَنْظُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنْ﴾ a maṣdar-forming particle that puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿يَأْتِيَهُمُ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb); أن and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿فِي ظُلَلٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿مِنَ الْغَمامِ﴾ both attached to an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of ظلل. ﴿وَالْمَلائِكَةُ﴾ conjoined to الله. ﴿وَقُضِيَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); قضي is a passive past verb. ﴿الْأَمْرُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). It has also been said that the wāw is a conjunction and قضي has the sense of the imperfect, conjoined to ينظرون. ﴿وَإِلَى اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by إلى; both are attached to ترجع. ﴿تُرْجَعُ الْأُمُورُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb and its nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿سَلْ﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, the fāʿil being "anta" (you). ﴿بَنِي﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural, the nūn having been deleted for annexation. ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the fatḥa, a diptote because of being a proper name and foreign. ﴿كَمْ﴾ the predicative kam (khabariyya) expressing abundance, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). It has also been said that it is interrogative, a fronted mafʿūl bihi. ﴿آتَيْناهُمْ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn; نا is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ كم. ﴿مِنْ آيَةٍ﴾ من is a redundant (zāʾid) preposition; آية is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position as tamyīz (specification). ﴿بَيِّنَةٍ﴾ ṣifa of آية. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; من is a jussive-governing conditional noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿يُبَدِّلْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿نِعْمَةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi.
﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ both attached to يبدل. ﴿ما جاءَتْهُ﴾ the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَإِنَّ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿إن اللَّهَ شَدِيدُ﴾ إنّ, the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism) and شديد its khabar.
﴿الْعِقابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.

daas-irab:212-212.t:
﴿زُيِّنَ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) زين. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿الْحَياةُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ ṣifa (adjective) of الحياة; the clause زين is resumptive.
﴿وَيَسْخَرُونَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; يسخرون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مِنَ الَّذِينَ﴾ both attached to يسخرون. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿اتَّقَوْا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿فَوْقَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of place, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of الذين.
﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time, also attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the nominal clause والذين اتقوا is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَرْزُقُ﴾ an imperfect verb, the fāʿil being "huwa" (He); the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause ﴿اللَّهُ يَرْزُقُ﴾ is resumptive. ﴿مِنَ﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿مِنَ﴾; the relative noun is ﴿مَنْ﴾.] ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, and the fāʿil is "huwa". ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾ both attached to يرزق. ﴿حِسابٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:53-54.t:
﴿وَإِذْ﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿آتَيْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مُوسَى﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَالْفُرْقانَ﴾: a noun conjoined to الكتاب. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾: لعل and its noun. ﴿تَهْتَدُونَ﴾: the clause is the khabar (predicate).
The nominal clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿وَإِذْ﴾: conjoined. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb. ﴿مُوسى﴾: fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِقَوْمِهِ﴾: both attached to (mutaʿalliq) قال. ﴿يا قَوْمِ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), annexed (muḍāf), accusative with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person; the yāʾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿إِنَّكُمْ﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿ظَلَمْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿أَنْفُسَكُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ. ﴿بِاتِّخاذِكُمُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb before them. ﴿الْعِجْلَ﴾: first object of the maṣdar (verbal noun) اتخاذ.
The second object is omitted, its implied form being "باتخاذكم العجل معبودا أو ربا" (by your taking the calf as an object of worship, or as a lord). ﴿فَتُوبُوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, on the implied form "إذا كنتم فعلتم ذلك فتوبوا" (since you have done that, then repent). توبوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. The clause is conjoined to the clause ظلمتم. ﴿إِلى بارِئِكُمْ﴾: both attached to توبوا. ﴿فَاقْتُلُوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَنْفُسَكُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ذلِكُمْ﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾: its khabar. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: both attached to the elative (ism al-tafḍīl) خير. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾: mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of place attached to خير. The clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿بارِئِكُمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَتابَ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; the clause تاب is conjoined. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: both attached to the verb. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿هُوَ﴾: a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿التَّوَّابُ﴾: khabar of إنّ. And ﴿الرَّحِيمُ﴾: a second khabar of إنّ. The clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:55-56.t:
﴿وَإِذْ﴾: adverbial. ﴿قُلْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿يا مُوسى﴾: the one addressed (munādā), a singular proper noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma, in the position of accusative. ﴿لَنْ﴾: a particle making the verb subjunctive. ﴿نُؤْمِنَ﴾: an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb), and the fāʿil is "نحن" (we); the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لَكَ﴾: both attached to (mutaʿalliq) نؤمن. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit and a preposition. ﴿نَرَى﴾: an imperfect verb, subjunctive by an implied أن after حتى, with an implied fatḥa, and the fāʿil is "نحن". The maṣdar is in the position of genitive by حتى, the implied form being "حتى رؤية الله" (until the seeing of Allah). ﴿اللَّهَ﴾: the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿جَهْرَةً﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, i.e. "openly" (جاهرين); or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿فَأَخَذَتْكُمُ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿الصَّاعِقَةُ﴾: fāʿil, nominative. ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); أنتم is mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿تَنْظُرُونَ﴾ is its khabar (predicate). The clause وأنتم تنظرون is circumstantial. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿بَعَثْناكُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾: both attached to بعثناكم. ﴿مَوْتِكُمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾: لعل and its noun.
﴿تَشْكُرُونَ﴾: the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of لعل. The nominal clause لعلكم is circumstantial.

daas-irab:57-58.t:
﴿ظَلَّلْنا﴾: We made it give shade. ﴿الْغَمامَ﴾: the clouds. ﴿الْمَنَّ﴾: a kind of plant used as food. ﴿السَّلْوى﴾: a kind of bird. ﴿حِطَّةٌ﴾: "that You forgive us".
﴿وَظَلَّلْنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ظللنا is a past verb, and نا is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿عَلَيْكُمُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) ظللنا. ﴿الْغَمامَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَأَنْزَلْنا عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَنَّ وَالسَّلْوى﴾: like the clause before it, and it is conjoined to it. ﴿كُلُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is mafʿūl bihi of the omitted verb قلنا (We said).
﴿مِنْ طَيِّباتِ﴾: both attached to the verb كلوا. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿رَزَقْناكُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. The omitted clause قلنا is conjoined. ﴿وَما ظَلَمُونا﴾: ما is negative; ظلموا is a past verb and its fāʿil, and نا is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to the omitted [clause]: "فظلموا أنفسهم وما ظلمونا" (so they wronged themselves, and they did not wrong Us). ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk). ﴿كانُوا﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb [one of kāna and its sisters], and the wāw is its noun.
﴿أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾: a fronted mafʿūl bihi of يظلمون. ﴿يَظْلِمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of كانوا. The clause كانوا is circumstantial. ﴿وَإِذْ﴾: its i'rab has been repeated. ﴿قُلْنَا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿ادْخُلُوا﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). The clause قلنا is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿هذِهِ﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable on kasra, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa); it is also said to be accusative as an adverb of place. ﴿الْقَرْيَةَ﴾: a badal (substitute), accusative. ﴿فَكُلُوا﴾: the clause is conjoined to ادخلوا. ﴿مِنْها﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to كلوا. ﴿حَيْثُ﴾: mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of place, indeclinable on ḍamma, attached to the verb; it is also said to be attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial): "متنقلين حيث شئتم" (moving about wherever you wish). ﴿شِئْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿رَغَداً﴾: a ḥāl, accusative. ﴿وَادْخُلُوا﴾: conjoined to كلوا. ﴿الْبابَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi by extension.
﴿سُجَّداً﴾: a ḥāl, accusative. ﴿وَقُولُوا﴾: conjoined to ادخلوا. ﴿حِطَّةٌ﴾: khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "شأننا حطة" (our concern is حطة). The clause is maqūl al-qawl. ﴿نَغْفِرْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to a command (jawāb al-ṭalab), and the fāʿil is "نحن" (We). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: both attached to نغفر. ﴿خَطاياكُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَسَنَزِيدُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the sīn is for the future; نزيد is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is "نحن". ﴿الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the yāʾ. The clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa).

daas-irab:59-60.t:
﴿رِجْزاً﴾: a punishment. ﴿اسْتَسْقى﴾: he asked for water. ﴿عثا﴾: he did mischief.
﴿فَبَدَّلَ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; بدل is a past verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, fāʿil (agent). ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil.
The clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿قَوْلًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿غَيْرَ﴾: a naʿt (adjective), accusative. ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿قِيلَ﴾: a passive past verb. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), or to the verb before them. The clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَأَنْزَلْنا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the clause أنزلنا is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿عَلَى الَّذِينَ﴾: both attached to أنزلنا. ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun.
﴿رِجْزاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb, or to an omitted naʿt of رجز. ﴿بِما كانُوا يَفْسُقُونَ﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition; ما is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by the preposition, i.e. "بسبب فسقهم" (because of their transgression).
﴿كانُوا﴾: كان and its noun. ﴿يَفْسُقُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause يفسقون is in the position of accusative as its khabar (predicate). ﴿وَإِذِ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and إذ is an adverb of time attached to the omitted verb اذكر (remember). ﴿اسْتَسْقى﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa.
﴿مُوسى﴾: fāʿil. ﴿لِقَوْمِهِ﴾: both attached to استسقى. The clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿فَقُلْنَا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; قلنا is a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿اضْرِبْ﴾: an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "أنت" (you); the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿بِعَصاكَ﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition; عصا is a noun, genitive with an implied kasra on the alif because of impossibility, and the kāf is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿الْحَجَرَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَانْفَجَرَتْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the clause انفجرت is conjoined to an omitted clause, the implied form being "فضرب بعصاه الحجر فانفجرت" (so he struck the rock with his staff, and there gushed forth). ﴿مِنْهُ﴾: both attached to انفجرت. ﴿اثْنَتا﴾: fāʿil, nominative with the alif because it is assimilated to the dual. ﴿عَشْرَةَ﴾: a [compound] part with no grammatical position. ﴿عَيْناً﴾: tamyīz (specification), accusative. ﴿قَدْ﴾: a particle of realization (taḥqīq).
﴿عَلِمَ﴾: a past verb. ﴿كُلُّ﴾: fāʿil. ﴿أُناسٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مَشْرَبَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿كُلُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; likewise ﴿وَاشْرَبُوا﴾. The two clauses are in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl of an omitted verb. ﴿مِنْ رِزْقِ﴾: both attached to the verb before them. ﴿وَلا تَعْثَوْا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is the prohibitive lā that makes the verb jussive; تعثوا is jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn from its end; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: both attached to the verb before them.
﴿مُفْسِدِينَ﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative with the yāʾ.

daas-irab:61-61.t:
﴿البقل﴾: plants that have no stalk. ﴿الفوم﴾: wheat, or garlic.
﴿وَإِذْ قُلْتُمْ يا مُوسى﴾: see verse 55. ﴿لَنْ﴾: a particle making the verb subjunctive. ﴿نَصْبِرَ﴾: an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb), and the fāʿil (agent) is "نحن" (we); the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿عَلى طَعامٍ﴾: both attached to (mutaʿalliq) نصبر. ﴿واحِدٍ﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of طعام. ﴿فَادْعُ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; ادع is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil is "أنت" (you); the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿لَنا﴾: both attached to the verb before them. ﴿رَبَّكَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the kāf is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿يُخْرِجْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to a command (jawāb al-ṭalab), and the fāʿil is "هو" (He); the clause is the answer to the command, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَنا﴾: both attached to يخرج. ﴿مِمَّا﴾: من is a preposition; ما is a relative noun in the position of genitive by the preposition; both are attached to the verb before them. ﴿تُنْبِتُ الْأَرْضُ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ بَقْلِها﴾: both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the omitted pronoun, the implied form being "مما تنبته" (of what it grows); it is also said that they are a badal (substitute) from مما. ها is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿وَقِثَّائِها وَفُومِها وَعَدَسِها وَبَصَلِها﴾: conjoined. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb, and the fāʿil is "هو" (he); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿أَتَسْتَبْدِلُونَ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; ﴿تَسْتَبْدِلُونَ﴾ is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is maqūl al-qawl. ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿هُوَ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَدْنى﴾: its khabar (predicate). The clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿بِالَّذِي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb. ﴿هُوَ خَيْرٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is the ṣila.
﴿اهْبِطُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is maqūl al-qawl of an omitted verb, its implied form being "قلنا" (We said).
﴿مِصْراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَإِنَّ﴾: the fāʾ is causal (taʿlīl); إنّ is a particle resembling the verb (one of inna and its sisters). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: both attached to the omitted fronted khabar of إنّ.
﴿ما سَأَلْتُمْ﴾: ما is a relative noun, the noun of إنّ; سألتم: سألت is a past verb and its fāʿil, and the mīm is for the masculine plural. The returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, its implied form being "ما سألتمونا إياه" (what you asked Us for). The clause is the ṣila, and the clause إن لكم is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَضُرِبَتْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ضربت is a passive past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿عَلَيْهِمُ﴾: both attached to ضربت. ﴿الذِّلَّةُ﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative. ﴿وَالْمَسْكَنَةُ﴾: a conjoined noun; the clause is resumptive, and it is also said to be parenthetical (muʿtariḍa). ﴿وَباؤُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِغَضَبٍ﴾: both attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾: both attached to a naʿt of غضب: "غضب نازل من الله" (wrath descending from Allah). ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿بِأَنَّهُمْ﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition; أنهم is أنّ and its noun. ﴿كانُوا﴾: كان, and the wāw is its noun; the clause is the khabar of أنّ. أنّ and what follows it are, by interpretation, a maṣdar in the position of genitive by the preposition, i.e. "بسبب كفرهم" (because of their disbelief). The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَكْفُرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِآياتِ﴾: both attached to يكفرون. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَيَقْتُلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿النَّبِيِّينَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the yāʾ, a sound masculine plural. The clause يكفرون is in the position of accusative as the khabar of كانوا, and the clause يقتلون is conjoined to يكفرون.
﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾: both attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "عاملين بغير الحق" (acting without right). ﴿الْحَقِّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿بِما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition; ما is maṣdariyya. ﴿عَصَوْا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; ما al-maṣdariyya with the verb is, by interpretation, a maṣdar in the position of genitive by the preposition. The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ ذلك, the implied form being "ذلك بسبب عصيانهم" (that is because of their disobedience). ﴿وَكانُوا﴾: كان and its noun; the clause is conjoined. The clause ﴿يَعْتَدُونَ﴾ is its khabar.

daas-irab:273-273.t:
﴿لِلْفُقَراءِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), the implied form being: "the charities are for the poor". ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of genitive as an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿أُحْصِرُوا﴾: a passive past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿فِي سَبِيلِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أحصروا. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ﴾: لا is negating; يستطيعون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿ضَرْباً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ضربا.
