﴿يَحْسَبُهُمُ الْجاهِلُ أَغْنِياءَ مِنَ التَّعَفُّفِ﴾: يحسبهم is an imperfect verb and its two objects, and الجاهل is the fāʿil; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them; the clause is in the position of accusative as ḥāl. ﴿تَعْرِفُهُمْ بِسِيماهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil is "you" (anta); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿لا يَسْئَلُونَ النَّاسَ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a fourth ḥāl. ﴿إِلْحافاً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "they importune importunately"; it is also said to be a ḥāl or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿وَما تُنْفِقُوا مِنْ خَيْرٍ﴾: the i'rab of something similar to it preceded in the previous verse. ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ بِهِ عَلِيمٌ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); inna, the Name of Majesty is its noun and عليم is its khabar; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to عليم; the clause is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis.

daas-irab:274-274.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يُنْفِقُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb. ﴿أَمْوالَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿بِاللَّيْلِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ينفقون. ﴿وَالنَّهارِ﴾: conjoined. ﴿سِرًّا وَعَلانِيَةً﴾: two ḥāls (circumstantials), i.e. "doing it secretly and openly". ﴿فَلَهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a linking fāʾ, because of the conditional meaning contained in the relative noun. ﴿لهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿أَجْرُهُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾: an adverb, attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. [Translator's note: so in the source; the clause فلهم أجرهم is ordinarily the khabar of the mubtadaʾ الذين.] ﴿وَلا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ﴾: its i'rab has been repeated before.

daas-irab:275-275.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ يَأْكُلُونَ الرِّبا﴾: in i'rab like the words of the Exalted ﴿الَّذِينَ يُنْفِقُونَ أَمْوالَهُمْ﴾. ﴿لا يَقُومُونَ﴾: لا is negating; يقومون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿كَما﴾: the kāf is a preposition; ما is the maṣdar-particle. ﴿يَقُومُ﴾: an imperfect verb; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from ما and the verb is in the position of genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), the implied form being: "they do not stand except with a standing like the standing of the one who ...". ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun, fāʿil; and the clause لا يقومون is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) الذين. ﴿يَتَخَبَّطُهُ الشَّيْطانُ مِنَ الْمَسِّ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object, and الشيطان is the fāʿil; من المس is attached to يقومون or to يتخبطه; and the clause يتخبطه is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿بِأَنَّهُمْ﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition; أنهم is anna and its noun, and the clause ﴿قالُوا﴾ is its khabar; anna with its noun and khabar is interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ ذلك, i.e. "that is because of their saying"; the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّمَا الْبَيْعُ مِثْلُ الرِّبا﴾: إنما is إنما, a restraining particle and the particle it restrains (kāffa wa-makfūfa); البيع and مثل are mubtadaʾ and khabar; الربا is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَأَحَلَّ اللَّهُ الْبَيْعَ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and a past verb; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil and البيع is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَحَرَّمَ الرِّبا﴾: conjoined to it. ﴿فَمَنْ جاءَهُ مَوْعِظَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; من is a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ; and a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and موعظة is the fāʿil; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb, which is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿فَانْتَهى﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the clause انتهى is conjoined to جاءه. ﴿فَلَهُ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ ﴿ما﴾. And the clause ﴿سَلَفَ﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun ما. ﴿وَأَمْرُهُ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; أمره is a nominative mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلَى اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive by إلى, and the two are attached to the omitted khabar; the clause is a ḥāl clause; and the clause ﴿فَلَهُ ما سَلَفَ﴾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿وَمَنْ عادَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; من is a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ; عاد is in the position of jussive as the protasis. ﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis; أولئك is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَصْحابُ﴾: khabar. ﴿النَّارِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause ﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾ is the apodosis. ﴿هُمْ فِيها خالِدُونَ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to خالدون; the clause is a ḥāl clause.

daas-irab:276-276.t: ﴿يَمْحَقُ اللَّهُ الرِّبا﴾: an imperfect verb, the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent) and الربا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَيُرْبِي الصَّدَقاتِ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is "he", referring to Allah; الصدقات is mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with kasra because it is a sound feminine plural; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; الله, the Name of Majesty, is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لا يُحِبُّ﴾: لا is negating; يحب is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is "he". ﴿كُلَّ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كَفَّارٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَثِيمٍ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa).

daas-irab:277-277.t: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾: inna and its noun; آمنوا is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحاتِ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined; and likewise the two clauses ﴿وَأَقامُوا الصَّلاةَ﴾ ﴿وَآتَوُا الزَّكاةَ﴾, conjoined to what precedes. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿أَجْرُهُمْ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar of inna. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾: an adverb of place, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from أجرهم. ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ﴾: for its i'rab see verse 274.

daas-irab:278-278.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾: for its i'rab see verse 254. ﴿اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the Name of Majesty is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَذَرُوا﴾: conjoined to واتقوا. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بَقِيَ﴾: a past verb, and its fāʿil is "he"; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿مِنَ الرِّبا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) بقي. ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: إن is a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive; كنتم is a past verb and the tāʾ is its noun; it is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: its khabar (predicate), accusative (manṣūb) with yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being: "if you are believers, then abandon what remains of usury".

daas-irab:279-279.t: ﴿فَإِنْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إن is conditional. ﴿لَمْ﴾: making the verb jussive. ﴿تَفْعَلُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿فَأْذَنُوا﴾: the fāʾ is linking, and أذنوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿بِحَرْبٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) اذنوا. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive by من, and the two are attached to an adjective of حرب. ﴿وَرَسُولِهِ﴾: conjoined to الله; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿وَإِنْ تُبْتُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and إن is conditional; تبتم is a past verb and the tāʾ is the fāʿil; it is in the position of jussive as the protasis. ﴿فَلَكُمْ رُؤُسُ أَمْوالِكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) رؤوس. ﴿أَمْوالِكُمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿لا تظلمون﴾: لا is negating; تظلمون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَلا تُظْلَمُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:280-280.t:
﴿وَإِنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إن is a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive. ﴿كانَ ذُو عُسْرَةٍ﴾: a complete (tāmm) past verb, and ذو is its fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) with wāw because it is one of the five nouns, and عسرة is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَنَظِرَةٌ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); نظرة is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being:
"then the matter is a deferral ...". ﴿إِلى مَيْسَرَةٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) نظرة; the clause is the apodosis. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾: a maṣdar-particle that makes the verb subjunctive. [Translator's note: so in the source, written ﴿وَإِنْ﴾; the verse reads وَأَنْ.] ﴿تَصَدَّقُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (subjunctive) by the dropping of the nūn; with an it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, its implied form being: "and your giving in charity is better for you". ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾. ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ﴾: for its i'rab see the preceding verse 277. [Translator's note: so in the source; the similar phrase إن كنتم مؤمنين is parsed at verse 278.]

daas-irab:281-281.t: ﴿وَاتَّقُوا يَوْماً﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اتقوا is an imperative verb, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and يوما is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined. ﴿تُرْجَعُونَ فِيهِ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); فيه is attached to (mutaʿalliq) ترجعون, as is the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿إِلَى اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive by إلى, and the two are attached to ترجعون. ﴿ثُمَّ تُوَفَّى كُلُّ نَفْسٍ﴾: a passive imperfect verb and its nāʾib fāʿil, which is the first object, and نفس is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ما كَسَبَتْ﴾: ما is a relative noun, second mafʿūl bihi, and the clause كسبت is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَهُمْ لا يُظْلَمُونَ﴾: the clause لا يظلمون is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) هم; and the clause ﴿وَهُمْ لا يُظْلَمُونَ﴾ is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:133-133.t: ﴿أَمْ﴾ a connected (muttaṣila) conjunction, or in the sense of bal, in which case it is disconnected (munqaṭiʿa). ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿شُهَداءَ﴾ its khabar (predicate). ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb for past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) شهداء, in the position of accusative. ﴿حَضَرَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿يَعْقُوبَ﴾ a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الْمَوْتُ﴾ a postponed fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb, badal (substitute) of the first idh. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, and the fāʿil is "he"; the clause is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿لِبَنِيهِ﴾ the lām is a preposition; بني is a noun genitive with the yāʾ because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural; they are attached to the verb قال. ﴿ما تَعْبُدُونَ﴾ mā is an interrogative noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn in the position of accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi; تعبدون is an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِي﴾ بعدي is a noun genitive with the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the yāʾ is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa; they are attached to تعبدون. The clause ﴿ما تَعْبُدُونَ ... ﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿نَعْبُدُ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿إِلهَكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَإِلهَ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿آبائِكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِبْراهِيمَ﴾ badal of آبائك, genitive with the fatḥa in place of the kasra because it is a diptote, being a proper name and foreign. ﴿وَإِسْماعِيلَ وَإِسْحاقَ﴾ conjoined to ابراهيم. ﴿إِلهاً﴾ badal of إله آبائك, accusative. ﴿واحِداً﴾ an adjective of إله. The clause ﴿نَعْبُدُ إِلهَكَ﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi of قالوا. ﴿وَنَحْنُ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial; نحن is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to مسلمون. ﴿مُسْلِمُونَ﴾ khabar, nominative with the wāw; the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

daas-irab:134-135.t:
﴿تِلْكَ﴾ a demonstrative indeclinable (mabnī) on the kasra in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿أُمَّةٌ﴾ khabar (predicate), nominative; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿خَلَتْ﴾ a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as "she". ﴿لَها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar; the clause is in the position of nominative as an adjective of أمة. ﴿ما كَسَبَتْ﴾ mā is a relative noun indeclinable on the sukūn in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; كسبت is a past verb, the tāʾ is for the feminine, and the fāʿil is "she"; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلَكُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لَكُمْ ما كَسَبْتُمْ﴾ like لها ما كسبت; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿تُسْئَلُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَمَّا﴾ the preposition and the genitive relative noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna, and the wāw is its noun. ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of kāna, and the clause كانوا يعملون is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَقالُوا﴾ the wāw is resumptive; قالوا is a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿كُونُوا﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperative verb indeclinable on dropping the nūn, and the wāw is its noun.
﴿هُوداً﴾ its khabar. ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿نَصارى﴾ a conjoined noun, accusative with the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif due to impossibility (taʿadhdhur).
﴿تَهْتَدُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the response to the command (jawāb al-ṭalab), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn from its end; the wāw is the fāʿil. The clause كونوا هودا is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "you", referring to the Prophet ﷺ. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction. ﴿مِلَّةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "follow". ﴿إِبْراهِيمَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the object of the saying.
﴿حَنِيفاً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial) of ابراهيم. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; mā is negative. ﴿كانَ﴾ a defective past verb; its noun is a latent pronoun implied as "he", referring to Ibrāhīm. ﴿مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ﴾ attached to the omitted khabar of kāna.

daas-irab:136-136.t:
﴿قُولُوا﴾ an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on dropping the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿آمَنَّا﴾ a past verb, and نا is the fāʿil. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; mā is a relative noun indeclinable on the sukūn in the position of genitive. ﴿أُنْزِلَ﴾ a passive past verb, and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is "it". ﴿إِلَيْنا﴾ attached to أنزل; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the clause آمنا is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَما أُنْزِلَ إِلى إِبْراهِيمَ﴾ conjoined to the two preceding. ﴿وَإِسْماعِيلَ وَإِسْحاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ﴾ conjoined nouns, genitive with the fatḥa in place of the kasra because they are foreign proper names. ﴿الْأَسْباطِ﴾ a conjoined noun.
﴿وَما﴾ a conjoined relative noun. ﴿أُوتِيَ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿مُوسى﴾ nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿وَعِيسى﴾ a conjoined noun; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿وَما أُوتِيَ النَّبِيُّونَ﴾ its i'rab is like the i'rab of the preceding one. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ﴾ attached to the verb before them; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿لا نُفَرِّقُ﴾ lā is negative, and an imperfect verb; the fāʿil is "we". ﴿بَيْنَ﴾ an adverb of place attached to the verb نفرق. ﴿أَحَدٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ attached to an adjective of أحد; the clause is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial), and likewise the clause ﴿وَنَحْنُ لَهُ مُسْلِمُونَ﴾.

daas-irab:137-137.t:
﴿فَإِنْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; in is a jussive conditional particle. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); it is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿بِمِثْلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿آمَنْتُمْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿بِهِ﴾ attached to آمنتم. ﴿فَقَدِ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis of the condition; qad is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿اهْتَدَوْا﴾ a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿إِنْ تَوَلَّوْا﴾ the clause is conjoined to the clause آمنوا. ﴿فَإِنَّما﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis of the condition; إنما is the restraining (kāffa) and restrained (makfūfa) particles. ﴿هُمْ﴾ a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿فِي شِقاقٍ﴾ attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of هم; the nominal clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿فَسَيَكْفِيكَهُمُ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; the sīn is for futurity; يكفي is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ due to heaviness; the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the hāʾ the second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; هو is mubtadaʾ. ﴿السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ﴾ two khabars of the mubtadaʾ.

daas-irab:138-138.t:
﴿صِبْغَةَ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, the implied form being "Allah has dyed us with a dye". ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍ); man is an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَحْسَنُ﴾ its khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) the elative (ism al-tafḍīl) أحسن.
﴿صِبْغَةَ﴾ tamyīz (specification). ﴿وَنَحْنُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; نحن is mubtadaʾ. ﴿لَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to عابدون. ﴿عابِدُونَ﴾ khabar; the clause is conjoined to His saying آمنا بالله, and the clause ومن أحسن من الله is parenthetical, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:139-139.t:
﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "you". ﴿أَتُحَاجُّونَنا﴾ the hamza is for interrogation; تحاجوننا is an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw is the fāʿil and نا is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فِي اللَّهِ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), and the clause قل is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial; هو is a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿رَبُّنا﴾ its khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَرَبُّكُمْ﴾ conjoined to ربنا. ﴿وَلَنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; لنا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿أَعْمالُنا﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is conjoined to the clause before it, and likewise the clause ﴿وَلَكُمْ أَعْمالُكُمْ﴾.
﴿وَنَحْنُ لَهُ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial; نحن is mubtadaʾ, whose khabar is ﴿مُخْلِصُونَ﴾, to which the preposition and its genitive noun له are attached.

daas-irab:140-140.t:
﴿أَمْ﴾ a connected (muttaṣila) conjunction, or disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) in the sense of bal. ﴿تَقُولُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to the clause أتحاجوننا. ﴿إِنَّ إِبْراهِيمَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿وَإِسْماعِيلَ وَإِسْحاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَالْأَسْباطَ﴾ nouns conjoined to ابراهيم; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿كانُوا﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the wāw is its noun. ﴿هُوداً﴾ its khabar (predicate).
﴿أَوْ نَصارى﴾ conjoined to هودا, accusative with the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "you".
﴿أَأَنْتُمْ﴾ the hamza is interrogative; أنتم is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَعْلَمُ﴾ its khabar; the nominal clause is the object of the saying. ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, a noun conjoined to أنتم. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; man is an interrogative noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَظْلَمُ﴾ its khabar. ﴿مِمَّنْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the elative (ism al-tafḍīl) أظلم; the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَتَمَ﴾ a past verb, and the fāʿil is "he". ﴿شَهادَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun man. ﴿عِنْدَهُ﴾ an adverb of place attached to an omitted adjective of شهادة. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, genitive by min; they are attached to an omitted adjective of شهادة. ﴿وَمَا﴾ the wāw is resumptive; mā operates like laysa. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its noun. ﴿بِغافِلٍ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; غافل is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position as the khabar of mā. ﴿عَمَّا﴾ attached to غافل. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative mā.

daas-irab:141-141.t: Its i'rab has preceded in verse no. 134.

daas-irab:142-142.t:
﴿سَيَقُولُ﴾ the sīn is a particle of futurity; يقول is an imperfect verb. ﴿السُّفَهاءُ﴾ fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنَ النَّاسِ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of السفهاء; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما وَلَّاهُمْ﴾ mā is an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); ولاهم is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa; the hāʾ is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as "it", referring to mā; the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of mā. ﴿عَنْ قِبْلَتِهِمُ﴾ attached to the verb ولاهم. ﴿الَّتِي﴾ a relative noun in the position of genitive as an adjective of قبلتهم.
﴿كانُوا﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the wāw is its noun. ﴿عَلَيْها﴾ attached to the omitted khabar of kāna; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "you". ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿الْمَشْرِقُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿وَالْمَغْرِبُ﴾ a noun conjoined to المشرق. ﴿يَهْدِي﴾ an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is "He". ﴿مِنَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi of يهدي; the clause is resumptive. [Translator's note: the word is مَنْ.] ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is "He". ﴿إِلى صِراطٍ﴾ attached to يهدي. ﴿مُسْتَقِيمٍ﴾ an adjective of صراط; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:143-143.t:
﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; the kāf is a preposition; ذلك is a demonstrative in the position of genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of an omitted maṣdar, its implied form being "like that making, We made you". ﴿جَعَلْناكُمْ﴾ a past verb; نا is the fāʿil (agent) and the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أُمَّةً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَسَطاً﴾ an adjective of أمة. ﴿لِتَكُونُوا﴾ the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl); تكونوا is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb), the sign of its subjunctive being the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw is its noun.
﴿شُهَداءَ﴾ its khabar (predicate). ﴿عَلَى النَّاسِ﴾ attached to شهداء. ﴿وَيَكُونَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; يكون is a defective imperfect verb, subjunctive, conjoined to تكونوا. ﴿الرَّسُولُ﴾ its noun. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ attached to شهيدا. ﴿شَهِيداً﴾ its khabar. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; mā is negative. ﴿جَعَلْنَا﴾ a past verb, and نا is its fāʿil. ﴿الْقِبْلَةَ﴾ the first mafʿūl bihi of جعلنا. ﴿الَّتِي﴾ a relative noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn in the position of accusative as an adjective; the second object of جعلنا is omitted, the implied form being: "and We did not make the qibla which you were upon a qibla". ﴿كُنْتَ﴾ a defective past verb and its noun; the clause كنت is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿عَلَيْها﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿لِنَعْلَمَ﴾ the lām is the lām of causation; نعلم: an imperfect verb, subjunctive by an implied an after the lām of causation; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as "we". The interpreted maṣdar from the implied an and the verb is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted element in the position of accusative as the excepted, the implied form being: "and We did not make the qibla except as a test for people, for knowing". ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of the verb before it. ﴿يَتَّبِعُ الرَّسُولَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil is "he"; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿مِمَّنْ﴾ min and the relative man, a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نعلم, which means "We distinguish". ﴿يَنْقَلِبُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is "he"; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, as is the clause يتبع الرسول. ﴿عَلى عَقِبَيْهِ﴾ عقبي is a noun genitive with the yāʾ because it is a dual, and the hāʾ is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "turning back on his heels". ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial; in is lightened from the heavy (inna), with no governing effect. ﴿كانَتْ﴾ a defective past verb; the tāʾ is the tāʾ of the feminine, and its noun is a latent pronoun implied as "it (fem.)", the implied form being: "and though the turning was". ﴿لَكَبِيرَةً﴾ the lām is the distinguishing lām (al-lām al-fāriqa); كبيرة is the khabar of كانت. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿عَلَى الَّذِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to كبيرة. ﴿هَدَى﴾ a past verb indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif due to impossibility (taʿadhdhur). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; mā is negative. ﴿كانَ﴾ a defective past verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its noun. ﴿لِيُضِيعَ﴾ the lām is the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd); يضيع is an imperfect verb, subjunctive by an implied an after the lām of denial, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun referring to Allah. ﴿إِيمانَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. The implied an and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar of kāna, the implied form being "Allah was not one who would intend the wasting of your faith". ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿بِالنَّاسِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to رؤوف or to رحيم. ﴿لَرَؤُفٌ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); رؤوف is the khabar of inna. ﴿رَحِيمٌ﴾ a second khabar; the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position, and the clause ما كان الله is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:282-282.t:
﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾: for its i'rab see verse 253. [Translator's note: so in the source; the phrase was parsed at verse 254.] ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb for future time, governing its protasis in the genitive and made accusative by its apodosis. ﴿تَدايَنْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِدَيْنٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تداينتم. ﴿إِلى أَجَلٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of دين. ﴿مُسَمًّى﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿فَاكْتُبُوهُ﴾: the fāʾ is linking; اكتبوه is an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿وَلْيَكْتُبْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; يكتب is a jussive (majzūm) imperfect verb. ﴿بَيْنَكُمْ﴾: an adverb, attached to يكتب. ﴿كاتِبٌ﴾: fāʿil. ﴿بِالْعَدْلِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to كاتب; it is also said that they are attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَلا يَأْبَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; يأب is an imperfect verb, jussive by the prohibitive lā, and the sign of its jussive is the dropping of the weak letter. ﴿كاتِبٌ﴾: fāʿil. ﴿أَنْ يَكْتُبَ﴾: the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from an and the verb is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كَما عَلَّمَهُ﴾: the kāf is a preposition; ما is the maṣdar-particle; علمه is a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi; the interpreted maṣdar formed from ما and the verb is in the position of genitive by the kāf, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), the implied form being: "to write a writing like Allah's teaching him". ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿فَلْيَكْتُبْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; يكتب is a jussive imperfect verb; the clause is conjoined to the ليكتب before it. ﴿وَلْيُمْلِلِ﴾: likewise the clause is conjoined. ﴿الَّذِي﴾: fāʿil. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿الْحَقُّ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَلْيَتَّقِ اللَّهَ رَبَّهُ﴾: يتق is an imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the weak letter, and its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿رَبَّهُ﴾: badal (substitute) from الله; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَلا يَبْخَسْ مِنْهُ شَيْئاً﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by the prohibitive lā; منه is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from شيئا, or to the verb before it; شيئا is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَإِنْ كانَ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إن is conditional; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun, the noun of kāna. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ﴿الْحَقُّ﴾. ﴿سَفِيهاً﴾: the khabar of kāna. ﴿أَوْ ضَعِيفاً﴾: conjoined; the nominal clause is the ṣila of the relative noun.
﴿أَوْ لا يَسْتَطِيعُ﴾: the clause is conjoined to سفيها. ﴿أَنْ يُمِلَّ﴾: the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿هُوَ﴾: a detached pronoun, tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent fāʿil in the verb يمل. ﴿فَلْيُمْلِلْ وَلِيُّهُ بِالْعَدْلِ﴾: the fāʾ is linking; يملل is a jussive imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and وليه is its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿وَاسْتَشْهِدُوا﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿شَهِيدَيْنِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative with yāʾ because it is a dual. ﴿مِنْ رِجالِكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to استشهدوا or to شهيدين. ﴿فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُونا رَجُلَيْنِ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إن is conditional; لم makes the verb jussive; يكونا is a defective imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the nūn, and the alif is its noun; it is the protasis. ﴿رَجُلَيْنِ﴾: its khabar, accusative with yāʾ because it is a dual. ﴿فَرَجُلٌ﴾: the fāʾ is linking, occurring in the apodosis. ﴿رجل﴾: mubtadaʾ, i.e. "then a man is a witness". ﴿وَامْرَأَتانِ﴾: conjoined. ﴿مِمَّنْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of رجل. ﴿تَرْضَوْنَ مِنَ الشُّهَداءِ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the imperfect verb; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿أَنْ تَضِلَّ﴾: the interpreted maṣdar formed from an and the verb is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. for the purpose of one of them reminding the other. ﴿إِحْداهُما﴾: fāʿil. ﴿فَتُذَكِّرَ إِحْداهُمَا الْأُخْرى﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is إحداهما and whose object is الأخرى; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَلا يَأْبَ الشُّهَداءُ﴾: لا is prohibitive; يأب is a jussive imperfect verb, and the sign of its jussive is the dropping of the weak letter. ﴿الشُّهَداءِ﴾: fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِذا ما دُعُوا﴾: إذا is adverbial and conditional; ما is redundant (zāʾida); دعوا is a passive past verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the apodosis of إذا is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. ﴿وَلا تَسْئَمُوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; تسأموا is an imperfect verb, jussive by lā, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿أَنْ تَكْتُبُوهُ﴾: the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, the implied form being "and do not weary of writing it"; it is also said to be mafʿūl bihi. ﴿صَغِيراً﴾: ḥāl. ﴿أَوْ كَبِيراً﴾: conjoined to صغير. ﴿إِلى أَجَلِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "fixed until its term". ﴿ذلِكُمْ﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَقْسَطُ﴾: khabar. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾: an adverb, attached to أقسط. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأَقْوَمُ﴾: conjoined to أقسط. ﴿لِلشَّهادَةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أقوم; and the clause ﴿ذلِكُمْ أَقْسَطُ ... ﴾
is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَأَدْنى﴾: conjoined to وأقوم. ﴿أَلَّا تَرْتابُوا﴾: the maṣdar-particle an and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of genitive by a preposition, the implied form being: "nearer in respect of the absence of doubt". ﴿أَلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. [Translator's note: so in the source, written ﴿أَلَّا﴾; the verse reads إِلَّا أَنْ تَكُونَ.] ﴿أَنْ تَكُونَ﴾: تكون is a defective imperfect verb, accusative (subjunctive) by an, and its noun is omitted, its implied form being: "except that the trade be a trade ..."; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of accusative as the excepted. It is also permissible to parse تكون as complete (tāmma). ﴿تِجارَةً﴾: the noun of تكون. [Translator's note: so in the source; on the reading with تِجارَةً in the accusative, as given here, it is the khabar of تكون, its noun being omitted as just stated.] ﴿حاضِرَةً﴾: an adjective of تجارة. ﴿تُدِيرُونَها بَيْنَكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil, and an adverb attached to the verb; the clause is a second adjective. ﴿فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ليس is a defective past verb; عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿جُناحٌ﴾: its noun. ﴿أَلَّا تَكْتُبُوها﴾: the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by a preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective of جناح. ﴿وَأَشْهِدُوا﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb containing the meaning of condition. ﴿تَبايَعْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi because it follows the adverb إذا. ﴿وَلا يُضَارَّ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive, making the verb jussive; يضار is a jussive imperfect verb, given a fatḥa for lightness; it is passive. ﴿كاتِبٌ﴾: nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿وَلا شَهِيدٌ﴾: conjoined. ﴿وَإِنْ تَفْعَلُوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive; تفعلوا is a jussive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; it is the protasis. ﴿فَإِنَّهُ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis. ﴿إنه فُسُوقٌ﴾: inna, its noun and its khabar. ﴿بِكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of فسوق; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the Name of Majesty is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَيُعَلِّمُكُمُ اللَّهُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil. ﴿وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ﴾: الله, the Name of Majesty, is mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَلِيمٌ﴾: its khabar, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:283-283.t: ﴿وَإِنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إن is a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun; it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿عَلى سَفَرٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿وَلَمْ تَجِدُوا﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); لم is a particle of negation, jussive mood and conversion (to past meaning); تجدوا is a jussive (majzūm) imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿كاتِباً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَرِهانٌ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); رهان is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being: "then the security is pledges", or it is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted. ﴿مَقْبُوضَةٌ﴾: an adjective of رهان; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿فَإِنْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; إن is a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive. ﴿أَمِنَ بَعْضُكُمْ بَعْضاً﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَلْيُؤَدِّ﴾: the fāʾ is linking; يؤد is a jussive imperfect verb, and the sign of its jussive is the dropping of the weak letter; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun, fāʿil. ﴿اؤْتُمِنَ﴾: a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is "he". ﴿أَمانَتَهُ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَلْيَتَّقِ اللَّهَ رَبَّهُ﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿وَلا تَكْتُمُوا﴾ الشهادة: the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَمَنْ يَكْتُمْها﴾: the wāw is resumptive; من is a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ; يكتمها is a jussive imperfect verb, the protasis. ﴿فَإِنَّهُ آثِمٌ قَلْبُهُ﴾: the fāʾ is linking; inna, its noun and its khabar; and قلبه is the fāʿil of the active participle آثم. The protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of من. ﴿وَاللَّهُ بِما تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌ﴾: الله, the Name of Majesty, is the mubtadaʾ and عليم is the khabar; the nominal clause is resumptive. بما is attached to عليم, and the clause تعملون is the ṣila of the relative noun.

daas-irab:62-62.t:
﴿الَّذِينَ هادُوا﴾: the Jews. ﴿الصابئ﴾: one who abandons his religion.
﴿إِنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb (one of inna and its sisters). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative as its noun. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: conjoined to the first الذين. ﴿هادُوا﴾: like آمنوا. ﴿وَالنَّصارى وَالصَّابِئِينَ﴾: both conjoined to الذين. ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of accusative as a badal (substitute) from the noun of إنّ; it may also be parsed as a conditional [noun], mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿آمَنَ﴾: a past verb, and the fāʿil is "هو" (he); the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾: both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿وَالْيَوْمِ﴾: conjoined to الله. ﴿الْآخِرِ﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of اليوم. ﴿وَعَمِلَ﴾: the clause is conjoined to آمن.
﴿صالِحاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَلَهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis in meaning, and لهم: both attached to the omitted khabar (predicate).
﴿أَجْرُهُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ; the clause is the khabar of إنّ, or the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿عِنْدَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to the maṣdar (verbal noun) أجر, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), its implied form being "محفوظا عند ربهم" (preserved with their Lord). ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَلا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ﴾: لا is negative, with no governing effect because it is repeated. The i'rab of this clause has preceded with verse 38.

daas-irab:63-64.t:
﴿وَإِذْ أَخَذْنا﴾: the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿مِيثاقَكُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَرَفَعْنا﴾: the clause is conjoined to the clause أخذنا. ﴿فَوْقَكُمُ﴾: mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before it. ﴿الطُّورَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿خُذُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the wāw of the plural, the fāʿil (agent); the clause is the speech of an omitted verb of saying. The clause of the omitted saying is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), the implied form being "قائلين لهم خذوا" (saying to them: take). ﴿ما آتَيْناكُمْ﴾: ما is a relative noun, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi.
﴿آتَيْناكُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi. The clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, the implied form being "ما آتيناكموه" (what We gave you of it). ﴿بِقُوَّةٍ﴾: both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), the implied form being "خذوا ما آتيناكم حاملين بقوة" (take what We gave you, carrying it with strength). ﴿وَاذْكُرُوا﴾: conjoined to خذوا. ﴿ما فِيهِ﴾: ما is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi; فيه: both attached to an omitted ṣila of ما, the implied form being "الذي ذكر فيه" (what is mentioned in it).
﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾: لعل and its noun. ﴿تَتَّقُونَ﴾: the clause is the khabar (predicate) of لعل. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿تَوَلَّيْتُمْ﴾: the clause is conjoined to the clause أخذنا. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾: both attached to توليتم. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿فَلَوْلا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive.
لولا is a particle of impossibility because of existence (ḥarf imtināʿ li-wujūd). ﴿فَضْلُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: both attached to the maṣdar (verbal noun) فضل; its khabar is omitted, its implied form being "موجود" (exists). ﴿وَرَحْمَتُهُ﴾: conjoined to فضل. ﴿لَكُنْتُمْ﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis of the condition of لولا. كنتم is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb [one of kāna and its sisters], and the tāʾ is its noun. ﴿مِنَ الْخاسِرِينَ﴾: both attached to the omitted khabar. The clause لكنتم has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.

daas-irab:65-65.t:
﴿خاسِئِينَ﴾: abased. ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive. The lām occurs in the answer to an oath (jawāb al-qasam); قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq).
﴿عَلِمْتُمُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿اعْتَدَوْا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾: both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), the implied form being "اعتدوا ظالمين منكم" (they transgressed, being wrongdoers among you). ﴿فِي السَّبْتِ﴾: both attached to the verb before them. ﴿فَقُلْنا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; قلنا is a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: both attached to قلنا.
﴿كُونُوا﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperative verb [of kāna and its sisters]; the wāw is its noun and its khabar (predicate) is ﴿قِرَدَةً﴾, and ﴿خاسِئِينَ﴾ is a second khabar — it is also said to be a naʿt (adjective). The clause كونوا قردة is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:66-67.t:
﴿فَجَعَلْناها﴾: [i.e.] the punishment just mentioned. ﴿نَكالًا﴾: an exemplary lesson. ﴿لِما بَيْنَ يَدَيْها﴾: for those who lived through it. ﴿ما خَلْفَها﴾: the nations who came after it.
﴿فَجَعَلْناها﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause is conjoined. ﴿نَكالًا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لِما﴾: ما is a relative noun in the position of genitive by the lām; both are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (verbal noun) نكال, or to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of it. ﴿بَيْنَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿يَدَيْها﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the yāʾ because it is a dual; the nūn was dropped because of the annexation, and the hāʾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is conjoined to the first ما. ﴿خَلْفَها﴾: an adverb of place attached to an omitted ṣila. ﴿وَمَوْعِظَةً﴾: conjoined to نكالا. ﴿لِلْمُتَّقِينَ﴾: both attached to موعظة, or to an omitted naʿt of it. ﴿وَإِذْ قالَ مُوسى لِقَوْمِهِ﴾: the i'rab of something like it has preceded. ﴿إِنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb (one of inna and its sisters). ﴿اللَّهَ﴾: the Name of Majesty, its noun. ﴿يَأْمُرُكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "هو" (He), referring back to Allah. ﴿إِنَّ﴾: a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle. «[Translator's note: the source prints this particle as ﴿إِنَّ﴾; the particle in the verse is أَنْ.]» ﴿تَذْبَحُوا﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by a preposition, its implied form being "بذبح بقرة" (to slaughter a cow), both attached to the verb before them. The clause يأمركم is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. ﴿بَقَرَةً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿أَتَتَّخِذُنا﴾: the hamza is for interrogation. تتخذنا is an imperfect verb and its first mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "أنت" (you). ﴿هُزُواً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَعُوذُ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is "أنا" (I). ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive by the bāʾ; both are attached to أعوذ; the clause is maqūl al-qawl. ﴿إِنَّ﴾: a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle. «[Translator's note: here too the source prints ﴿إِنَّ﴾ for the verse's أَنْ.]» ﴿أَكُونَ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb [one of kāna and its sisters], subjunctive (manṣūb); it is, by interpretation, a maṣdar in the position of genitive by a preposition, the implied form being "من الجهل" (from ignorance), and both are attached to the verb أعوذ. The noun of أكون is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنا". ﴿مِنَ الْجاهِلِينَ﴾: both attached to the khabar of أكون.

daas-irab:68-69.t:
﴿الفارض﴾: the old, aged one. ﴿البكر﴾: the young one. ﴿العوان﴾: the middle-aged one.
﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿ادْعُ﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil is "أنت" (you); the clause is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لَنا﴾: both attached to (mutaʿalliq) ادع. ﴿رَبَّكَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يُبَيِّنْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to a command (jawāb al-ṭalab), and the fāʿil is "هو" (He), referring back to ربك. The clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the command. ﴿لَنا﴾: both attached to يبين. ﴿ما﴾: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿هِيَ﴾: a detached nominative pronoun, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of the verb يبين. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: إنّ and its noun; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿يَقُولُ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is "هو", referring back to Allah; the clause is the khabar of إنّ. ﴿إِنَّها﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿بَقَرَةٌ﴾: its khabar; the clause is maqūl al-qawl. ﴿لا فارِضٌ﴾: لا is negative; فارض is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, the implied form being "لا هي فارض" (she is not old); the clause is in the position of nominative as a naʿt (adjective), and likewise ﴿وَلا بِكْرٌ﴾, the clause being conjoined. ﴿فارِضٌ﴾ may also be parsed as a naʿt. ﴿عَوانٌ﴾: khabar or naʿt.
﴿بَيْنَ﴾: mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of place attached to عنوان. «[Translator's note: so in the source (عنوان); the word meant is عوان.]» ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَافْعَلُوا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that reveals an omitted condition), i.e. "إذا وجدتم البقرة المطلوبة فافعلوا" (when you have found the required cow, then do). افعلوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition: "إذا وجدتم فافعلوا" (when you have found, then do). ﴿ما تُؤْمَرُونَ﴾: ما is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi; تؤمرون is a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted: "ما تؤمرون به" (what you are commanded with). ﴿قالُوا ادْعُ لَنا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّنْ لَنا ما لَوْنُها قالَ إِنَّهُ يَقُولُ إِنَّها بَقَرَةٌ﴾: see the previous verse.
﴿صَفْراءُ﴾: a naʿt of بقرة. ﴿فاقِعٌ﴾: a fronted khabar. ﴿لَوْنُها﴾: a delayed mubtadaʾ, and the fāʿil of the adjective resembling the participle (ṣifa mushabbaha) فاقع is a pronoun latent (mustatir) in it. فاقع may also be parsed as a naʿt of بقرة, with لونها as the fāʿil of فاقع. The nominal clause is also a naʿt of بقرة.
﴿تَسُرُّ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿النَّاظِرِينَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the yāʾ. The clause is a third naʿt of بقرة.

daas-irab:70-71.t:
﴿الأصفر الفاقع﴾: intensely yellow. ﴿لا ذَلُولٌ﴾: not broken in by work. ﴿تُثِيرُ الْأَرْضَ﴾: ploughs it. ﴿مُسَلَّمَةٌ﴾: free of defects. ﴿لا شِيَةَ﴾: no other colour together with her yellow colour.
﴿قالُوا ادْعُ لَنا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّنْ لَنا ما هِيَ﴾: see verse 68. ﴿إِنَّ الْبَقَرَ﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿تَشابَهَ﴾: a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "هو" (it); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. The clause إن البقر is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾: both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb تشابه.
﴿وَإِنَّا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. إنا is إنّ and its noun. ﴿إِنَّ﴾: a jussive conditional particle making two verbs jussive. «[Translator's note: the source prints this particle as ﴿إِنَّ﴾; the conditional particle in the verse is إِنْ.]» ﴿شاءَ﴾: a past verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿لَمُهْتَدُونَ﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); مهتدون is the khabar of إنا. The clause وإنا لمهتدون is conjoined. The clause إن شاء الله is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya). The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being "إن شاء الله اهتدينا" (if Allah wills, we shall be guided). ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb, and the fāʿil is "هو" (he). ﴿إِنَّهُ يَقُولُ﴾: إنّ and its noun; يقول is an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is its khabar. The nominal clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنَّها بَقَرَةٌ﴾: إنّ, its noun and its khabar; the clause is maqūl al-qawl. ﴿لا ذَلُولٌ﴾: لا is negative; ذلول is a naʿt (adjective) of بقرة, or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject): "لا هي ذلول" (she is not broken in). ﴿تُثِيرُ الْأَرْضَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun.
The clause is likewise a naʿt of بقرة. ﴿وَلا تَسْقِي الْحَرْثَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the clause is conjoined to the preceding one, and لا is redundant (zāʾida).
﴿مُسَلَّمَةٌ﴾: a naʿt of بقرة. ﴿لا شِيَةَ﴾: لا is the lā of generic negation, working like إنّ; شية is its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of accusative. ﴿فِيها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the omitted khabar. The clause is in the position of nominative as a fourth naʿt. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿الْآنَ﴾: mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of time attached to the verb before them; it is also said to be attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial): "جئت متلبسا بالحق" (you have come bearing the truth). «[Translator's note: so in the source ("before them"); the verb جئت actually follows الآن.]» ﴿جِئْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾: both attached to جئت; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
﴿فَذَبَحُوها﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ذبحوها is a past verb and its fāʿil, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to omitted clauses before it, the implied form being "فطلبوها فاشتروها فذبحوها" (so they sought her, bought her, and slaughtered her). ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ما is negative. ﴿كادُوا﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the wāw is its noun; the clause وما كادوا is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿يَفْعَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar.

daas-irab:213-213.t:
﴿كانَ النَّاسُ أُمَّةً﴾ كان, its noun (ism) and its khabar (predicate). ﴿واحِدَةً﴾ ṣifa (adjective). ﴿فَبَعَثَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿بعث اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to an omitted clause, i.e. "mankind was one community, then they differed, so Allah sent". ﴿النَّبِيِّينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿مُبَشِّرِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَمُنْذِرِينَ﴾ conjoined. ﴿وَأَنْزَلَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; أنزل is a past verb, the fāʿil being "huwa" (He), referring to Allah. ﴿مَعَهُمُ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before it. ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لِيَحْكُمَ﴾ the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl); يحكم is an imperfect verb, accusative by an أن concealed after the lām of causation; it and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb أنزل. ﴿بَيْنَ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to يحكم. ﴿النَّاسُ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿النَّاسُ﴾ with ḍamma; as muḍāf ilayhi it is ﴿النَّاسِ﴾.] ﴿فِيمَا﴾ ما is relative, and both are attached to يحكم. ﴿اخْتَلَفُوا﴾ a past verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَمَا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; ما is negating. ﴿اخْتَلَفَ﴾ a past verb.
﴿فِيهِ﴾ both attached to اختلف. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, fāʿil. ﴿أُوتُوهُ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma because of its connection to the wāw of the group; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), which is the first object, and the hāʾ is the second object. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ both attached to اختلف. ﴿ما جاءَتْهُمُ﴾ ما is maṣdariyya (infinitival); جاءتهم is a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and it is interpreted with the maṣdariyya ما as a maṣdar in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿الْبَيِّناتُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿بَغْياً﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to an omitted ṣifa of بغيا. ﴿فَهَدَى اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb, the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil and الذين is the mafʿūl bihi; آمنوا is a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿لِمَا﴾ both attached to هدى. ﴿اخْتَلَفُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ both attached to the verb; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun ما. ﴿مِنَ الْحَقِّ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl from ما. ﴿بِإِذْنِهِ﴾ both attached to هدى. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); الله, the Name of Majesty, is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَهْدِي﴾ an imperfect verb, the fāʿil being "huwa", referring to Allah; the clause is the khabar. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿مِنْ﴾; the relative noun is ﴿مَنْ﴾.] ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿إِلى صِراطٍ﴾ both attached to يهدي. ﴿مُسْتَقِيمٍ﴾ ṣifa.

daas-irab:214-214.t:
﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿حَسِبْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَنْ﴾ a maṣdar-forming particle that puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿تَدْخُلُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the deletion of the nūn; it is interpreted with the maṣdariyya أن as an interpreted maṣdar standing in place of the two objects of حسبتم. ﴿الْجَنَّةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَلَمَّا﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); لمّا is a jussive-governing particle. ﴿يَأْتِكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the weak letter, and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿مَثَلُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); the clause is circumstantial. ﴿خَلَوْا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil.
﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) خلوا. ﴿مَسَّتْهُمُ﴾ a past verb; the tāʾ is the tāʾ of the feminine and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْبَأْساءُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿وَالضَّرَّاءُ﴾ conjoined; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in خلوا. ﴿وَزُلْزِلُوا﴾ زلزلوا is a passive past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya) and genitive. ﴿يَقُولَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by a concealed أن; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to زلزلوا. ﴿الرَّسُولُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ conjoined to الرسول. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿مَعَهُ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to آمنوا.
﴿مَتى﴾ an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as an adverb of time, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of نصر.
﴿نَصْرُ﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the nominal clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿أَلا﴾ an opening particle (istiftāḥ). ﴿إِنَّ نَصْرَ اللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ﴾ إنّ, its noun (ism) and its khabar; الله, the Name of Majesty, is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:215-215.t: ﴿يَسْئَلُونَكَ﴾ an imperfect verb; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿ماذا﴾ ما is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and ذا is a relative noun, its khabar (predicate); the clause is a fronted mafʿūl bihi. It may also be regarded as one word and parsed as an interrogative noun, a fronted mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يُنْفِقُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, the fāʿil being "anta" (you); the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما أَنْفَقْتُمْ﴾ ما is a jussive-governing conditional, in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi, and it may also be parsed as a relative noun; أنفقتم is a past verb and the tāʾ is the fāʿil, and it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿مِنْ خَيْرٍ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ما. ﴿فَلِلْوالِدَيْنِ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); للوالدين is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "then it is given to the parents". The clause ﴿أَنْفَقْتُمْ﴾ is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying), and the implied clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿وَالْأَقْرَبِينَ وَالْيَتامى وَالْمَساكِينِ وَابْنِ السَّبِيلِ﴾ conjoined to الوالدين. ﴿وَما تَفْعَلُوا مِنْ خَيْرٍ﴾ like ما أنفقتم من خير; the clause is conjoined or resumptive. ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ بِهِ عَلِيمٌ﴾ إنّ, the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism) and عليم its khabar; به is attached to عليم; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.

daas-irab:216-216.t: ﴿كُتِبَ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿عَلَيْكُمُ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) كتب. ﴿الْقِتالُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); هو is a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كُرْهٌ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ both attached to كره; the clause is circumstantial. ﴿وَعَسى﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); عسى is a non-inflecting (jāmid) past verb, and here it is complete (tāmm). ﴿أَنْ تَكْرَهُوا﴾ أن is a maṣdar-forming particle that puts the verb in the accusative; تكرهوا is accusative by the deletion of the nūn, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil (agent) of عسى. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ﴾ parsed like ﴿وَهُوَ كُرْهٌ لَكُمْ﴾. ﴿وَعَسى أَنْ تُحِبُّوا شَيْئاً وَهُوَ شَرٌّ لَكُمْ﴾ the clause is conjoined to the one before it and is like it. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; الله, the Name of Majesty, is mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾ is its khabar. ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; أنتم is mubtadaʾ. ﴿لا تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ لا is negating; تعلمون is an imperfect verb and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of أنتم.

daas-irab:217-217.t:
﴿يَسْئَلُونَكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَنِ الشَّهْرِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) يسألونك. ﴿الْحَرامِ﴾ ṣifa (adjective). ﴿قِتالٍ﴾ badal (substitute) from الشهر. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ both attached to قتال. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, the fāʿil being "anta" (you). ﴿قِتالٍ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). [Translator's note: the source prints this second ﴿قِتالٍ﴾ with kasra; as mubtadaʾ it is ﴿قِتالٌ﴾.] ﴿فِيهِ﴾ both attached to قتال also, or to a ṣifa of it. ﴿كَبِيرٌ﴾ khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿وَصَدٌّ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; صد is mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ﴾ both attached to صد; الله, the Name of Majesty, is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَكُفْرٌ﴾ conjoined to صد. ﴿بِهِ﴾ both attached to كفر. ﴿وَالْمَسْجِدِ﴾ conjoined to سبيل. ﴿الْحَرامِ﴾ ṣifa. ﴿وَإِخْراجُ﴾ conjoined to صد. ﴿أَهْلِهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ both attached to إخراج. ﴿أَكْبَرُ﴾ khabar of the mubtadaʾ صد. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to أكبر. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْفِتْنَةُ أَكْبَرُ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنَ الْقَتْلِ﴾ both attached to أكبر. ﴿وَلا يَزالُونَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; لا يزالون is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, and the wāw is its noun (ism). ﴿يُقاتِلُونَكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb; the wāw is the fāʿil and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of لا يزالون. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya) and genitive. ﴿يَرُدُّوكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an أن concealed after حتى; the wāw is the fāʿil and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi. The interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿عَنْ دِينِكُمْ﴾ both attached to يردوكم. ﴿إِنِ﴾ a jussive-governing conditional particle. ﴿اسْتَطاعُوا﴾ a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and its apodosis (jawāb) is omitted, its implied form being: "that they turn you back". ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); من is a jussive-governing conditional noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَرْتَدِدْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis, the fāʿil being "huwa" (he), referring to مَن. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in يرتدد. ﴿عَنْ دِينِهِ﴾ both attached to يرتدد. ﴿فَيَمُتْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; يمت is a jussive imperfect verb, and the clause is conjoined to يرتدد. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); هو is a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿كافِرٌ﴾ its khabar; the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); أولئك is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿حَبِطَتْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine; the clause is the khabar of the demonstrative.
﴿أَعْمالُهُمْ﴾ fāʿil; and the nominal clause ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of مَن. ﴿فِي الدُّنْيا﴾ both attached to حبطت. ﴿وَالْآخِرَةِ﴾ conjoined to الدنيا. ﴿وَأُولئِكَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; أولئك is mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَصْحابُ﴾ its khabar. ﴿النَّارِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿هُمْ﴾ a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِيها﴾ both attached to خالدون. ﴿خالِدُونَ﴾ khabar.

daas-irab:218-218.t: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾ إنّ and its noun (ism). ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ هاجَرُوا وَجاهَدُوا﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فِي سَبِيلِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) جاهدوا. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَرْجُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿رَحْمَتَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; the nominal clause ﴿أُولئِكَ يَرْجُونَ﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of إنّ. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); الله, the Name of Majesty, is mubtadaʾ. ﴿غَفُورٌ﴾ first khabar. ﴿رَحِيمٌ﴾ second khabar.

daas-irab:219-219.t:
﴿يَسْئَلُونَكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object. ﴿عَنِ الْخَمْرِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) يسألونك. ﴿وَالْمَيْسِرِ﴾ conjoined to الخمر; the clause is resumptive. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, the fāʿil being "anta" (you). ﴿فِيهِما﴾ both attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿إِثْمٌ﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كَبِيرٌ﴾ ṣifa (adjective); the nominal clause is in the position of the accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿وَمَنافِعُ﴾ conjoined to إثم. ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾ both attached to an omitted ṣifa of منافع. ﴿وَإِثْمُهُما﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); إثمهما is mubtadaʾ; the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa), and the mīm and alif are two letters for the dual. ﴿أَكْبَرُ﴾ khabar. ﴿مِنْ نَفْعِهِما﴾ both attached to أكبر. ﴿وَيَسْئَلُونَكَ ماذا يُنْفِقُونَ﴾ its i'rab has preceded with verse 214. [Translator's note: so in the source; the phrase is analysed under verse 215.]
﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, the fāʿil being "anta"; the clause is resumptive. ﴿الْعَفْوَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "spend the surplus"; the omitted verbal clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿يُبَيِّنُ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿لَكُمُ﴾ both attached to يبين. ﴿الْآياتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾ لعلّ and its noun (ism). ﴿تَتَفَكَّرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of لعلّ.

daas-irab:220-220.t: ﴿فِي الدُّنْيا﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) تتفكرون. ﴿وَالْآخِرَةِ﴾ conjoined to الدنيا. ﴿وَيَسْئَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْيَتامى قُلْ:﴾ conjoined to the first يسألونك and like it. ﴿إِصْلاحٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to إصلاح. ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾ khabar (predicate); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); إن is conditional. ﴿تُخالِطُوهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the nūn because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَإِخْوانُكُمْ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). إخوانكم is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "then they are your brothers"; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, and the clause ﴿إِنْ تُخالِطُوهُمْ﴾ is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; الله, the Name of Majesty, is mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾ an imperfect verb, the fāʿil being "huwa" (He), referring to Allah; the clause يعلم is the khabar. ﴿الْمُفْسِدَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنَ الْمُصْلِحِ﴾ both attached to يعلم; the clause ﴿وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ﴾ is resumptive. ﴿وَلَوْ شاءَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; لو is conditional. ﴿شاءَ اللَّهُ﴾ a verb and its fāʿil, and an omitted mafʿūl bihi, its implied form being "had He willed your hardship". ﴿لَأَعْنَتَكُمْ﴾ the lām occurs in the apodosis of the condition لو; أعنتكم is a past verb, the fāʿil being "huwa", referring to Allah, and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ﴾ إنّ, its noun (ism) and its two khabars; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:221-221.t: ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); لا is the prohibitive, jussive-governing lā. ﴿تَنْكِحُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿الْمُشْرِكاتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya) and genitive. ﴿يُؤْمِنَّ﴾ an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because of its connection to the nūn of the feminine plural, and the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil; it is in the position of the accusative by an أن concealed after حتى, and the interpreted maṣdar from it and the verb is in the position of the genitive by حتى; both are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تنكحوا. ﴿وَلَأَمَةٌ﴾ the wāw is resumptive and the lām is for inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ); أمة is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مُؤْمِنَةٌ﴾ ṣifa (adjective). ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنْ مُشْرِكَةٍ﴾ both attached to the elative noun (ism al-tafḍīl) خير. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); لو is a conditional particle in the sense of إن. ﴿أَعْجَبَتْكُمْ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi; the tāʾ is for the feminine, and the fāʿil is "hiya" (she), referring to مشركة; the clause is circumstantial. [Translator's note: the source says the fāʿil is «هو» (masculine), although it refers to the feminine مشركة.] ﴿وَلا تَنْكِحُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿وَلا تُنْكِحُوا الْمُشْرِكِينَ حَتَّى يُؤْمِنُوا وَلَعَبْدٌ مُؤْمِنٌ خَيْرٌ مِنْ مُشْرِكٍ وَلَوْ أَعْجَبَكُمْ﴾ parsed like what precedes it. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَدْعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿إِلَى النَّارِ﴾ both attached to يدعون; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; الله, the Name of Majesty, is mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَدْعُوا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ﴾ the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ is conjoined. ﴿وَالْمَغْفِرَةِ﴾ conjoined to الجنة. ﴿بِإِذْنِهِ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of يدعو. ﴿وَيُبَيِّنُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; يبين is an imperfect verb, the fāʿil being "huwa" (He), referring to Allah. ﴿آياتِهِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾ both attached to يبين. ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾ لعلّ and its noun (ism). ﴿يَتَذَكَّرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of لعلّ.

daas-irab:284-284.t:
﴿لِلَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, genitive (majrūr) by the lām; the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause); the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَما فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: conjoined to ما في السموات. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إن is conditional. ﴿تُبْدُوا﴾: a jussive (majzūm) imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فِي أَنْفُسِكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila. ﴿أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ﴾: conjoined to ﴿تُبْدُوا﴾. ﴿يُحاسِبْكُمْ﴾: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), jussive. ﴿بِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يحاسبكم. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿فَيَغْفِرُ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive. ﴿يغفر﴾: a nominative (marfūʿ) imperfect verb; the clause is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being: "He forgives ...". ﴿لِمَنْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يغفر; and the clause ﴿يَشاءُ ... ﴾
is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَيُعَذِّبُ مَنْ يَشاءُ﴾: conjoined to يغفر لمن يشاء. ﴿وَاللَّهُ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ﴾: the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ and قدير is its khabar; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar, and شيء is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive ...

daas-irab:285-285.t: ﴿آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿بِما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) آمن. ﴿أُنْزِلَ﴾: a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is "he". ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أنزل. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أنزل. ﴿وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: conjoined to الرسول; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿كُلٌّ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿آمَنَ﴾: a past verb, and the fāʿil is the latent (mustatir) "he". ﴿بِاللَّهِ وَمَلائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to آمن, and what follows it is conjoined to it; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of كل. ﴿لا نُفَرِّقُ﴾: لا is negating; نفرق is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is "we" (نحن). ﴿بَيْنَ﴾: an adverb, attached to نفرق. ﴿أَحَدٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ رُسُلِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of أحد; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted verb, and the omitted saying clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَقالُوا سَمِعْنا وَأَطَعْنا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause ﴿سَمِعْنا﴾ is the object of the saying, and أطعنا is conjoined. ﴿غُفْرانَكَ﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾: the one addressed in the vocative (munādā), in construct, accusative. ﴿وَإِلَيْكَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إليك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿الْمَصِيرُ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined to an omitted clause, the implied form being: "from You is the beginning and to You is the return".

daas-irab:286-286.t: ﴿لا يُكَلِّفُ﴾: لا is negating; يكلف is an imperfect verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent). ﴿نَفْساً﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿وُسْعَها﴾: second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause ﴿كَسَبَتْ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; and likewise ﴿وَعَلَيْها مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ﴾; the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾: the one addressed in the vocative (munādā), in construct. ﴿لا تُؤاخِذْنا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lā; نا is mafʿūl bihi and the fāʿil is "you" (anta); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿إِنْ نَسِينا﴾: إن is a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive; نسينا is a past verb and نا is the fāʿil; it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. ﴿أَوْ أَخْطَأْنا﴾: conjoined to نسينا. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾: the one addressed, with an omitted vocative particle. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is prohibitive. ﴿تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنا إِصْراً﴾: a jussive imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تحمل. ﴿كَما﴾: ما is the maṣdar-particle, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تحمل. ﴿حَمَلْتَهُ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; with ما it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive by the kāf, the two being attached to an omitted adjective of a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿عَلَى الَّذِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to حملته. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila. ﴿رَبَّنا وَلا تُحَمِّلْنا ما لا طاقَةَ لَنا بِهِ﴾: تحملنا is an imperfect verb, jussive by lā, and نا is mafʿūl bihi; ما is a relative noun, second mafʿūl bihi; لا is the lā of generic negation; طاقة is its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; لنا and به are both attached to the omitted khabar of lā. ﴿وَاعْفُ﴾: a verb of supplication, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil is "you"; the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَنَّا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اعف. ﴿وَاغْفِرْ لَنا وَارْحَمْنا﴾: conjoined to what precedes them. ﴿أَنْتَ مَوْلانا﴾: أنت is a detached pronoun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ. ﴿مَوْلانا﴾: khabar, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَانْصُرْنا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction or causal; انصرنا is a verb of supplication, and نا is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عَلَى الْقَوْمِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to انصرنا. ﴿الْكافِرِينَ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa).

daas-irab:144-144.t:
﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿نَرى﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma, and the fāʿil (agent) is "we". ﴿تَقَلُّبَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
