﴿وَجْهِكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the kāf is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿فِي السَّماءِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar تقلب. ﴿فَلَنُوَلِّيَنَّكَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; the lām paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam); نولينك is an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because of its connection with the heavy nūn of emphasis; the fāʿil is "we" and the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قِبْلَةً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the response to an oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿تَرْضاها﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with the implied ḍamma; ها is mafʿūl bihi and the fāʿil is "you"; the clause is in the position of accusative as an adjective of قبلة. ﴿فَوَلِّ﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa; ولّ is an imperative verb indeclinable on dropping the weak letter, and the fāʿil is "you". ﴿وَجْهِكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿شَطْرَ﴾ mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of place attached to the verb ولّ. ﴿الْمَسْجِدِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْحَرامِ﴾ an adjective. The clause ول وجهك is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَحَيْثُ ما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; حيثما is a jussive conditional noun indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as an adverb of place, attached to the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of كنتم. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ kāna and its noun; it is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿فَوَلُّوا﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis of the condition; ولوا is an imperative verb indeclinable on dropping the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿وُجُوهَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿شَطْرَهُ﴾ mafʿūl fīhi, an adverb of place attached to the verb before it; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿وَإِنَّ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; inna is a particle resembling the verb (ḥarf mushabbah bi-l-fiʿl). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of accusative as its noun. ﴿أُوتُوا﴾ a passive past verb indeclinable on the ḍamma because of its connection with the wāw of the plural, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi, the nāʾib fāʿil being the first object; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿لَيَعْلَمُونَ﴾ the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); يعلمون is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿أَنَّهُ﴾ anna and its noun. ﴿الْحَقُّ﴾ its khabar; anna with its noun and its khabar has stood in place of the two objects of يعلمون. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ﴾ attached to an omitted element in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الحق. The clause ﴿لَيَعْلَمُونَ﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna. ﴿وَمَا﴾ the wāw is resumptive; mā is the Ḥijāzī negative mā that operates like laysa. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its noun. ﴿بِغافِلٍ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; غافل is the khabar of mā. ﴿عَمَّا﴾ عن and the relative mā; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to غافل. ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun.

daas-irab:145-145.t: ﴿وَلَئِنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; the lām paves the way for the response to the oath; in is a jussive conditional particle. ﴿أَتَيْتَ﴾ a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because of its connection with the tāʾ of the agent; it is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause ﴿أُوتُوا الْكِتابَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿أُوتُوا﴾ a passive past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), being the first object; الكتاب is the second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِكُلِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿آيَةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ما تَبِعُوا﴾ mā is negative; تبعوا is a past verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿قِبْلَتَكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa; the clause is the response to the oath, and it has made the apodosis of the condition unnecessary. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; mā operates like laysa. ﴿أَنْتَ﴾ its noun. ﴿بِتابِعٍ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; تابع is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position as the khabar (predicate) of mā. ﴿قِبْلَتَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi of تابع; the clause is conjoined to the clause before it. ﴿وَما بَعْضُهُمْ بِتابِعٍ قِبْلَةَ بَعْضٍ﴾ the clause is conjoined to what precedes it and is parsed in the same way. ﴿وَلَئِنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; the lām paves the way for the response to the oath; in is conditional. ﴿اتَّبَعْتَ﴾ a past verb, and its fāʿil is the tāʾ. ﴿أَهْواءَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ attached to the verb before them. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun indeclinable on the sukūn in the position of genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿جاءَكَ﴾ a past verb, and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿مِنَ الْعِلْمِ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿إِذاً﴾ a particle of answer and requital (jawāb wa-jazāʾ). ﴿لَمِنَ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). ﴿من الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of inna. The clause إنك is the response to the oath, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:146-146.t:
﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿آتَيْناهُمُ﴾ a past verb indeclinable on the sukūn; نا is the fāʿil (agent) and the hāʾ is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾ the second mafʿūl bihi of آتيناهم.
﴿يَعْرِفُونَهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿كَما﴾ the kāf is a preposition; mā is maṣdariyya. ﴿يَعْرِفُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿أَبْناءَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. The maṣdariyya mā with the verb is interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of genitive by the kāf, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of an omitted maṣdar, the implied form being: "they know with a witnessed knowledge like their knowledge of their sons". ﴿وَإِنَّ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial; inna is a particle resembling the verb (ḥarf mushabbah bi-l-fiʿl). ﴿فَرِيقاً﴾ its noun.
﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ attached to فريقا. ﴿لَيَكْتُمُونَ﴾ the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); يكتمون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿الْحَقَّ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. The nominal clause ﴿وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:147-148.t:
﴿الْحَقُّ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa; lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَكُونَنَّ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of jussive (majzūm) by the lā of prohibition; its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as "you". ﴿مِنَ الْمُمْتَرِينَ﴾ attached to the omitted khabar of تكون.
[Translator's note: from here to the end of the entry the source's Quranic-word markers are damaged (the opening brackets and first letters are lost); the words are restored below from the Quranic text.]
﴿وَلِكُلٍّ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; لكل is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿وِجْهَةٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿هُوَ﴾ a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿مُوَلِّيها﴾ the khabar of هو, nominative with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, and the hāʾ is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa; the nominal clause هو موليها is in the position of nominative as an adjective of وجهة. ﴿فَاسْتَبِقُوا﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa. استبقوا: an imperative verb indeclinable on dropping the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿الْخَيْراتِ﴾ accusative by removal of the preposition; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of an implied condition. ﴿أَيْنَ ما﴾ a jussive conditional noun indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as an adverb of place, attached to the omitted fronted khabar of تكونوا. ﴿تَكُونُوا﴾ a defective imperfect verb, jussive by dropping the nūn; it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the wāw is its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَأْتِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; it is the apodosis of the condition.
﴿بِكُمُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يأت. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition not joined by the fāʾ or the إذا of surprise. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿عَلى كُلِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قدير. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿قَدِيرٌ﴾ the khabar of inna; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:149-149.t:
﴿وَمِنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; min is a preposition. ﴿حَيْثُ﴾ a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb ولّ after them. ﴿خَرَجْتَ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa.
﴿فَوَلِّ﴾ the fāʾ is a linking one, because of the sense of condition in حيث; ولّ is an imperative verb indeclinable on dropping the weak letter, and the fāʿil is "you".
﴿وَجْهَكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿شَطْرَ﴾ an adverb of place attached to ول. ﴿الْمَسْجِدِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْحَرامِ﴾ an adjective. ﴿وَإِنَّهُ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial; إنه is inna and its noun. ﴿لَلْحَقُّ﴾ the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); الحق is its khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكَ﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of الحق; the clause is circumstantial. ﴿وَمَا اللَّهُ بِغافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ its i'rab preceded with verse 74.

daas-irab:150-150.t: ﴿وَمِنْ حَيْثُ خَرَجْتَ فَوَلِّ وَجْهَكَ شَطْرَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرامِ وَحَيْثُ ما كُنْتُمْ فَوَلُّوا وُجُوهَكُمْ شَطْرَهُ﴾ its i'rab has preceded in the previous verse, and the i'rab of ﴿وَحَيْثُ ما كُنْتُمْ﴾ preceded in verse 144. ﴿لِئَلَّا﴾ the lām is a preposition; an is a subjunctive particle assimilated into the negative lā. ﴿يَكُونَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb); the interpreted maṣdar from the subjunctive an and the verb is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate). [Translator's note: so in the source; presumably the omitted element to which لئلا is attached is meant, while the khabar of يكون is mentioned next.] ﴿لِلنَّاسِ عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿حُجَّةٌ﴾ the postponed noun of يكون. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa in the position of accusative as the excepted. ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾ a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the verb before them. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa, and lā is the jussive lā of prohibition. ﴿تَخْشَوْهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by dropping the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَاخْشَوْنِي﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; اخشوني is an imperative verb indeclinable on dropping the nūn because its imperfect is one of the five verbs; the wāw is the fāʿil, the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿وَلِأُتِمَّ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl); أتم is an imperfect verb, subjunctive by an implied an after it; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are conjoined to لئلا يكون. ﴿نِعْمَتِي﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the yāʾ is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أتم. ﴿وَلَعَلَّكُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; لعل and its noun. ﴿تَهْتَدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is its khabar. The nominal clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:151-151.t:
﴿كَما﴾ the kāf is a preposition; mā is maṣdariyya. ﴿أَرْسَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿فِيكُمْ﴾ attached to أرسلنا. ﴿رَسُولًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ attached to the verb before them. ﴿يَتْلُوا﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ attached to يتلوا. ﴿آياتِنا﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the kasra in place of the fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural; the clause is in the position of accusative as an adjective of رسول.
﴿وَيُزَكِّيكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi; and likewise ﴿وَيُعَلِّمُكُمُ﴾; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَالْحِكْمَةَ﴾ a conjoined noun. ﴿وَيُعَلِّمُكُمُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لَمْ تَكُونُوا﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its noun. ﴿تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of accusative as khabar (predicate), and the clause لم تكونوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.

daas-irab:72-73.t:
﴿ادارأتم﴾: its original form is تدارأتم: you pushed [the blame] onto one another and disputed about it. ﴿اضْرِبُوهُ بِبَعْضِها﴾:
strike the slain man with some of her flesh; so they struck him and Allah brought him to life, and He followed this with His saying "كذلك يحيي الله الموتى" (thus Allah gives life to the dead).
﴿وَإِذْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the i'rab of إذ has preceded. ﴿قَتَلْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
﴿نَفْساً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَادَّارَأْتُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to قتلتم. ﴿فِيها﴾: both attached to (mutaʿalliq) ادارأتم.
﴿وَاللَّهُ مُخْرِجٌ﴾: the wāw is the wāw of parenthesis (iʿtirāḍ). الله, the Name of Majesty, is mubtadaʾ (subject) and مخرج is the khabar (predicate); the clause is parenthetical (muʿtariḍa). ﴿ما كُنْتُمْ﴾: ما is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi of the active participle مخرج; كنتم is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb [one of kāna and its sisters], the tāʾ is its noun, and the mīm is for the masculine plural. ﴿تَكْتُمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar, and the clause كنتم is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَقُلْنا﴾:
the clause is conjoined. ﴿اضْرِبُوهُ﴾:
an imperative verb; the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بِبَعْضِها﴾:
both attached to the verb before them. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾:
the kāf is a preposition; ذلك is a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of genitive by the preposition; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), the implied form being "كذلك يحيي الله الموتى إحياء مثل ذلك الإحياء" (thus Allah gives life to the dead, a giving of life like that giving of life). ﴿يُحْيِ﴾:
an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ because of heaviness. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾:
the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿الْمَوْتى﴾:
mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), because before it there is omitted speech, as if Allah the Exalted had said: "فضربوه ببعضها فيحيى، كذلك يحيي" (so they struck him with part of it and he came to life; thus He gives life). ﴿وَيُرِيكُمْ﴾:
the wāw is a conjunction; an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined. ﴿آياتِهِ﴾:
second mafʿūl bihi, accusative with kasra. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾:
لعل and its noun, and the clause ﴿تَعْقِلُونَ﴾
is its khabar.

daas-irab:74-74.t:
﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿قَسَتْ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif, which was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿قُلُوبُكُمْ﴾: fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾: both attached to (mutaʿalliq) قست. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَهِيَ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; هي is a detached nominative pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كَالْحِجارَةِ﴾: both attached to the omitted khabar (predicate); it is also said that the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل) and is itself the khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿أَشَدُّ﴾: khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هي أشد" (they are harder); [or] conjoined to the kāf or to the omitted khabar, as a conjoining of single words. ﴿قَسْوَةً﴾: tamyīz (specification).
﴿وَإِنَّ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إنّ is a particle resembling the verb (one of inna and its sisters). ﴿مِنَ الْحِجارَةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted khabar of إنّ.
﴿لَما﴾: the lām is the lām of initiation (lām al-ibtidāʾ) — it is also said to be the shifted lām (muzaḥlaqa); ما is a relative noun in the position of accusative as the delayed noun of إنّ. ﴿يَتَفَجَّرُ﴾: the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾: both attached to يتفجر. ﴿الْأَنْهارُ﴾: fāʿil. The clause ﴿إِنَّ مِنَ الْحِجارَةِ﴾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿وَإِنَّ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إنّ is a particle resembling the verb. ﴿مِنْها﴾: both attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿لَما﴾: the lām is the lām of initiation; ما is a relative noun, its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَشَّقَّقُ﴾ is an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿فَيَخْرُجُ مِنْهُ الْماءُ﴾ is conjoined to it, and likewise the clause ﴿وَإِنَّ مِنْها لَما يَهْبِطُ مِنْ خَشْيَةِ اللَّهِ﴾. ﴿وَمَا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ما is negative, working like ليس. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, its noun. «[Translator's note: the source prints the word with a kasra (﴿اللَّهِ﴾) although it parses it as the noun of ما (nominative); in the verse it is اللَّهُ.]» ﴿بِغافِلٍ﴾: the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; غافل is a noun, genitive in form and accusative in position, as the khabar of ما. ﴿عَمَّا﴾: عن is a preposition; ما is a relative noun in the position of genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the active participle غافل. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, and the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, its implied form being "عما تعملونه" (of what you do).

daas-irab:75-75.t:
﴿أَفَتَطْمَعُونَ﴾: the hamza is for disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), the fāʾ is a conjunction; تطمعون is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَنْ يُؤْمِنُوا﴾: the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from the verb and the maṣdar-forming particle is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, the implied form being "في إيمانهم" (in their believing). It is also said to be in the position of accusative by removal of the preposition. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb يؤمنوا. ﴿وَقَدْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿كانَ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb [one of kāna and its sisters]. ﴿فَرِيقٌ﴾: its noun. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾: both attached to a naʿt (adjective) of فريق. ﴿يَسْمَعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿كَلامَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause كان فريق منهم is circumstantial. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction.
﴿يُحَرِّفُونَهُ مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾: [من بعد:] both attached to the verb. ﴿ما عَقَلُوهُ﴾: ما is maṣdariyya, interpreted together with the verb after it as a maṣdar in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa), the implied form being "بعد عقلهم له" (after their understanding it); the clause يحرفونه is conjoined. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; هم is a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾: the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:76-76.t:
﴿وَإِذا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إذا is an adverb for future time, putting its condition in the genitive [by annexation] and attached to (mutaʿalliq) its apodosis. ﴿لَقُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position.
﴿آمَنَّا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, and نا is the fāʿil; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَإِذا﴾: conjoined to the first إذا. ﴿خَلا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa. ﴿بَعْضُهُمْ﴾: fāʿil. ﴿إِلى بَعْضٍ﴾: both attached to the verb خلا. The clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. The clause is the apodosis of إذا. ﴿أَتُحَدِّثُونَهُمْ﴾: the hamza is interrogative; تحدثونهم is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is maqūl al-qawl. ﴿بِما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition; ما is relative or maṣdariyya; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them, and the clause ﴿فَتَحَ اللَّهُ﴾ has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: both attached to فتح. ﴿لِيُحَاجُّوكُمْ﴾: the lām is the lām of outcome (lām al-ʿāqiba), or of result (al-ṣayrūra), and it is like the lām of causation (taʿlīl).
﴿يحاجوكم﴾: an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of outcome, the sign of its subjunctive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the kāf is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. The interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb تحدثونهم. ﴿بِهِ﴾: both attached to يحاجوكم. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to the verb before it. ﴿رَبِّكُمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿أَفَلا تَعْقِلُونَ﴾: its i'rab has preceded.

daas-irab:77-77.t: ﴿أَوَلا﴾: the hamza is for interrogation and rebuke, and the wāw is resumptive; لا is negative. ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: أنّ, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾: the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿ما يُسِرُّونَ﴾: ما is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause يسرون is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the clause يعلمون is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause ﴿وَما يُعْلِنُونَ﴾ is conjoined. أنّ with its noun and its khabar takes the place of the two objects of يعلمون.

daas-irab:78-79.t:
﴿وَمِنْهُمْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; منهم: both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿أُمِّيُّونَ﴾: a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative with the wāw. ﴿لا يَعْلَمُونَ﴾: لا is negative; يعلمون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of nominative as a naʿt (adjective). ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿أَمانِيَّ﴾: excepted (mustathnā), accusative; the nominal clause ومنهم أميون is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿وَإِنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن has the meaning of the negative ما. ﴿هُمْ﴾: a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿يَظُنُّونَ﴾: the clause is the khabar of هم, and the nominal clause is conjoined. ﴿فَوَيْلٌ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; ويل is mubtadaʾ, nominative; beginning with it was permissible, though it is indefinite, because it is an imprecation. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾: both attached to the omitted khabar; the clause is resumptive.
﴿يَكْتُبُونَ الْكِتابَ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿بِأَيْدِيهِمْ﴾: a noun, genitive with an implied (muqaddar) kasra on the yāʾ because of heaviness; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿ثُمَّ يَقُولُونَ﴾: the clause is conjoined. ﴿هذا﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿مِنْ عِنْدِ﴾: both attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لِيَشْتَرُوا﴾: the lām is the lām of causation (lām al-taʿlīl); يشتروا is an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb), and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿بِهِ﴾: both attached to the verb before them. ﴿ثَمَناً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾: a naʿt, accusative. ﴿فَوَيْلٌ لَهُمْ﴾: the nominal clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa).
﴿مِمَّا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ ويل. ﴿كَتَبَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿وَوَيْلٌ لَهُمْ﴾: the clause is conjoined to the clause ويل preceding it. ﴿مِمَّا﴾: both attached to ويل.
﴿يَكْسِبُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila.

daas-irab:222-222.t:
﴿وَيَسْئَلُونَكَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; يسألونك is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿عَنِ الْمَحِيضِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them; the clause is conjoined. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, the fāʿil being "anta" (you); the clause is resumptive. ﴿هُوَ﴾ a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَذىً﴾ khabar (predicate); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿فَاعْتَزِلُوا﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition); اعتزلوا is an imperative verb and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿النِّساءَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فِي الْمَحِيضِ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), its implied form being "being in the state of menstruation". ﴿وَلا تَقْرَبُوهُنَّ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined, and the clause ﴿فَاعْتَزِلُوا﴾ has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya) and genitive. ﴿يَطْهُرْنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because of its connection to the nūn of the feminine plural, and the nūn is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿فَإِذا﴾
the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); إذا is an adverb (ẓarf) for future time, putting its condition in the genitive and itself made accusative by its apodosis. ﴿تَطَهَّرْنَ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because of its connection to the nūn of the feminine plural, and the nūn is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَأْتُوهُنَّ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); أتوهن is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn because its imperfect is one of the five verbs; the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ حَيْثُ﴾ من is a preposition; حيث is an adverb of place, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أتوهن. ﴿أَمَرَكُمُ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi, and the Name of Majesty as fāʿil. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ إنّ and the Name of Majesty as its noun (ism). ﴿يُحِبُّ﴾ an imperfect verb, the fāʿil being "huwa" (He). ﴿التَّوَّابِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ; the clause is the khabar of إنّ, and likewise the clause ﴿وَيُحِبُّ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ﴾, which is conjoined to it.

daas-irab:223-223.t: ﴿نِساؤُكُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿حَرْثٌ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ṣifa (adjective) of حرث; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَأْتُوا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); أتوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿حَرْثَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَنَّى﴾ a conditional noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as an adverb of time — it has also been said, of place — attached to أتوا. ﴿شِئْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَقَدِّمُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; قدموا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil. ﴿لِأَنْفُسِكُمْ﴾ both attached to قدموا. ﴿وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ﴾ an imperative verb, the wāw is the fāʿil, and the Name of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَاعْلَمُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil; these clauses are all conjoined. ﴿وَبَشِّرِ﴾ an imperative verb. ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, the fāʿil being "anta" (you); the clause is conjoined, and أنّ and what follows it stand in place of the two objects of اعلموا. [Translator's note: the source does not parse ﴿أَنَّكُمْ مُلاقُوهُ﴾ separately; this last remark refers to it.]

daas-irab:224-224.t: ﴿وَلا تَجْعَلُوا﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); لا is the prohibitive, jussive-governing lā; تجعلوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿عُرْضَةً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لِأَيْمانِكُمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) عرضة; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a maṣdar-forming particle that puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿تَبَرُّوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and the wāw is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), the implied form being "for fear of your being righteous". ﴿وَتَتَّقُوا وَتُصْلِحُوا﴾ like تبروا. ﴿بَيْنَ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to تصلحوا. ﴿النَّاسِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَاللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and two khabars (predicates); the clause is resumptive or parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya).

daas-irab:225-225.t: ﴿لا يُؤاخِذُكُمُ﴾ لا is negating; يؤاخذكم is an imperfect verb and the kāf is its object. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِاللَّغْوِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) يؤاخذكم. ﴿فِي أَيْمانِكُمْ﴾ both attached to اللغو, or to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from it. ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk). ﴿يُؤاخِذُكُمُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the fāʿil being "huwa" (He), referring to Allah the Exalted; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِما﴾ both attached to the verb before them. ﴿كَسَبَتْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿قُلُوبُكُمْ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ حَلِيمٌ﴾ the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject), and غفور and حليم are two khabars (predicates).

daas-irab:226-226.t: ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿يُؤْلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿مِنْ نِسائِهِمْ﴾ both attached to the verb before them. ﴿تَرَبُّصُ﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَرْبَعَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَشْهُرٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَإِنْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿إن﴾ a jussive-governing conditional. ﴿فاؤُ﴾ a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿فَإِنْ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿فَإِنْ﴾ here; the Quranic text is ﴿فَإِنَّ﴾.] ﴿إن اللَّهَ﴾ إنّ and the Name of Majesty as its noun (ism). ﴿غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾ two khabars; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.

daas-irab:227-227.t:
﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; إن is a jussive-governing conditional particle. ﴿عَزَمُوا﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿الطَّلاقَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); it has also been said that it is accusative by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e. "upon divorce". The clause is conjoined. ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); إنّ, the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism), and سميع and عليم are its two khabars (predicates); the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.
It has also been said that the apodosis is omitted, its implied form being "let them carry it out".

daas-irab:228-228.t:
﴿وَالْمُطَلَّقاتُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); المطلقات is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَتَرَبَّصْنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿بِأَنْفُسِهِنَّ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) يتربصن. ﴿ثَلاثَةَ﴾ an adverb of time, attached to يتربصن; it has also been said that it is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿قُرُوءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; لا is negating. ﴿يَحِلُّ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿لَهُنَّ﴾ both attached to يحل. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a maṣdar-forming particle that puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿يَكْتُمْنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative by أن, and the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil; أن and the imperfect verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil of يحل. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿خَلَقَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil. ﴿فِي أَرْحامِهِنَّ﴾ both attached to خلق; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a jussive-governing conditional particle. [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿أَنْ﴾; the conditional particle in the Quranic text is ﴿إِنْ﴾. The same applies to the second ﴿أَنْ﴾ below.] ﴿كُنَّ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because of its connection to the nūn of the feminine plural, and the nūn is its noun (ism); it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿يُؤْمِنَّ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كنّ, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being: "if they believe, then let them not do so".
﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by the bāʾ, and both are attached to يؤمنّ. ﴿وَالْيَوْمِ﴾ conjoined. ﴿الْآخِرِ﴾ ṣifa (adjective). ﴿وَبُعُولَتُهُنَّ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; بعولتهن is mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَحَقُّ﴾ khabar. ﴿بِرَدِّهِنَّ﴾ both attached to أحق. ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾ both attached to ردهن. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a jussive-governing conditional particle. ﴿أَرادُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis. ﴿إِصْلاحاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. ﴿وَلَهُنَّ﴾ both attached to an omitted, fronted khabar. ﴿مِثْلُ﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلَيْهِنَّ﴾ both attached to an omitted ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿بِالْمَعْرُوفِ﴾ both attached to an omitted ṣifa of مثل, or to the khabar; the nominal clause ﴿وَلَهُنَّ﴾ is conjoined to the one before it. ﴿وَلِلرِّجالِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; للرجال: both attached to an omitted, fronted khabar. ﴿عَلَيْهِنَّ﴾ both attached to an omitted khabar as well. ﴿دَرَجَةٌ﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَاللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ﴾ the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ, and عزيز and حكيم are two khabars; the clause is resumptive or parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya).

daas-irab:229-229.t:
﴿الطَّلاقُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مَرَّتانِ﴾ khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) with the alif because it is dual. ﴿فَإِمْساكٌ﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition); إمساك is the mubtadaʾ of an omitted khabar, its implied form being "then upon you is retaining". ﴿بِمَعْرُوفٍ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) إمساك. ﴿أَوْ تَسْرِيحٌ﴾ أو is a conjunction; تسريح is conjoined to إمساك. ﴿بِإِحْسانٍ﴾ both attached to تسريح. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); لا is negating. ﴿يَحِلُّ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ both attached to يحل. ﴿أَنْ﴾ an accusative-governing particle. ﴿تَأْخُذُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the deletion of the nūn; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil (agent) of يحل, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ both attached to تأخذوا. ﴿آتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ﴾ a past verb; the tāʾ is the tāʾ of the agent, the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the nūn is for the feminine plural; its ḍamma was prolonged, and so the wāw arose; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi of تأخذوا. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿أَنْ﴾ an accusative-governing particle. ﴿يَخافا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by the deletion of the nūn, and the alif is the fāʿil; أن and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) in the position of the genitive by a preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), the implied form being: "except fearing". [Translator's note: no preposition appears in the text; one is implied.] ﴿إِلَّا﴾ أن is an accusative-governing particle and لا is negating. [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿إِلَّا﴾; the word in the Quranic text is ﴿أَلَّا﴾ (أن + لا).] ﴿يُقِيما﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative; the verb with أن is interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿حُدُودَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَإِنْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; إن is conditional. ﴿خِفْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿أَلَّا يُقِيما﴾ the interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi of خفتم. ﴿حُدُودَ اللَّهِ﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb); لا is the lā of generic negation. ﴿جُناحَ﴾ its noun (ism), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿عَلَيْهِما﴾ both attached to an omitted khabar of لا. ﴿فِيمَا﴾ both attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿افْتَدَتْ﴾ a past verb; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿بِهِ﴾ both attached to افتدت; the clause فلا جناح is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿تِلْكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿حُدُودَ﴾ khabar. [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿حُدُودَ﴾ with fatḥa; as khabar it is ﴿حُدُودُ﴾.] ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive.
﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa; لا is the prohibitive, jussive-governing lā. ﴿تَعْتَدُوها﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of an implied condition. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; من is a jussive-governing conditional noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَتَعَدَّ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the weak letter, the fāʿil being "huwa" (he). ﴿حُدُودَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis; أولئك is mubtadaʾ. ﴿هُمُ﴾ a second mubtadaʾ. ﴿الظَّالِمُونَ﴾ its khabar; the nominal clause ﴿هُمُ الظَّالِمُونَ﴾ is the khabar of أولئك, and the clause ﴿فَأُولئِكَ ... ﴾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.
And the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of مَن.

daas-irab:152-152.t: ﴿فَاذْكُرُونِي﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa; اذكروني is an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on dropping the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَذْكُرْكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the response to the command (jawāb al-ṭalab); the fāʿil is "I" and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿وَاشْكُرُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; اشكروا is like the preceding اذكروا. ﴿لِي﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; lā is the jussive lā of prohibition. ﴿تَكْفُرُونِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive by dropping the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw is the fāʿil, the nūn is for protection, and the omitted yāʾ is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:153-154.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾ see verse no. 21. The clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿اسْتَعِينُوا﴾ an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on dropping the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿بِالصَّبْرِ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿وَالصَّلاةِ﴾ conjoined to الصبر. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿مَعَ الصَّابِرِينَ﴾ مع is an adverb of place attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of inna; الصابرين is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلا تَقُولُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; lā is the jussive lā of prohibition; تقولوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by dropping the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿لِمَنْ﴾ man is a relative noun in the position of genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿يُقْتَلُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun. ﴿فِي سَبِيلِ﴾ attached to the verb before them; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَمْواتٌ﴾ the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being: "they are dead"; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction. ﴿أَحْياءٌ﴾ the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being: "they are alive"; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; lākin is a particle of rectification (istidrāk). ﴿لا تَشْعُرُونَ﴾ lā is negative; تشعرون is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:155-157.t:
﴿وَلَنَبْلُوَنَّكُمْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and the lām paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam); نبلونكم is an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because of its connection with the heavy nūn of emphasis; the fāʿil (agent) is "we" and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the response to the oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿بِشَيْءٍ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) نبلونكم. ﴿مِنَ الْخَوْفِ﴾ attached to an omitted adjective of شيء. ﴿وَالْجُوعِ﴾ conjoined to الخوف. ﴿وَنَقْصٍ﴾ conjoined. ﴿مِنَ الْأَمْوالِ﴾ attached to an adjective of نقص. ﴿وَالْأَنْفُسِ وَالثَّمَراتِ﴾ also conjoined. ﴿وَبَشِّرِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; بشر is an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "you". ﴿الصَّابِرِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the yāʾ; the clause is conjoined to the clause لنبلونكم. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun indeclinable on the fatḥa in the position of accusative as an adjective of الصابرين. ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverb for future time, attached to its apodosis قالوا. ﴿أَصابَتْهُمْ﴾ a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi.
﴿مُصِيبَةٌ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, genitive by the lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to راجعون. [Translator's note: so in the source; لله is usually taken as the khabar of the first inna.] ﴿وَإِنَّا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; inna and its noun. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ attached to راجعون; the clause is conjoined to the clause before it. ﴿راجِعُونَ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural. The clause قالوا is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position, and the nominal clause إنا لله is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative indeclinable on the kasra in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted element in the position of nominative as a fronted khabar. ﴿صَلَواتٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause عليهم صلوات is the khabar of أولئك. ﴿وَأُولئِكَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; أولئك: mubtadaʾ. ﴿هُمُ﴾ a second mubtadaʾ.
﴿الْمُهْتَدُونَ﴾ the khabar of هم; the nominal clause هم المهتدون is the khabar of أولئك.

daas-irab:158-158.t:
﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb (ḥarf mushabbah bi-l-fiʿl). ﴿الصَّفا﴾ its noun, accusative with the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif due to impossibility (taʿadhdhur). ﴿وَالْمَرْوَةَ﴾ conjoined to الصفا. ﴿مِنْ شَعائِرِ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of inna; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; man is a jussive conditional noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿حَجَّ﴾ a past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʿil (agent) is "he", referring to man. ﴿الْبَيْتَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَوِ اعْتَمَرَ﴾ aw is a conjunction; اعتمر is a past verb conjoined to the preceding one, and the fāʿil is "he". ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis of the condition; lā is the lā of generic negation, which operates like inna. ﴿جُناحَ﴾ its noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of lā. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle. [Translator's note: so in the source; the Qur'anic word is أَنْ.]
﴿يَطَّوَّفَ﴾ an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb); an and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of genitive by a preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the maṣdar جناح. ﴿بِهِما﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يطوف. The clause فلا جناح is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the two clauses of the condition and its apodosis are the khabar of man. ﴿وَمَنْ تَطَوَّعَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and it is parsed like من حج. ﴿خَيْراً﴾ accusative by removal of the preposition, its implied form being "whoever volunteers with good". ﴿فَإِنَّ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis of the condition.
﴿إن اللَّهِ﴾ inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿شاكِرٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾ two khabars of inna. The clause ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis with its apodosis is the khabar of man.

daas-irab:159-159.t:
﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾ inna, and the relative noun is its noun. ﴿يَكْتُمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَنْزَلْنا﴾ a past verb, and نا is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿مِنَ الْبَيِّناتِ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "in the state of being clarifying". ﴿وَالْهُدى﴾ conjoined to البينات. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ attached to the verb يكتمون. ﴿ما بَيَّنَّاهُ﴾ mā is maṣdariyya; بيناه is a past verb, نا is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾ attached to the verb before them. ﴿فِي الْكِتابِ﴾ attached to the verb بيناه. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَلْعَنُهُمُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi.
﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَيَلْعَنُهُمُ اللَّاعِنُونَ﴾ the clause is conjoined to the preceding clause يلعنهم. The nominal clause أولئك is the khabar of inna.

daas-irab:160-160.t:
﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa in the position of accusative as the excepted. ﴿تابُوا﴾ a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَأَصْلَحُوا وَبَيَّنُوا﴾ both conjoined to تابوا.
﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾ the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida); أولئك is a demonstrative indeclinable on the kasra in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَتُوبُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as "I". ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them; the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the demonstrative, and the nominal clause ﴿أولئك﴾ is resumptive. ﴿وَأَنَا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; أنا is mubtadaʾ.
﴿التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ﴾ two khabars of أنا; the clause is conjoined to the clause before it.

daas-irab:161-161.t:
﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَماتُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; ماتوا is a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial; هم: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كُفَّارٌ﴾ khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar. ﴿لَعْنَةُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالْمَلائِكَةِ وَالنَّاسِ﴾ two conjoined nouns.
﴿أَجْمَعِينَ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis) of الناس, genitive with the yāʾ because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural. The nominal clause ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ أولئك, and the nominal clause ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna. The clause ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾ is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:162-163.t:
﴿خالِدِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿فِيها﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) خالدين. ﴿لا يُخَفَّفُ﴾
lā is negative; يخفف: a passive imperfect verb. ﴿عَنْهُمُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يخفف.
﴿الْعَذابُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the verbal clause is in the position of accusative as a second ḥāl, of the latent (mustatir) pronoun in خالدين, so it is an overlapping ḥāl (ḥāl mutadākhila); it is also said to be a ḥāl of the genitive pronoun in عليهم. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; lā: negative. ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿يُنْظَرُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of هم, and the nominal clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿وَإِلهُكُمْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; إلهكم is mubtadaʾ, and the kāf is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿إِلهٌ﴾ its khabar. ﴿واحِدٌ﴾ an adjective of إله; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا﴾ the lā of generic negation, which operates like inna. ﴿إِلهٌ﴾ its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). The khabar of lā is omitted, its implied form being "existent". ﴿هُوَ﴾ a detached pronoun, badal (substitute) of the latent pronoun in the omitted khabar. ﴿الرَّحْمنُ الرَّحِيمُ﴾ two khabars of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "He". The nominal clause ﴿لا إِلهَ إِلَّا هُوَ﴾ is a second khabar of إلهكم, and the clause هو الرحمن الرحيم is in the position of nominative as a third khabar.

daas-irab:164-164.t:
﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb (ḥarf mushabbah bi-l-fiʿl). ﴿فِي خَلْقِ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined. ﴿وَاخْتِلافِ﴾ conjoined to خلق. ﴿اللَّيْلِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالنَّهارِ﴾ conjoined to الليل.
﴿وَالْفُلْكِ﴾ conjoined to خلق. ﴿الَّتِي﴾ a relative noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn in the position of genitive as an adjective of الفلك.
﴿تَجْرِي﴾ an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "it (fem.)"; the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿فِي الْبَحْرِ﴾ are attached to the verb before them; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿بِما﴾ the bāʾ is a preposition; mā is a relative noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb تجري. ﴿يَنْفَعُ النَّاسَ﴾ an imperfect verb and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿وَما﴾ a relative noun conjoined to what precedes.
﴿أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾ attached to أنزل. ﴿مِنْ ماءٍ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are a badal (substitute) of His saying من السماء. ﴿فَأَحْيا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; أحيا is conjoined to أنزل. ﴿بِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أحيا. ﴿الْأَرْضِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بَعْدَ﴾ an adverb of time attached to أحيا. ﴿مَوْتِها﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَبَثَّ﴾ conjoined to أحيا. ﴿فِيها﴾. ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ﴾ both are attached to بث. ﴿دَابَّةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَتَصْرِيفِ﴾ conjoined to خلق. ﴿الرِّياحِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالسَّحابِ﴾ conjoined to الرياح.
﴿الْمُسَخَّرِ﴾ an adjective of السحاب. ﴿بَيْنَ﴾ an adverb of place attached to مسخر. ﴿السَّماءِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined. ﴿لَآياتٍ﴾ the lām is the lām of emphasis (tawkīd); it is also said to be the shifted lām (al-muzaḥlaqa). آيات is the postponed noun of inna, accusative with the kasra in place of the fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of آيات. ﴿يَعْقِلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of genitive as an adjective of قوم.

daas-irab:80-81.t:
﴿وَقالُوا﴾: the wāw is resumptive. قالوا is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿لَنْ تَمَسَّنَا﴾: تمس is an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by لن, and نا is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿النَّارُ﴾: fāʿil. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَيَّاماً﴾: an adverb of time. ﴿مَعْدُودَةً﴾: a naʿt (adjective), accusative; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "أنت" (you). ﴿أَتَّخَذْتُمْ﴾: the connecting hamza (hamzat al-waṣl) was dropped because of the presence of the interrogative hamza; the clause is maqūl al-qawl, and the clause قل is resumptive. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾: an adverb of place. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَهْداً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَلَنْ﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis of the omitted condition. ﴿يُخْلِفَ اللَّهُ عَهْدَهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), in the position of jussive. ﴿أَمْ﴾: a conjunction, or with the meaning of بل (rather).
﴿تَقُولُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive by على, and both are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿ما﴾: relative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لا﴾: negative, and the clause ﴿تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, its implied form being "ما لا تعلمونه" (what you do not know). ﴿بَلى﴾: a particle of answer. ﴿مَنْ﴾: a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كَسَبَ﴾: a past verb. ﴿سَيِّئَةً﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "هو" (he); the clause is in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate) — it is also said that the clause of the apodosis is the khabar. ﴿وَأَحاطَتْ﴾: conjoined to كسب. ﴿بِهِ﴾: both attached to أحاطت. ﴿خَطِيئَتُهُ﴾: fāʿil. ﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis; أولئك is a demonstrative in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَصْحابُ﴾: its khabar. ﴿النَّارِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿هُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِيها﴾: both attached to خالدون. ﴿خالِدُونَ﴾: khabar; the clause is a naʿt, and the clause فأولئك is in the position of jussive as the apodosis.

daas-irab:82-82.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا﴾: see verse 39; its i'rab is like the i'rab of that verse, even though it is its opposite in meaning.

daas-irab:83-83.t:
﴿وَإِذْ﴾: إذ is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر يا محمد" (remember, O Muhammad) or "اذكروا يا بني إسرائيل" (remember, O Children of Israel). ﴿أَخَذْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِيثاقَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بَنِي﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the yāʾ because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural. ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with fatḥa in place of kasra, a foreign proper noun [and so a diptote]. The clause أخذنا is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿لا تَعْبُدُونَ﴾: لا is negative, with no grammatical position; تعبدون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿اللَّهَ﴾: the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَبِالْوالِدَيْنِ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, the bāʾ is a preposition, and الوالدين is a noun, genitive with the yāʾ because it is a dual. The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted verb وأحسنوا (and do good). The clause لا تعبدون is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "قلنا لا تعبدون" (We said: you shall not worship), and the negation here has the force of prohibition. The clause is conjoined to the clause لا تعبدون. ﴿إِحْساناً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. ﴿وَذِي الْقُرْبى وَالْيَتامى وَالْمَساكِينِ﴾: conjoined nouns; ذي is a noun, genitive with the yāʾ because it is one of the five nouns. ﴿وَقُولُوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; قولوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to the omitted clause أحسنوا. ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾: both attached to قولوا. ﴿حُسْناً﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq, its implied form being "قولوا قولا ذا حسن" (speak a speech possessing goodness), or "قولا حسنا" (a good speech). ﴿وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلاةَ﴾: the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَآتُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿الزَّكاةَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ثُمَّ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ﴾: the clause is conjoined to an implied, omitted clause, i.e. "قبلتم ثم توليتم" (you accepted, then you turned away). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾: excepted (mustathnā), accusative. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾: both attached to قليل. ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ مُعْرِضُونَ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); أنتم is mubtadaʾ (subject) and معرضون is khabar (predicate); the clause is circumstantial.

daas-irab:84-84.t: ﴿وَإِذْ أَخَذْنا مِيثاقَكُمْ﴾: its i'rab is like the preceding one. ﴿لا تَسْفِكُونَ دِماءَكُمْ﴾: لا is negative, and an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl) of the omitted [verb of] saying. ﴿وَلا تُخْرِجُونَ أَنْفُسَكُمْ مِنْ دِيارِكُمْ﴾: conjoined. ﴿ثُمَّ أَقْرَرْتُمْ﴾: conjoined to the clause أخذنا, or to an omitted clause, i.e. "قبلتم ثم أقررتم" (you accepted, then you affirmed). ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); أنتم is a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿تَشْهَدُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause تشهدون is the khabar (predicate). The nominal clause is circumstantial, and it is also said to be conjoined to أقررتم.

daas-irab:85-85.t:
﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾: a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿هؤُلاءِ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of accusative as a vocative, by the omitted vocative particle يا. ﴿تَقْتُلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَنْفُسَكُمْ﴾:
mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and likewise the clause ﴿وَتُخْرِجُونَ فَرِيقاً﴾, conjoined to the preceding one. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾: both attached to (mutaʿalliq) فريق, or to a naʿt (adjective) of it. ﴿مِنْ دِيارِهِمْ﴾: both attached to the verb تخرجون. ﴿تَظاهَرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: both attached to تظاهرون; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿بِالْإِثْمِ﴾: both attached to an omitted ḥāl; the meaning is "تظاهرون عليهم حال كونهم متلبسين بالإثم" (you back one another against them while they are engaged in sin).
﴿وَالْعُدْوانِ﴾: a noun conjoined to الإثم. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إن is conditional. ﴿يَأْتُوكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أُسارى﴾: a ḥāl, accusative; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿تُفادُوهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the nūn because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿وَهُوَ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); هو is mubtadaʾ. ﴿مُحَرَّمٌ﴾: khabar. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to محرم. The nominal clause is circumstantial. ﴿إِخْراجُهُمْ﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of the passive participle محرم. Alternatively, هو may be parsed as mubtadaʾ, محرم as a fronted khabar and إخراجهم as a delayed mubtadaʾ, the nominal clause being the khabar. ﴿أَفَتُؤْمِنُونَ بِبَعْضِ الْكِتابِ وَتَكْفُرُونَ بِبَعْضٍ﴾: conjoined to an omitted clause, the implied form being "أتفعلون ذلك فتؤمنون" (do you do that, and so believe...). ﴿فَما﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; ما is negative. ﴿جَزاءُ﴾: mubtadaʾ, nominative. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a relative noun in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). «[Translator's note: the source prints this word as ﴿مِنْ﴾; the relative noun in the verse is مَن.]» ﴿يَفْعَلُ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is "هو" (he). ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾: both attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "حال كونه منكم" (being one of you). The clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿خِزْيٌ﴾: khabar of جزاء; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِي الْحَياةِ﴾: both attached to خزي. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾: a naʿt of الحياة. ﴿وَيَوْمَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; يوم is a mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial) attached to يردون.
﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿يُرَدُّونَ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلى أَشَدِّ﴾: both attached to يردون. ﴿الْعَذابِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿وَمَا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ما is the Ḥijāzī mā, working like ليس. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, its noun. ﴿بِغافِلٍ﴾: the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; غافل is a noun, genitive in form and accusative in position, as the khabar of ليس. «[Translator's note: so in the source; what is meant is the khabar of ما, which works like ليس.]» ﴿عَمَّا﴾: ما is a relative noun in the position of genitive by the preposition; both are attached to تعلمون. «[Translator's note: so in the source; the phrase عما is evidently attached to غافل, as at verse 74, while تعملون is the verb of the ṣila.]» The clause is resumptive, and the clause ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun.

daas-irab:230-230.t: ﴿فَإِنْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; إن is a jussive-governing conditional particle. ﴿طَلَّقَها﴾ a past verb, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); لا is negating. ﴿تَحِلُّ﴾ an imperfect verb, the fāʿil (agent) being "hiya" (she), i.e. the divorced woman; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿لَهُ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) تحل. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدُ﴾ بعد is an adverb of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma because it has been cut off from annexation, and it is in the position of the genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya) and genitive. ﴿تَنْكِحَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an أن concealed after حتى; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تحل. ﴿زَوْجاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿غَيْرَهُ﴾ ṣifa (adjective). ﴿فَإِنْ طَلَّقَها﴾ its i'rab is like the one before it. ﴿فَلا جُناحَ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis; لا is the lā of generic negation, and جناح is its noun (ism). ﴿عَلَيْهِما﴾ both attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of لا. ﴿أَنْ يَتَراجَعا﴾ the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by a preposition, and both are attached to the khabar of لا. ﴿إِنْ ظَنَّا﴾ إن is a jussive-governing conditional; ظنا is a past verb and the alif is the fāʿil; it is the protasis. ﴿أَنْ يُقِيما﴾ the interpreted maṣdar stands in place of the two objects of ظنا. ﴿حُدُودَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the apodosis clause is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. ﴿وَتِلْكَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); تلك is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿حُدُودَ﴾ khabar. [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿حُدُودَ﴾ with fatḥa; as khabar it is ﴿حُدُودُ﴾.] ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يُبَيِّنُها﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, the fāʿil being "huwa" (He); the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾ both attached to the verb before them. ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a ṣifa.

daas-irab:231-231.t:
﴿وَإِذا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; إذا is an adverb (ẓarf) for future time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أمسكوهن. ﴿طَلَّقْتُمُ النِّساءَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَبَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; بلغن is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil. ﴿أَجَلَهُنَّ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); أمسكوهن is an imperative verb, its fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿بِمَعْرُوفٍ﴾ both attached to أمسكوهن. ﴿أَوْ سَرِّحُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ﴾ conjoined to the preceding clause. ﴿وَلا تُمْسِكُوهُنَّ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; لا is the prohibitive, jussive-governing lā; تمسكوهن is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ضِراراً﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿لِتَعْتَدُوا﴾ the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl); تعتدوا is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by a concealed أن; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ضرارا. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); من is a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَفْعَلْ﴾ the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَقَدْ﴾ the fāʾ is linking; قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿ظَلَمَ﴾ a past verb, the fāʿil being "huwa" (he). ﴿نَفْسَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; لا is jussive-governing. ﴿تَتَّخِذُوا﴾ a jussive imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿آياتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the kasra. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿هُزُواً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَاذْكُرُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿نِعْمَتَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ both attached to نعمة. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; ما is conjoined to نعمة. ﴿أَنْزَلَ﴾ a past verb, the fāʿil being "huwa" (He), referring to Allah. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ both attached to أنزل.
﴿مِنَ الْكِتابِ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَالْحِكْمَةِ﴾ conjoined to الكتاب. ﴿يَعِظُكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, the fāʿil being "huwa", and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause is circumstantial. ﴿بِهِ﴾ both attached to يعظكم. ﴿وَاتَّقُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; اتقوا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi. [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ with kasra; as mafʿūl bihi it is ﴿اللَّهَ﴾.] ﴿وَاعْلَمُوا﴾ like اتقوا. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ﴾ أنّ, the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism) and عليم its khabar (predicate); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to عليم; أنّ and what follows it stand in place of the two objects of اعلموا.

daas-irab:232-232.t:
﴿وَإِذا طَلَّقْتُمُ النِّساءَ فَبَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ﴾ parsed in the previous verse. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿تَعْضُلُوهُنَّ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the apodosis clause has no grammatical position. ﴿أَنْ يَنْكِحْنَ﴾ ينكحن is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative by أن, and the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by an implied preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿أَزْواجَهُنَّ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) for future time. ﴿تَراضَوْا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to تراضوا. ﴿بِالْمَعْرُوفِ﴾ both attached to تراضوا; the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يُوعَظُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb. ﴿بِهِ﴾ both attached to يوعظ; the clause يوعظ is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ ذلك. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿كانَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, its noun (ism) being "huwa" (he); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ both attached to the verb يؤمن. ﴿يُؤْمِنُ﴾ an imperfect verb, the fāʿil being "huwa"; the clause is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of كان. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by the bāʾ; both are attached to the verb before them. ﴿وَالْيَوْمِ﴾ conjoined to بالله. ﴿الْآخِرِ﴾ ṣifa (adjective); and the nominal clause. [Translator's note: the sentence breaks off thus in the source.]
﴿ذلِكُمْ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَزْكى﴾ its khabar. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ both attached to أزكى. ﴿وَأَطْهَرُ﴾ conjoined to أزكى. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); الله, the Name of Majesty, is mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is its khabar, and likewise: ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ لا تَعْلَمُونَ﴾.

daas-irab:233-233.t:
﴿وَالْوالِداتُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and الوالدات is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يُرْضِعْنَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَوْلادَهُنَّ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿حَوْلَيْنِ﴾ an adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is dual, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يرضعن. ﴿كامِلَيْنِ﴾ ṣifa (adjective), accusative. ﴿لِمَنْ﴾ both attached to an omitted khabar, its implied form being: "that matter is for whoever". ﴿أَرادَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿أَنْ يُتِمَّ﴾ the interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi of أراد. ﴿الرَّضاعَةَ﴾ object of يتم; the clause أراد is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَعَلَى الْمَوْلُودِ﴾ both attached to an omitted, fronted khabar. ﴿لَهُ﴾ both attached to المولود. ﴿رِزْقُهُنَّ﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَكِسْوَتُهُنَّ﴾ conjoined to رزقهن. ﴿بِالْمَعْرُوفِ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is conjoined. ﴿لا تُكَلَّفُ﴾ لا is negating; تكلف is a passive imperfect verb. ﴿نَفْسٌ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿وُسْعَها﴾ second mafʿūl bihi, the nāʾib fāʿil being the first object; the clause is explicative (tafsīriyya). ﴿لا تُضَارَّ﴾ لا is the prohibitive, jussive-governing lā; تضار is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the sukūn, and it was given the fatḥa for its lightness; it is passive. ﴿والِدَةٌ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿بِوَلَدِها﴾ both attached to تضار; the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; لا is negating. ﴿مَوْلُودٌ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil of an omitted verb, its implied form being يضار. ﴿لَهُ﴾ both attached to مولود. ﴿بِوَلَدِهِ﴾ both attached to the omitted verb يضار. ﴿وَعَلَى الْوارِثِ﴾ both attached to an omitted, fronted khabar. ﴿مِثْلُ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَإِنْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; إن is a jussive-governing conditional particle. ﴿أَرادا﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and the alif is the fāʿil; it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿فِصالًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عَنْ تَراضٍ﴾ both attached to an omitted ṣifa of فصالا. ﴿مِنْهُما﴾ both attached to تراض. ﴿وَتَشاوُرٍ﴾ conjoined. ﴿فَلا جُناحَ﴾ the fāʾ is linking; لا is the lā of generic negation; جناح is its indeclinable noun (ism). ﴿عَلَيْهِما﴾ both attached to the omitted khabar; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿أَرَدْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿أَنْ تَسْتَرْضِعُوا﴾ the interpreted maṣdar is mafʿūl bihi of the verb أردتم. ﴿أَوْلادَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the second object of تسترضعوا is omitted, its implied form being: "that you seek a wet-nurse for…".
﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis. ﴿لا جُناحَ عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) for future time, putting its condition in the genitive, attached to its apodosis. ﴿سَلَّمْتُمْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿آتَيْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِالْمَعْرُوفِ﴾ both attached to آتيتم; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive. ﴿اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the Name of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَاعْلَمُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil, conjoined to اتقوا. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ بصير: أنّ, the Name of Majesty is its noun and بصير its khabar. ﴿بِما﴾ both attached to the khabar. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun; أنّ and what follows it stand in place of the two objects of اعلموا.
